  its guards are unchanged. Program the outbound filter entry before the denied job, print the
  measured fields and restore the outbound filter to pass all.
. Error injection. Point: the DMA `DST_ADDRESS`, aimed at the unmapped local address. Kind: a
  64-byte copy to the unmapped address after the copy to the SRAM. Expected response: the copy goes
  quiet within the bound; its `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0` and handshake counts are printed. Before it, seed
  the DMA source and poison the SRAM destination, run the 64-byte copy to the SRAM (write `CONFIG`
  with `ENABLED_ND` and the descriptor registers, read `DONE_0`, read `NEXT_ID_0`, poll `DONE_0` to
  a value above the baseline, wait for the idle window) and compare the SRAM with the source; after
  the unmapped copy wait for the idle window.
. Clear `SIZE` and `DEST_ADDR`, read `SIZE` back as 0, then require the step stamps to strictly
  increase and the checker lines to appear in step order, each after its own compare; record the
  non-vacuity checker.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ZEROER-SRAM-FULL` |A 0x2_0000-byte job over the whole SRAM window ends with `STATUS` 0 on two
  reads and a SEP_IN read-back of the whole window with every 8-byte word zero
|`CHK-ZEROER-SRAM-PARTIAL` |The unaligned, one-beat and one-burst jobs each clear exactly their
  range and leave the bytes either side, guards included, at the pattern, with `STATUS` 0 on two
  reads
|`CHK-ZEROER-EGRESS-REGION` |The egress job with `INT_EN` set ends with `STATUS` 0, its range zero
  and its guard words unchanged, and raises exactly one `tb_zeroer_intp` pulse with the line low
  after the quiet window
|`CHK-ZEROER-UNMAPPED-OR-DENIED` |The job at the unmapped local address and the job under a
  write-block filter entry each end with `STATUS` 0 on two reads, and the denied region and its
  guards are unchanged; the other fields are measured and printed without comparing them
|`CHK-ACCEL-LOCAL-TARGETS` |The DMA copy to the SRAM retires and leaves the SRAM equal to the
  source, and the copy to the unmapped address goes quiet within the bound; the unmapped-copy
  `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0` and handshake counts are measured and printed without comparing them
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The six step stamps are strictly increasing and the five checker lines appear in step
  order, each after its own compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: all six checkers hold and every sequence assert holds: the full and partial clears
leave exactly the requested bytes zero, the egress job raises one pulse, the denied region is
untouched, every zeroer job ends with `STATUS` 0 and the DMA copy to the SRAM matches. The
unmapped-target and denied-target response fields and the unmapped DMA copy results are reported
only. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: For the unmapped and denied zeroer jobs the `CTRL_STATUS` bits outside `STATUS`, the
interrupt pulses, AW handshakes, B cycles and the SYS_OUT write count change are measured and
printed, not compared, because the specification does not state the value; the response codes are
not on a bench probe. For the DMA copy to the unmapped address `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0`, the AW
handshakes, B cycles and completion cycles are measured and printed, not compared.

'''''

[[sec-528-smc_dma_invalid_descriptor_test]]
===== 528 `smc_dma_invalid_descriptor_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: POWER

*Source Module*: `smc_dma_invalid_descriptor_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI sequencer (`env.sys_axi_agent`, no protocol VIP) for the DMA registers;
the TB SYS_OUT output-fabric responder memory (`cfg.sys_out_mem`) preloaded and read back through
its backdoor; TB input pin `tb_top.tb_output_axi_resp_hold` driven 0; passive probes
`tb_output_axi_arvalid`, `tb_output_axi_arready`, `tb_output_axi_araddr`,
`tb_output_axi_awvalid`, `tb_output_axi_awready`, `tb_output_axi_awaddr`, `tb_dma_busy` and bit 322
of `tb_cpu_interrupts` sampled at every `clk_smc_i` rise; DMA registers `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0`,
`NEXT_ID_0`, `CONFIG`, `NUM_REPETITIONS`, `SRC_ADDRESS`, `DST_ADDRESS`, `LENGTH`, `SRC_STRIDE`,
`DST_STRIDE`

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/dma.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: A command with `CONFIG.ENABLED_ND` cleared and a zero-length command move no data and
issue no AR or AW handshake, while the same descriptor with `ENABLED_ND` set and a nonzero length
copies; the register-boundary results of the no-data commands are measured.

*Test Coverage*:

* Clearing `CONFIG.ENABLED_ND` forces a zero-repetition command that moves no data and still retires
  its transfer ID (`dma.adoc`, Linear and Two-Dimensional Copies; `dma_ctrl.rdl`,
  `CONFIG.ENABLED_ND`). `DONE_0` must differ from its pre-command value within 3000 reads, all 16
  destination bytes must keep their 0xEE poison and no AR or AW handshake may occur between the
  submit and the `DONE_0` change. Over the whole leaf the AR and AW counts must equal those of the
  three copy legs, so no handshake occurs outside the copies.
* The `NEXT_ID_0` value the submit returned, `DONE_0` before and after, `STATUS_0[9:0]` before and
  after and the bit 322 pulse count and widths of the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared command are measured,
  not compared, until tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455 is resolved: that issue tracks the open
  disagreement between `dma.adoc` and `dma_ctrl.rdl` on what `NEXT_ID_0` returns when no command
  is set up.
* Zero-length transfers are rejected (`dma.adoc`, Stream and Register Ownership, the DMA register
  storage table): a linear command (`NUM_REPETITIONS_LO` 1) and a 2D command (`NUM_REPETITIONS_LO`
  4, source stride 0x30, destination stride 0x28) with `LENGTH` 0 must leave 16 and 136 destination
  bytes at 0xEE and produce no AR or AW handshake through the end of a 3000-read `DONE_0` poll.
  Whether `DONE_0` changed, `STATUS_0[9:0]`, the returned `NEXT_ID_0` and the bit 322 pulse count
  of both commands are measured, not compared, until tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455 is resolved.
* Positive control (`dma.adoc`, Linear and Two-Dimensional Copies): the same descriptor with
  `ENABLED_ND` set and `LENGTH_LO` 16 copies. A 2D copy with `NUM_REPETITIONS_LO` 4 and the strides
  0x30 and 0x28 of the zero-length 2D command writes its four source rows over the 136-byte
  destination span, the 72 bytes between rows staying 0xEE, with at least four AR and four AW
  handshakes; a linear copy of one row equals its source with at least one AR and one AW
  handshake. Every destination byte the no-data compares require to stay 0xEE is therefore shown
  writable by a command of this leaf.
* A 32-bit read of `NEXT_ID_0` at 0x48 launches exactly one command: `DONE_0` holds its new value on
  six further reads. A 64-bit read at 0x48 launches one command as well and counts the same AR and
  AW handshakes (`dma.adoc`, Stream and Register Ownership; `dma_ctrl.rdl`, `NEXT_ID_0`).
* The DMA interrupt is a one-cycle pulse on a falling edge of combined busy, raw CPU vector bit 322
  (`dma.adoc`, Submission and Completion): the valid copy gives exactly one pulse, one `clk_smc_i`
  cycle wide, up to one rise after `tb_dma_busy` reads low.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Require the nine `tb_top` probes to exist, release the R and B hold, program the inbound and
  outbound filter windows to pass all, start the sampler of AR and AW handshakes, bit 322 and
  `tb_dma_busy`, read `DONE_0` and wait two `clk_smc_i` cycles.
. Write a 16-byte source pattern and 16 bytes of 0xEE at the destination, program `CONFIG` 0, the
  addresses, `LENGTH_LO` 16, nonzero strides and one repetition, read `DONE_0` and `STATUS_0`, read
  `NEXT_ID_0` (32-bit) to submit, poll `DONE_0` until it differs (3000 reads), read `STATUS_0`,
  take the handshake counts and bit 322 pulses, and read the destination.
. Error injection. Point: the DMA `LENGTH` registers. Kind: a linear command with `ENABLED_ND` set,
  `LENGTH` 0 and one repetition. Expected response: the 16 destination bytes stay 0xEE and no AR or
  AW handshake occurs through the end of the 3000-read `DONE_0` poll. Re-poison the destination
  first, submit, poll `DONE_0` for 3000 reads or until it differs, and take the status, handshake,
  pulse and destination readings.
. Error injection. Point: the DMA `LENGTH` registers. Kind: a 2D command with `LENGTH` 0, four
  repetitions and strides 0x30 and 0x28. Expected response: the 136 destination bytes stay 0xEE and
  no AR or AW handshake occurs through the end of the poll. Preload 0xEE over the 136-byte span
  first and repeat the readings of step 3.
. Preload 0xEE over the 136-byte destination span, program the step-4 descriptor with
  `ENABLED_ND` set and `LENGTH_LO` 16 (four rows, strides 0x30 and 0x28), submit with a 32-bit
  read of `NEXT_ID_0`, poll `DONE_0` until it differs, read `DONE_0` six more times, wait for
  `tb_dma_busy` low and read the 136-byte span. Then re-poison 16 bytes, program the leg-a
  descriptor with `ENABLED_ND` set and one repetition, submit with a 32-bit read of `NEXT_ID_0`,
  poll `DONE_0` until it differs, read `DONE_0` six more times, wait for `tb_dma_busy` low and the
  following rise, then read the destination and take the counts and the bit 322 pulses.
. Re-poison the destination, program the same descriptor, submit with a 64-bit read at 0x48, poll
  `DONE_0`, read it six more times and read the destination.
. Wait two `clk_smc_i` cycles after step 6, require the step stamps to strictly increase and the
  step order to hold, and require the AR and AW counts accumulated since step 1 over the whole leaf
  to equal the sums of the three copy legs' counts, so any extra handshake fails; record the
  non-vacuity checker.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DMA-ND-CLEAR-NO-DATA` |After the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared command retires, all 16 destination
  bytes read 0xEE and no AR or AW handshake occurs between the submit and the `DONE_0` change
|`CHK-DMA-ND-CLEAR-DONE-ADVANCES` |`DONE_0` differs from its pre-command value within 3000 reads
  after the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared command
|`CHK-DMA-ND-CLEAR-MEASURED` |The returned `NEXT_ID_0`, `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0[9:0]` and bit 322 pulse
  readings of the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared command are measured and printed without comparing them,
  until tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455 is resolved
|`CHK-DMA-ZEROLEN-NO-DATA` |The linear and the 2D zero-length commands leave their 16 and 136
  destination bytes at 0xEE with no AR or AW handshake through the end of the poll
|`CHK-DMA-ZEROLEN-MEASURED` |The returned `NEXT_ID_0`, `DONE_0` change, `STATUS_0[9:0]` and bit 322
  pulse readings of both zero-length commands are measured and printed without comparing them,
  until tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455 is resolved
|`CHK-DMA-COPY-CONTROL` |The `ENABLED_ND`-set 2D copy of four 16-byte rows at strides 0x30 and
  0x28 writes its source rows over the 136-byte destination span with the bytes between rows still
  0xEE, after `DONE_0` differs, with at least four AR and four AW handshakes; the linear copy of 16
  bytes equals its source after `DONE_0` differs, with at least one AR and one AW handshake
|`CHK-DMA-SUBMIT-32BIT` |The 32-bit read of `NEXT_ID_0` launches one command: `DONE_0` changes and
  holds on six further reads and the destination equals the source
|`CHK-DMA-SUBMIT-64BIT` |The 64-bit read at 0x48 launches one command: the destination equals the
  source, `DONE_0` changes and holds, and the AR and AW counts equal those of the 32-bit copy
|`CHK-DMA-IRQ-PULSE-COPY` |The valid copy gives exactly one bit 322 pulse, one `clk_smc_i` cycle
  wide, ending low one rise after `tb_dma_busy` reads low
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The seven step stamps are strictly increasing in step order and the AR and AW counts
  accumulated since setup equal the sums of the three copy legs' counts; any extra handshake fails
|===

*Pass Criteria*: all ten checkers hold and every sequence assert holds: the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared
command retires its ID and both zero-length commands leave the destination at 0xEE with no bus
traffic, the 2D copy writes the 136-byte span the zero-length 2D compare covers, the linear copy
moves its 16 bytes through both a 32-bit and a 64-bit submit with equal handshake counts, and the
linear copy raises one one-cycle interrupt pulse. The register-boundary results of the no-data
commands are measured, not compared, until tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455 is resolved. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Open issue*: tenstorrent/tt-oca-harness#2455, the disagreement between `dma.adoc` and
`dma_ctrl.rdl` on what `NEXT_ID_0` returns when no command is set up.

*Scope limit*: The returned `NEXT_ID_0`, `DONE_0` before and after, `STATUS_0[9:0]` before and after
and the bit 322 pulse count and widths of the `ENABLED_ND`-cleared command, and the `DONE_0` change,
`STATUS_0[9:0]`, returned `NEXT_ID_0` and bit 322 pulse count of both zero-length commands, are
measured and not compared until the open issue above is resolved.

[[sec-023-smc_axil_burst_idle_test]]
===== 23 `smc_axil_burst_idle_test`

*Phase*: 1

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_axil_burst_idle_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI-Lite)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/axil.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`, `axil`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Run the SMC OSS AXI-Lite burst idle scenario.

*Test Coverage*:

* The eight idle SAMPLEs are a negative claim, so they run *after* a positive control: :func:`smc_axil_idle_test_seq.prove_axil_probe_alive` drives a real frontdoor SEP_IN AXI request that makes `tb_axil_any_master_active` (via its `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` term) observe 1, and the test declares `probe_positive_controls = ("axil_external_active",)` for the third backable probe.
* Without those legs a stuck-at-0 / undriven / mis-tied probe passes all eight asserts identically (`[NEGATIVE-NEEDS-POSITIVE-CONTROL]`).
* `dtp_csr_active` is never exact-compared here: no positive control for it can exist in this TB (`tb_top.sv` ties `axil_dtp_csr_resp = '0'`), so the shared :func:`smc_axil_idle_test_seq.assert_axil_idle` iterates `AXIL_CHECKABLE_FIELDS` and returns that field as OBSERVED-ONLY text.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_axil_burst_idle_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DIAG-AXIL-ACTIVE` |Positive control in `smc_diagnostic_vip_utils.py`: `tb_axil_any_master_active` samples 1 under the same eFuse-bank AXI-Lite request; the run fails if the OR never rises
|`CHK-EFUSE-BANK-AXIL-ACTIVE` |Positive control in `smc_efuse_vip_utils.py`, reached through `prove_axil_probe_alive`: `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` samples 1 while a strict SEP_IN read of the eFuse-shim window (expected its generated reset) is in flight; the run fails if the probe never rises
|`CHK-NONVAC` |Non-vacuity count in `smc_axil_burst_idle_test_seq.py`
|`CHK-PROBE-AXIL-EXTERNAL-ALIVE` |Named compare in `smc_axil_burst_idle_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DIAG-AXIL-ACTIVE`, `CHK-EFUSE-BANK-AXIL-ACTIVE`, `CHK-NONVAC`, `CHK-PROBE-AXIL-EXTERNAL-ALIVE` hold after their compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`, `axil`.

*Scope limit*: `dtp_csr_active` is never exact-compared and is returned as OBSERVED-ONLY text, because no positive control for it can exist in this bench (the DTP CSR AXI-Lite response is tied off).
'''''

[[sec-024-smc_axil_idle_test]]
===== 24 `smc_axil_idle_test`

*Phase*: 1

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_axil_idle_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI), ocah_axi_vip (AXI-Lite)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/axil.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`, `axil`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `axil`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: SMC OSS PyUVM AXI-Lite master idle test.

*Test Coverage*:

* **Positive control** -- :func:`prove_axil_probe_alive` drives real frontdoor SEP_IN AXI traffic that makes the activity OR `tb_axil_any_master_active` (and its `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` term) observe 1. Without it a stuck-at-0 / undriven / mis-tied probe passes the idle assert identically (`[NEGATIVE-NEEDS-POSITIVE-CONTROL]`).
* **Idle leg** -- one `SmcAxilItem` SAMPLE through the observer agent, whose *backable* activity bits (`AXIL_CHECKABLE_FIELDS`) must all read exactly 0. `dtp_csr_active` is excluded: no positive control for it can exist in this TB, so it is reported OBSERVED-ONLY and never exact-compared (see :func:`assert_axil_idle`). The `CHK-AXIL-IDLE` evidence token is emitted only after both legs and the typed scoreboard-counter end gate passed (`[EVIDENCE-TOKEN-CONDITIONAL]`).

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_axil_idle_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-AXIL-IDLE` |Named compare in `smc_axil_idle_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-DIAG-AXIL-ACTIVE` |Positive control in `smc_diagnostic_vip_utils.py`, reached through `prove_axil_probe_alive`: `tb_axil_any_master_active` samples 1 under a real eFuse-bank AXI-Lite request; the run fails if the OR never rises
|`CHK-EFUSE-BANK-AXIL-ACTIVE` |Positive control in `smc_efuse_vip_utils.py`, reached through `prove_axil_probe_alive`: `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` samples 1 while a strict SEP_IN read of the eFuse-shim window (expected its generated reset) is in flight; the run fails if the probe never rises
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-AXIL-IDLE`, `CHK-DIAG-AXIL-ACTIVE`, `CHK-EFUSE-BANK-AXIL-ACTIVE` hold after their compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`, `axil`.

*Scope limit*: `dtp_csr_active` is excluded from the exact compare and reported OBSERVED-ONLY, because no positive control for it can exist in this bench.
'''''

[[sec-026-smc_deadspace_decode_test]]
===== 26 `smc_deadspace_decode_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_deadspace_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Offsets past a register block's decoded extent are refused by the fabric and never reach a live register.

*Test Coverage*:

* Nine probes, one per register window (system timer, reset unit, base config, outbound filter 0, alias remap 0, DFX control, AVSBus controller, Zeroer, I2C 0). Each pairs a live register with the offset one wrap period past the block's PeakRDL `SIZE` / `TOTAL_SIZE`, read by symbol from `smc_addr.h` (`_block_extent` + `DeadspaceProbe.__post_init__`), never from the crossbar rule and never hand-copied. The crossbars are sized from the same generated parameters, so a regenerated map moves the decode and the probe definitions together.
* Contract: `hw/sys/smc/doc/memmap.adoc` -- the fabric refuses an address between unit apertures or past a unit's decoded extent. The dead read and both dead writes (`0xA5A5A5A5`, then `0x00000000`) of every probe must answer non-OKAY with the live register unchanged. An OKAY answer is booked ACCEPTED, a live change WRAP-TO-LIVE, and a dead read returning the seeded live value READ-ALIAS; each fails the leaf.
* The i2c probe lands in the SIZE-to-stride hole between two I2C instances, inside the I2C_WRAP aperture the fabric decodes; the refusal there is the i2c_wrap's own SIZE range-check and is held to the same verdict.
* Positive control: before its dead offsets are touched, each live register is seeded with a value drawn from its generated field layout (`regs/gen/py/smc_reg.py`) that raises at least one field bit -- so a 1-bit register takes a seed too -- and the readback must show the bit raised. A probe whose seed does not take keeps running, but its negative conclusions are booked `alias_not_checkable` / `change_not_proven` and fail the leaf.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_deadspace_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer. The sequence records the bystander `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` value, then for each probe reads the live register, seeds it, reads it back, reads the dead offset, writes the two dead payloads reading the live register after each, and restores the live register; it then re-reads the bystander with the baseline as the scoreboard's expected value. The leaf books a protocol-VIP record with the measured access count against a floor of 45.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DEADSPACE-SEED` |One line per probe, logged only after the seeded readback shows at least one field bit raised from the pre-seed value; it names the field mask, the value written and the bits raised. This is the positive control the two refusal compares rest on
|`CHK-DEADSPACE-READ-REFUSED` |One line per probe, logged only when the dead read answered non-OKAY. An OKAY dead read that returns the seeded live value is READ-ALIAS; an OKAY dead read of anything else is ACCEPTED; both fail the leaf
|`CHK-DEADSPACE-WRITE-REFUSED` |One line per probe, logged only when both dead writes answered non-OKAY, the live register read back unchanged after each, and the probe's seed took. A live change is WRAP-TO-LIVE, an OKAY write is ACCEPTED; both fail the leaf
|`CHK-DEADSPACE-BYSTANDER` |`CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` reads back its baseline after the sweep; the recovery read carries the baseline as the scoreboard's expected value, so the exact compare fails on collateral damage
|`CHK-DEADSPACE-SWEEP` |Summary line, logged only after the final gate held: no WRAP-TO-LIVE, READ-ALIAS or ACCEPTED entry, no unproven negative, and the refused-read and refused-write counts both equal the probe count
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every probe's seed takes, its dead read and both dead writes are refused with the live register unchanged, and the bystander is unchanged. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-028-smc_filter_multi_entry_test]]
===== 28 `smc_filter_multi_entry_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_filter_multi_entry_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: Filter 16 inbound + 16 outbound CONFIG sweep.

*Test Coverage*:

* RTL exposes 16 inbound + 16 outbound filter entries; this sweep covers every one of the 32 slots rather than entry 0 of each direction.
* Each of the 32 slots is proven *individually discriminable*, not merely "a window that answers 0x3000": every slot gets a signature value unique to (direction, index), and the sweep is PHASED so that the 32 signatures are CO-RESIDENT when they are read back.
* A per-slot write/readback/restore cycle proves nothing about aliasing: only one slot is ever non-default at a time, so an RTL that mapped all 32 windows onto one physical register would return the value just written through the very same address and pass.
* Here phase 2 programs all 32 slots without restoring any of them, and phase 3 reads all 32 back while all 32 are still resident -- so a read of slot i can only return sig_i if slot i has storage of its own.
* Under total aliasing the register holds sig_31 when phase 3 starts and the very first readback fails; under any partial aliasing of two windows the later-written one overwrites the earlier and that slot's readback fails.
* Phase 1 checks the RDL reset content of every window before anything is written, and phases 4/5 restore and re-confirm the RDL default, so the run also carries reset-value evidence.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_filter_multi_entry_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-FILTER-MULTI-ENTRY-SLOT-IDENTITY` |Named compare in `smc_filter_multi_entry_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-FILTER-MULTI-ENTRY-SLOT-IDENTITY` hold after their compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-032-smc_output_fabric_slverr_inject_test]]
===== 32 `smc_output_fabric_slverr_inject_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_output_fabric_slverr_inject_test`

draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: OKAY WR/RD, then the SYS_OUT responder's one-shot SLVERR and DECERR on both directions, each carried back to the manager unchanged, and an OKAY recovery on the same address.

*Test Coverage*:

* SYS_OUT error responses through the slave agent's one-shot faults.
* The outbound fabric is a conduit: an error the subordinate raises is the subordinate's verdict, and the fabric's obligation is to hand the requesting manager the same encoding, neither downgraded nor swallowed. Each injected code is observed on the SYS_OUT wire by the passive monitor and required of the manager, so a fabric that rewrote it fails.
* The response code is an exact expectation on each access, so a DECERR is not satisfied by a SLVERR.
* The errored accesses leave the stored word untouched, and the OKAY write/read pair that follows on the same address shows no error state was latched.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_output_fabric_slverr_inject_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SYS-OUT-ERROR-CODES` |Each injected response code -- read SLVERR, write SLVERR, write DECERR and read DECERR -- was counted exactly once on the SYS_OUT wire by the passive monitor and received by the JTAG-AXI manager with the same encoding, and the OKAY write/read pair that follows on the same address completed normally
|===


*Pass Criteria*: the OKAY path completes and is booked against the memory model, each injected error reaches the manager with the encoding it had on the SYS_OUT wire, the stored word is untouched by the errored accesses, and the following OKAY write/read pair completes normally. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-035-smc_remap_cla_test]]
===== 35 `smc_remap_cla_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_remap_cla_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI), `SmcJtagAxiAgent` (JTAG-AXI bench agent over the `tb_top` JTAG-AXI bridge)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: ALIAS_REMAP address translation, remap-table reset sweep, CLA window.

*Test Coverage*:

* **ALIAS_REMAP address translation** -- entry 0 is programmed (`REGION_START` / `REGION_END` / `REGION_ATTRS.offset|valid`) and a JTAG AXI write issued at the source address is observed **landing at the translated address** on the SYS_OUT responder (`tb_output_axi_last_addr`). The un-programmed identity case is the same-run positive control and the entry-disabled re-read is the same-run negative control, so "the remap moved the access" is distinguishable from "nothing happened".
* **SMC_MMODE_REMAP_0..7 / SMC_ALIAS_REMAP_0..7 / SMC_XVISOR_REMAP_0..7** -- the RDL reset content of every entry (`expected=` on every read, not merely an OKAY response), and per-entry decode: every register of each table holds a distinct pattern inside its writable field while the rest of the table holds theirs, reads it back exactly and is restored, so an aliased pair or an undecoded window answering OKAY with zeros fails the readback. The reset reads alone cannot make that distinction, since every entry of a table resets to the same value.
* **SMC_CLA_REG** -- the Cluster Local Aggregator window: an allow leg on real CLA registers (RDL reset values + a scratch write/readback) paired with the in-window-hole leg. Unallocated offsets inside the map complete OKAY with data 0; the five non-zero reset rows and the scratch write/readback distinguish a live aperture from a hole.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_remap_cla_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-RESET-SWEEP` |Named compare in `smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-CLA-WINDOW-ALLOW` |Named compare in `smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-CLA-WINDOW-DENY` |Unmapped in-window CLA offsets complete OKAY with data 0 (`smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`); the run fails if a hole returns an error or non-zero data
|`CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-IDENTITY` |Named compare in `smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-LANDING` |Named compare in `smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-OFF` |Named compare in `smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-REMAP-TABLE-CORESIDENT` |The 8 XVISOR ATTRS, 8 MMODE ATTRS and 24 ALIAS START/END/ATTRS registers each held a distinct pattern written before any of its table was read back, read it back exactly and read back the RDL reset after the restore write, every readback a scoreboard value compare (`smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`); an aliased pair or an OKAY-zero hole fails the first readback of the pair
|`CHK-REMAP-TABLE-RESET` |All 40 MMODE/ALIAS/XVISOR remap registers answer OKAY and match their generated RDL reset value in a scoreboard value compare (`smc_remap_cla_test_seq.py`)
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-RESET-SWEEP`, `CHK-CLA-WINDOW-ALLOW`, `CHK-CLA-WINDOW-DENY`, `CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-IDENTITY`, `CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-LANDING`, `CHK-REMAP-ALIAS0-OFF`, `CHK-REMAP-TABLE-CORESIDENT`, `CHK-REMAP-TABLE-RESET` hold after their compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

[[sec-179-smc_address_map_region_decode_test]]
===== 179 `smc_address_map_region_decode_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_address_map_region_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (no external VIP); `tb_axil_external_active`, a mirror of `smc_external_req_o`, sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge for the adopter external AXI-Lite window

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Every address-map region an inbound SEP_IN master can reach decodes at a base-side register and at the last register of its extent; three addresses no block declares are answered DECERR by the fabric error slave; the external window is proven at its own AXI-Lite port.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every expectation comes from the generated register map (`hw/sys/smc/regs/gen/py/smc_reg.py`) or from a co-resident write/readback pattern, never from a first read of the DUT. A region whose reset is zero throughout is proven by the co-resident pattern rather than by a 0 == 0 compare, because a dead or unmapped window commonly reads 0.
* The co-resident shape writes several addresses before any of them is read back, so a decode that collapses two windows onto one physical register returns a neighbour's pattern and fails the exact compare -- which a per-address write-then-read cannot see.
* Three addresses no generated-map block declares and no crossbar rule covers (past the watchdog cluster, past the DFX block, past the fabric-control block) are declared expected-error to the SEP_IN monitor and required to answer DECERR from the fabric error slave.
* The first word past the straps block in the external window (`SMC_TOP_SMC_EXTERNAL_MANDATORY_STRAPS_BASE_ADDR` plus `SMC_TOP_SMC_EXTERNAL_MANDATORY_STRAPS_SIZE` from the generated `smc_addr.h`) is claimed by no target of the window's demux. It must reach the external port and be answered DECERR there, and `STRAPS_LO`/`STRAPS_HI` must read the same on both sides of it.
* **Past a block's generated extent.** The crossbars decode each block to its generated `SIZE` or `TOTAL_SIZE` and send every other address to the error slave. A read and a write at the first word past `GPIO_INTF[64]` (`GPIO_INTF_TOTAL_SIZE`), and a write past misc_wrap (`SIZE`), must each be refused with an error response, and the last register before each must read the same afterwards.
* **Data-accelerator range.** The crossbar decodes the DMA block to `SMC_TOP_DMA_CTRL_SIZE` and the zeroer block to `SMC_TOP_ZEROER_CTRL_SIZE`, both cross-checked against the decoded extent of the generated memory map (`regs/gen/py/smc_memory_map.py`), whose RDL past-extent response (`ocah_past_extent_resp`) is DECERR for a read and a write. The first word past the DMA block (the gap below the zeroer, `0xC0038138` in the current map) and the first word past the zeroer block (`0xC0038218`) each take a read and an all-ones write, and each access must answer DECERR. Every DMA descriptor register and the zeroer's `DEST_ADDR` read 0 before and after, so a write that reached either block at any offset fails the readback.
* The 32-bit peripheral CSR blocks behind the AXI-Lite peripheral crossbar are read at their generated-map addresses, and 32-bit reads are required to return values with bits above 16 set, so the 32-bit data path is exercised beyond a 16-bit window.
* The regions SEP_IN cannot reach in this bench are named in the log and left open rather than claimed: the PLIC and CLINT/BEU windows lie outside the local and global apertures at the reset `REGION_SIZE` and answer DECERR (`smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test` reaches them after widening it), the generated map declares no register in the debug-module region, and the M-mode/Xvisor remap regions are outbound apertures with no inbound decode pinned by the specification.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_address_map_region_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer. The sequence sweeps every reachable region at its base side and at the top of its extent, probes the three beyond-region addresses and the four past-extent addresses, routes one access into the external window and one past its straps block, requires the scoreboard's exact-value compare count to have advanced by its floor, and prints the cell ledger. The leaf then re-checks the scoreboard compare count and books a protocol-VIP record with the sequence's measured access count against a stimulus floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ADDRESS-MAP-REGION` |The cell ledger. One line per coverage cell the sequence closed, naming the measured evidence that closed it, plus one line per cell left NOT closed in this bench with the reason. A cell is entered only after its own compare passed, and the ledger raises if no cell closed at all; the NOT-closed lines are recorded gaps, not compares
|`CHK-ADDRESS-MAP-REGION-DECODE` |Summary line: cells closed, the scoreboard exact-value compare count against its floor, the number of beyond-region DECERR probes, the external-port active cycles and the number of cells left open. Logged only once every per-region compare and the compare-count floor have held; it carries no compare of its own
|`CHK-ADDRESS-MAP-REGION-FLOOR` |The leaf requires the scoreboard's `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged, so a run whose stimulus stopped reaching the DUT fails instead of passing with a short sweep
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every region's generated-reset compare or co-resident readback holds, the three beyond-region addresses each answer DECERR, the external window accesses drive `smc_external_req_o` and the one past the straps block answers DECERR with the straps unchanged, the past-extent probes are refused (DECERR in the data-accelerator range) with their neighbouring registers unchanged, and the scoreboard books at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` exact-value compares. The cells named NOT closed are not part of the claim. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The regions SEP_IN cannot reach in this bench are named in the log as cells not closed and are not part of the claim: the PLIC and CLINT/BEU windows, which lie outside the local and global apertures at the reset `REGION_SIZE` and answer DECERR (`smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test` reaches them after widening it); the debug-module region, in which the generated map declares no register; and the M-mode/Xvisor remap regions, which are outbound apertures with no inbound decode pinned by the specification.

'''''

[[sec-180-smc_address_window_top_decode_test]]
===== 180 `smc_address_window_top_decode_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_address_window_top_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (no external VIP)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The last word of every SEP_IN-reachable window the RDL address map pins -- the aperture `smc.rdl` reserves for each unit (`ocah_aperture_size`), written by the register generator into the generated memory map -- answers, and answers from its own block: a window sized short bus-errors there and one sized long is answered by the next block. Where the map gives a unit an aperture larger than its decoded extent, the extent's last word is the top that must answer and the aperture's last word must be refused with the response the RDL gives an access past the decoded extent (`ocah_past_extent_resp`, DECERR).

*Test Coverage*:

* Every window top is derived from the generated memory map as data (`regs/gen/py/smc_memory_map.py`, the component view the register generator writes from the RDL address map) and `LOCAL_BASE` from the generated `SMC_BASE_CONFIG.LOCAL_BASE` reset; no window extent is hand-copied, and the DECERR expected past each decoded extent is the map's RDL `past_response`.
* Scratchpad memory: the first and the last 64-bit word of the 1 MiB `spm_memory` window hold distinct co-resident patterns and each reads back exactly, so the window reaches its last word without aliasing.
* Boot ROM: the last word of the 128 KiB `spm_rom_memory` window (the extent `rom.adoc` states) answers OKAY, returns neither resident scratchpad pattern, refuses a write with an error response, and still holds the same word afterwards -- which is what read-only means at this boundary. No specification pins the word an unprogrammed ROM offset holds, so that value is reported, not compared.
* DMA controller and memory zeroer: with distinct patterns resident in `DMA_CTRL.DST_ADDRESS_LO` and `ZEROER_CTRL.DEST_ADDR`, the last word of the 312 B `dma_ctrl` decoded extent and of the 24 B `zeroer_ctrl` decoded extent answers OKAY and returns neither pattern (an in-extent word without a register has no specified value, so it is reported, not compared), and the last word of the 512 B and 256 B apertures, past the decoded extent, is refused with DECERR. Both extents are cross-checked between the generated map and the generated `smc_addr.h` sizes.
* DMA stream banks: `NEXT_ID_1` through `NEXT_ID_15` each answer OKAY with exactly 0 as `dma.adoc` states for a reserved bank, each checked to sit at the 8-byte stream-bank stride from `NEXT_ID_0`. `NEXT_ID_0` is read last and for an OKAY response only, because reading it is the one access that launches a transfer. The reserved banks hold no writable state (`STATUS` and `DONE` are tied to 0 too), so this leg proves that every reserved bank address answers as specified and does not claim to tell one reserved bank from another.
* CLA: the trace-sink `TRDSTRAMIMPL` identification word, in the first 8 bytes of the 16 KiB `smc_cla` window, reads its generated reset, and the window's last 8-byte word -- the trace destination's `ScratchLo`/`ScratchHi` pair -- holds distinct co-resident patterns and reads them back.
* The miscellaneous wrapper's 2 KiB aperture carries a 524 B decoded extent and is driven the same way: the extent's last word answers OKAY (value reported) and the aperture's last word is refused with DECERR.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_address_window_top_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer, then let the leaf re-check the scoreboard's exact-value compare count and book a protocol-VIP record against a stimulus floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ADDRESS-WINDOW-TOP` |The cell ledger: one line per window top closed with the measured evidence. Cells are entered only after their compare passed; for the three apertures larger than their decoded extent the cell names both the extent top that answered and the aperture top that was refused
|`CHK-ADDRESS-WINDOW-TOP-DECODE` |Summary line: window tops closed, the scoreboard exact-value compare count against its floor, the access count, and how many apertures were driven at both tops. Logged after the per-window compares and the floor have held
|`CHK-ADDRESS-WINDOW-TOP-FLOOR` |The leaf requires `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every closed window top answered OKAY; the scratchpad, CLA and stream-bank tops matched their co-resident pattern, generated reset or specified 0 exactly; the ROM, DMA, zeroer and miscellaneous-wrapper extent tops returned neither resident pattern and have no specified value to compare; the DMA, zeroer and miscellaneous-wrapper aperture tops were refused with DECERR; the ROM write was refused and left the word unchanged; and the scoreboard booked at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The word read at the ROM, DMA, zeroer and miscellaneous-wrapper extent tops is reported and not compared, because no specification pins the word an unprogrammed ROM offset holds or the value of an in-extent word without a register; those tops are held only to answering OKAY and returning neither resident pattern. The stream-bank leg does not claim to tell one reserved bank from another, since the reserved banks hold no writable state.

'''''

[[sec-181-smc_alias_remap_spare_block_decode_test]]
===== 181 `smc_alias_remap_spare_block_decode_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_alias_remap_spare_block_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (no external VIP)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: `LOCAL_BASE` reaches the SMC's own resources through the alias remap's reset setting, and the ends of the eight-entry alias-remap array, the two spare register blocks and the four end mailbox halves each decode as separate storage.

*Test Coverage*:

* The first access of the run is a read at `LOCAL_BASE` itself -- the core-0 watchdog `CTRL` sits at window offset 0 -- taken before anything is written to the remap block, so the same access carries both the local-alias claim and the transparent-at-reset claim. `CMP` in the same block carries a non-zero generated reset, which is what makes the offset-0 read decode evidence rather than a 0 == 0 compare.
* Alias-remap regions 0 and 7, the ends of the array, are checked to sit at the chapter's 0x20 stride, configured with distinct co-resident `REGION_START` values and restored to the generated reset, so a decoder that collapses the eight instances onto one fails the readback.
* Spare blocks: the scratch word holds an all-ones pattern and reads it back exactly, so all 32 bits are storage; the chip-config block is written and must still read its generated reset, because every `chip_config.rdl` field is `sw = r`.
* Mailbox: the two halves of pair 0 and of pair 31 hold four distinct co-resident `IRQEN` patterns at once, then read back 0. The offset of each half inside a pair comes from the generated map.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_alias_remap_spare_block_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer, then let the leaf re-check the scoreboard's exact-value compare count and book a protocol-VIP record against a stimulus floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ALIAS-REMAP-SPARE-BLOCK` |The cell ledger: one line per cell closed with the measured evidence behind it. A cell is entered only after its compare passed, and the ledger raises if no cell closed
|`CHK-ALIAS-REMAP-SPARE-BLOCK-DECODE` |Summary line: cells closed, accesses issued and the scoreboard exact-value compare count against its floor, naming the `LOCAL_BASE` read taken before any remap write, the two alias-array ends, the two spare blocks and the four mailbox halves. Logged after those compares and the floor have held
|`CHK-ALIAS-REMAP-SPARE-BLOCK-FLOOR` |The leaf requires `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged
|===

*Pass Criteria*: the `LOCAL_BASE` and `CMP` reads match the generated resets, every co-resident pattern reads back exactly and every register is restored, the chip-config write leaves the register at its reset, and the scoreboard books at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.

'''''

[[sec-185-smc_dual_base_addressing_test]]
===== 185 `smc_dual_base_addressing_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_dual_base_addressing_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (no external VIP)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: `LOCAL_BASE` is fixed read-only at 0xC000_0000 and keeps that value across a write attempt, `GLOBAL_BASE` in the same block takes and returns a pattern through the identical write path, and `REGION_SIZE` reads its specified 16 MiB reset.

*Test Coverage*:

* The three expectations are the sentences of `memmap.adoc` (Memory Map); nothing is read back from the DUT to form them.
* The write-has-no-effect leg has a positive control in the same register block: `GLOBAL_BASE`, the programmable sibling, is written and read back through the same path, so a dropped `LOCAL_BASE` write is attributable to the read-only attribute and not to a dead write channel. The control is checked not to already hold the probe pattern, and `GLOBAL_BASE` is restored to the value read at entry.
* `LOCAL_BASE` is written last, so a DUT that wrongly accepted the write fails its own readback rather than silently re-basing every later access of the run.
* While `GLOBAL_BASE` holds the pattern, `LOCAL_BASE` is read at its global address, the pattern plus its offset. `fabric.adoc` (Local and Remote Resource Access) lets a local resource be addressed through either its global address or its local alias, so the read reaches the register with address bit 31 clear. The same address is read first, while `GLOBAL_BASE` still holds its reset value; it then lies in neither aperture and must answer DECERR from the fabric error slave (`fabric.adoc`, Traffic Subordinates), so a decoder that answered the offset whatever `GLOBAL_BASE` held fails.
* `smc_region_size_o` is unconnected in `tb_top`, so the pin-side effect of `REGION_SIZE` is not claimed here.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dual_base_addressing_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer: read `REGION_SIZE` and `LOCAL_BASE` against their specified values, save `GLOBAL_BASE`, read the global-window address and require DECERR, prove the write path on `GLOBAL_BASE` and read `LOCAL_BASE` through the global window it now sets, then attempt the `LOCAL_BASE` write and require the register to still read 0xC000_0000. The leaf re-checks the scoreboard compare count and books a protocol-VIP record against a stimulus floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DUAL-BASE` |The cell ledger: `local-base-reads-c0000000`, `local-resource-via-global-address` (DECERR before `GLOBAL_BASE` is programmed, `LOCAL_BASE` after) and `local-base-write-has-no-effect`, each with the measured evidence behind it, including the `GLOBAL_BASE` write that serves as the positive control
|`CHK-DUAL-BASE-ADDRESSING` |Summary line: the `LOCAL_BASE` value across the write attempt, the `GLOBAL_BASE` save/pattern/restore sequence and the `REGION_SIZE` reset. Logged after those compares and the stimulus floor have held
|`CHK-DUAL-BASE-FLOOR` |The leaf requires the scoreboard's `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `REGION_SIZE` reads the specified 16 MiB reset, `LOCAL_BASE` reads 0xC000_0000 before and after the write attempt and through the global window once `GLOBAL_BASE` is programmed, that address answers DECERR before it, `GLOBAL_BASE` returns the probe pattern and then the restored value, and the scoreboard books at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The pin-side effect of `REGION_SIZE` is not claimed, because `smc_region_size_o` is unconnected in the bench.

'''''


[[sec-190-smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test]]
===== 190 `smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (no external VIP)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: With `REGION_SIZE` programmed to 256 MiB the PLIC, the CLINT and the four bus error units decode at the addresses the chapters give them; at the 16 MiB reset those addresses lie outside the local and global apertures, and an inbound access there answers DECERR.

*Test Coverage*:

* `REGION_SIZE` reads its generated reset and `WDT0.CMP` inside the reset aperture reads its generated reset. The PLIC priority word at the same window offset is read above the reset aperture and must answer DECERR; the address is declared an expected DECERR to the SEP_IN monitor. The proof that the aperture widened is the PLIC, CLINT and BEU legs themselves: co-resident patterns and generated resets at addresses that are outside the aperture at reset.
* 256 MiB is the smallest legal power of two whose aperture contains the whole documented map up to BASE + 0x801_3FFF; the sequence asserts that relation against the generated reset size rather than hard-coding a verdict.
* PLIC: the priority and per-core enable words hold distinct co-resident patterns, are then written to the priority-0 / disabled state `interrupts.adoc` requires of firmware and read back exactly; the last word of the PLIC's decoded extent (generated memory map `regs/gen/py/smc_memory_map.py`, cross-checked against the generated `smc_addr.h` size) must answer without returning either pattern, and the top word of the 4 MiB window and the first word above it, both past the decoded extent, must be refused with DECERR, the response the RDL gives an access past a unit's decoded extent (`ocah_past_extent_resp`).
* CLINT: `MSIP_0` and `MTIMECMP_0` hold distinct co-resident patterns; the last word of the 48 KiB decoded extent must not return them, and the top word of the 64 KiB aperture must be refused.
* BEU: the four `ENABLE` registers read their generated reset, are each checked against the specified 0x1000 stride, and then hold four distinct co-resident patterns, so the per-core instances are proven separate registers rather than one alias; the last word of core 3's decoded extent answers and the top word of the 80 KiB timer / bus-error region, past it, is refused.
* `REGION_SIZE` is restored to its generated reset and a local-window register is read afterwards, so the aperture is left as the rest of the suite expects.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_region_size_plic_clint_beu_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer: read `REGION_SIZE` and a local-window register at reset and record what the PLIC word answers above the aperture, widen `REGION_SIZE`, drive the PLIC, its window edges, the CLINT and the four BEUs, restore `REGION_SIZE` and re-read a local-window register, then require the exact-value compare floor and print the cell ledger. The leaf re-checks the scoreboard compare count and books a protocol-VIP record.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-REGION-SIZE-PLIC-CLINT-BEU` |The cell ledger: one line per cell closed with the measured evidence -- the reset-aperture reads with the recorded above-aperture answer, the PLIC base, edge and firmware-init cells, the CLINT base and top, and the four BEU instances. A cell is entered only after its compare passed
|`CHK-REGION-SIZE-PLIC-CLINT-BEU-DECODE` |Summary line: the DECERR and word the PLIC address gave above the reset aperture, the word it gave at 256 MiB, cells closed, accesses issued and the scoreboard exact-value compare count against its floor. Logged after those compares and the floor have held
|`CHK-REGION-SIZE-PLIC-CLINT-BEU-FLOOR` |The leaf requires the scoreboard's `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `REGION_SIZE` and `WDT0.CMP` read their generated resets at the reset aperture, every PLIC, CLINT and BEU co-resident pattern reads back exactly at 256 MiB, the decoded-extent tops answer without returning a resident pattern, the aperture tops past those extents are refused with DECERR, `REGION_SIZE` is restored and the local-window register reads its reset afterwards, and the scoreboard books at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The word the PLIC address returns above the reset aperture is recorded; that access is held to answering DECERR.

'''''

[[sec-192-smc_sys_axi_in_port_test]]
===== 192 `smc_sys_axi_in_port_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_sys_axi_in_port_test`

*BFM / Model*: the SEP_IN AXI driver for the filter programming and the readbacks, plus the SYS_IN AXI agent (`sys_in_axi_agent`) driving `sys_axi_in_req_i`

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Once inbound filter entry 0 admits, `sys_axi_in` carries a read of a register with a non-zero generated reset and a write whose value both ports read back.

*Test Coverage*:

* Inbound entry 0 is programmed over SEP_IN with the pass-all recipe the output-fabric tests use, its config word is read back exactly, and all three of its registers are restored to their generated resets with a further config readback at the end.
* The SYS_IN read compares against the generated reset of `CHIP_CONFIG.VERSION_LO`, which is non-zero, so the compare distinguishes a decoded read from a window that answers 0.
* The scratch word written over SYS_IN is read back over SEP_IN and then over SYS_IN, so the same storage is shown reachable from the system port and from SEP_IN; the scratch register is restored to 0 with a readback.
* The access counts are the measured ones, not declarations: the sequence requires its own SEP_IN count to equal exactly the expected number and requires the scoreboard's completed SYS_IN AXI count to equal exactly four.
* The pre-admit SYS_IN read is issued with the error response tolerated and its response is reported, not asserted: the specification leaves the reset state of the sixteen inbound entries to the chiplet integration, so no verdict is claimed on it.
* The inbound filter decides each direction from its own request, with block-by-default when nothing matches, so the write and read channels of the port are driven together: four interleaved passes go out as one outstanding group, SEP_IN seeds the read sources and reads the write targets back, and the filter is observed admitting both directions in the same cycle.
* Every inbound port of this bench carries an agent, so the "unused port tied idle" cell cannot be driven here.
* Through the admitted entry a 2-beat and a 16-beat INCR burst of full-width beats are written into the SPM and each read back in order as one burst, and a read of the last unmapped page below `mmode_region`, must answer DECERR, so the port carries bursts and decode errors, not only single-beat register accesses.
* The write channel of the unimplemented region answers DECERR too; with GPIO0 ACCESS_FILTER armed over SEP_IN, an unprivileged `sys_axi_in` write is refused with an error response (reported) and took no effect, and an unprivileged read answers DECERR with the error-slave signature, and a read of the empty inbound mailbox answers SLVERR. Three passes of outstanding writes and then of reads over the eight scratch registers under a 64-cycle BREADY/RREADY hold stall the port's response channels and, with that many addresses queued, its address channels, measured per channel, and every read still returns the word its last write carried.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_sys_axi_in_port_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer, with the SYS_IN accesses issued as one-shots on the SYS_IN sequencer: pre-admit read, program and read back entry 0, SYS_IN read of `VERSION_LO`, SYS_IN scratch write, SEP_IN and SYS_IN readbacks, the interleaved write/read group over `sys_axi_in` with its seeds, readbacks and restores under a clocked observer on the filter decision, restore the scratch word and the filter entry, then require both access counts exactly. The leaf requires both SYS_IN read values to have been captured and books a protocol-VIP record carrying the measured SEP_IN and SYS_IN counts against their floors.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-READ` |After entry 0 admitted the whole address range, a `sys_axi_in` read of `CHIP_CONFIG.VERSION_LO` returned its non-zero generated reset exactly. The pre-admit response at the same address is printed on the same line as reported, not asserted
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-WRITE` |A `sys_axi_in` write of the scratch pattern was read back exactly over SEP_IN and over `sys_axi_in`, and the scoreboard had completed exactly the expected number of SYS_IN and SEP_IN accesses
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-NOT-CLOSED` |A recorded gap, not a compare: the unused-port-tied-idle cell, with the reason -- every inbound port of this bench carries an agent and none is tied to zero. Logged unconditionally
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-PORT` |Ledger line in the leaf: the SYS_IN read value, the scratch readback and the SEP_IN access count, logged after the leaf requires both SYS_IN reads to have been captured. The compares are the sequence's and the scoreboard's
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-BACKPRESSURE` |The BREADY/RREADY hold stalled the B and R channels for a non-zero number of cycles, measured by the sequence, and every read of the outstanding group is an exact scoreboard compare
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-ERRORS` |The unimplemented-region write and the refused filter read are compared against DECERR, the refused read against the error-slave signature, the refused write against an error response, the empty-mailbox read against SLVERR, and the armed filter reads back unchanged
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-BURST` |The AxLEN=1 and AxLEN=15 INCR bursts written over `sys_axi_in` read back as exact scoreboard compares, and the unimplemented-region read is compared against DECERR by the sequence; the run fails if either mismatches
|`CHK-SYS-AXI-IN-DUPLEX` |The interleaved write/read group over `sys_axi_in`: every read returned the word SEP_IN seeded and the write targets held the last pass, and the inbound filter was observed admitting both directions in at least one cycle -- both filter hits set with neither isolate -- so a run whose two channels never overlapped fails
|===

*Pass Criteria*: the admitted `sys_axi_in` read matches the generated reset, the scratch write reads back exactly over both ports, the filter entry and the scratch register are restored, and the measured SEP_IN and SYS_IN access counts equal the expected ones. The pre-admit response and the tied-idle cell are recorded, not claimed, the write-channel error responses and the backpressure stalls hold. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The response of the pre-admit SYS_IN read is reported, not asserted, because the specification leaves the reset state of the sixteen inbound entries to the chiplet integration, so no verdict is claimed on it. The unused-port-tied-idle cell is recorded as a gap, not a compare, because every inbound port of this bench carries an agent. The error response of the refused unprivileged `sys_axi_in` write is reported; it is held only to being an error response that took no effect.

'''''


[[sec-194-smc_sep_in_axi_shape_test]]
===== 194 `smc_sep_in_axi_shape_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_sep_in_axi_shape_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (`ocah_axi_vip` AXI4 master), no external VIP

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The transfer shapes the 64-to-32-bit conversion chain on the SEP_IN path has to resolve: narrow AxSIZE with byte strobes, a multi-beat INCR burst, and the FIXED and WRAP burst types the path refuses.

*Test Coverage*:

* AxSIZE below the bus width is a narrow transfer whose byte strobes select the lanes. A one-byte write at offset 0 and a two-byte write at offset 2 must each leave the rest of the word alone, so the readback is the merge of the three writes and not any one of them.
* Narrow reads return the addressed lanes of the same word, so the strobe placement is shown on both directions.
* An AxLEN=1 INCR burst is split into consecutive single-beat accesses: the two beats land in two consecutive scratch registers, are read back individually and again as one two-beat burst read, so a beat dropped, merged or reordered fails an exact compare.
* FIXED and WRAP multi-beat bursts: `fabric.adoc` does not state how the SEP_IN path answers a burst type it does not support, so the expectation is the DV-owned one for a refused write -- an AXI error response of either kind, never OKAY and never a wedge -- and both target registers, read back right after each burst and before any further write, must still hold the values the INCR burst left, so a path that errored the response while still writing is caught. The error code returned is reported, not asserted, because `fabric.adoc` fixes no response for an unsupported burst type.
* A 16-beat INCR burst of full-width beats into the SPM: every beat lands at its own address, read back at both ends and as one 16-beat read, so a splitter that drops, repeats or reorders beats past the first few is caught. A 2-beat FIXED burst of full-width beats to the scratch registers carries the words they already hold, so whether the path stores or refuses it the readbacks still test the INCR result; its response is reported, not asserted.
* The same two burst types at the other beat sizes a 64-bit manager may issue: two-beat FIXED and WRAP bursts of one-byte and two-byte beats, and a two-beat WRAP of eight-byte beats, each aligned for WRAP. A refused one must leave both scratch registers as the INCR burst left them; one the path accepts is reported and the registers re-seeded. Each response is reported.
* A write to the last unmapped page below `mmode_region`, must answer DECERR, so the write channel of the error slave is shown on SEP_IN as the read channel already is.
* Both scratch registers are restored to zero before the sequence ends.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_sep_in_axi_shape_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer: seed a scratch word, overwrite one byte and then one half of it with narrow writes and read the merge back, read the same lanes narrowly, place a two-beat INCR burst across two scratch registers and read it back per register and as one burst, issue the FIXED and the WRAP burst and require an error response with both registers read back unchanged after each, then restore both registers. The leaf requires the scoreboard's exact-value compare count to have reached its floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SEP-IN-NARROW-STROBES` |The seeded word, the word after the one-byte write and the word after the two-byte write are exact scoreboard compares, as are the narrow reads of the same lanes; a strobe the fabric ignored or widened fails one of them
|`CHK-SEP-IN-BURST-INCR` |The two beats of the AxLEN=1 INCR write are read back from their own registers and again as one AxLEN=1 read, all exact compares
|`CHK-SEP-IN-BURST-UNSUPPORTED` |The FIXED and the WRAP burst each answered an AXI error response -- the scoreboard fails an OKAY or a timed-out access marked expect-error -- and both registers, read back right after each burst, still held the values the INCR burst left; each FIXED or WRAP burst at the other beat sizes that answered an error left both registers unchanged, as exact compares; the error codes are reported, not asserted
|`CHK-SEP-IN-DECERR-WRITE` |The write to the unimplemented page is compared against DECERR by the sequence; the run fails if it mismatches
|`CHK-SEP-IN-BURST-LONG` |The first and last beat of the AxLEN=15 INCR write are read back from their own SPM addresses and the AxLEN=15 read returns every beat in order, all as exact scoreboard compares; the response of the 8-byte FIXED burst is reported
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every narrow and burst readback matches its exact expectation, the two rejected burst types answer an error response without changing either register, the 16-beat burst reads back in order, and the scoreboard books at least the expected number of value compares, the unimplemented-page write answers DECERR. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The error code returned to the refused FIXED and WRAP bursts is reported, not asserted, because `fabric.adoc` fixes no response for an unsupported burst type; those bursts are held to an AXI error response of either kind with both registers unchanged. The response of the 2-beat full-width FIXED burst and of each FIXED or WRAP burst at the other beat sizes is reported, and a burst the path accepts is reported with the registers re-seeded.

'''''

[[sec-195-smc_sep_in_axi_flow_control_test]]
===== 195 `smc_sep_in_axi_flow_control_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_sep_in_axi_flow_control_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (`ocah_axi_vip` AXI4 master) with a per-access `AxiTimingProfile` holding the response channels back

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: With several SEP_IN transactions outstanding and the manager holding BREADY and RREADY low, every access is still answered with the data of the address it was issued for, and the design keeps its response channels stable across the wait.

*Test Coverage*:

* AMBA IHI 0022 A3.2.1: a transfer completes only when VALID and READY are both asserted, VALID may not be withdrawn before that, and the channel's payload stays stable across the wait. B and R are driven by the design, so their stability under the manager's backpressure is the design's obligation and is sampled every cycle the manager holds READY low.
* Three write passes over the eight scratch registers go out as one outstanding group with BREADY held, each pass carrying its own word, so the individual readbacks also show that writes to one address took effect in the order they were issued.
* Four read passes over the same registers go out as one outstanding group with RREADY held, each compared against that address's word, so an access that was dropped, merged, reordered or mis-routed returns the wrong word.
* The stalled-cycle counts are asserted non-zero for all four channels. They are the measurement that the backpressure happened, not the claim: a run whose timing profile stopped reaching the bus fails rather than passing on traffic that never stalled.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_sep_in_axi_flow_control_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer with a clocked observer on the SEP_IN handshake lines: issue the write group under a BREADY hold, read each register back individually, issue the read group under an RREADY hold, restore the registers, then require the observer's violation list to be empty and every channel to have stalled at least once. The leaf requires the scoreboard's exact-value compare count to have reached its floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SEP-IN-FLOW-CONTROL` |Every outstanding write and read completed with the word of the address it named -- the individual readbacks show the last write pass to each address, the read group repeats the same expectation from deeper in the pipeline -- and every one of the four channels was observed stalled at least once
|`CHK-SEP-IN-RESP-STABLE` |Across every cycle in which the manager held BREADY or RREADY low, BVALID and RVALID stayed asserted and BRESP/BID and RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID did not change. A withdrawn VALID or a changed payload is recorded and fails the run
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every access in both outstanding groups returns its own address's word, no response channel withdrew VALID or moved its payload while READY was low, all four channels stalled at least once, and the scoreboard books at least the expected number of value compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.

'''''

[[sec-196-smc_axil_downstream_concurrency_test]]
===== 196 `smc_axil_downstream_concurrency_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_axil_downstream_concurrency_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver (`ocah_axi_vip` AXI4 master); the eFuse-bank window is backed by the eFuse-bank model and the mandatory external window by the reference integration's AXI-Lite error slave

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/axil.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`, `axil`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `axil`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The three downstream AXI-Lite manager ports are independent branches: with accesses to two of the windows outstanding at once, both ports are active in the same cycle and each access is answered by its own window.

*Test Coverage*:

* The two windows answer differently in both response code and data -- the eFuse shim register with OKAY and its generated reset, the mandatory external window with the terminator's DECERR and the error-slave word 0xBADCAB1E -- so a crossed route fails on the response code and on the data rather than only on a count.
* The eFuse half is compared by the scoreboard against the generated reset; the external half is required to carry the terminator's 0xBADCAB1E, which a neighbouring responder answering in its place would not.
* The cycles in which two of the three activity probes were high together are counted and required to be non-zero, so a group the fabric serialised after all fails instead of passing.
* The SEP_IN monitor attributes a response beat to the last address it saw accepted, which cannot name the transaction while two reads are outstanding; both addresses of the group are registered with it for that reason, and the per-access verdict is the scoreboard's exact expected response code.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_axil_downstream_concurrency_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer with a clocked observer on the three downstream activity probes: issue sixteen eFuse-shim reads alternated with sixteen external-window reads as one outstanding group, then require each external read to carry 0xBADCAB1E, each eFuse read to have answered OKAY, and at least one cycle with two ports active together. The leaf requires the scoreboard's exact-value compare count to have reached its floor.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-AXIL-DOWNSTREAM-CONCURRENCY` |Every eFuse-shim read answered OKAY with the generated reset and every external-window read answered DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E while both accesses were outstanding together, and two downstream manager ports were observed active in the same cycle at least once. The per-probe active-cycle counts are printed on the same line as reported, not asserted
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every access is answered by its own window with that window's response code and data, at least one cycle had two downstream manager ports active together, and the scoreboard books at least the expected number of value compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`, `axil`.

*Scope limit*: The per-probe active-cycle counts are printed as reported, not asserted; the compare is that at least one cycle had two downstream manager ports active together.

'''''


[[sec-188-smc_peripheral_instance_decode_test]]
===== 188 `smc_peripheral_instance_decode_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_peripheral_instance_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN AXI driver; `tb_axil_external_active` sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge for the PVT wrapper access, which the bench PVT model answers OKAY with zero data

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Every peripheral block the generated map declares reads a register with a non-zero generated reset, every multi-instance peripheral is proven at its first and last instance, and the PVT wrapper is proven at the adopter external port.

*Test Coverage*:

* Single-instance blocks are closed by a register whose generated reset is non-zero, so the compare can tell a decoded block from an absent window that reads 0.
* Multi-instance peripherals are additionally proven with distinct patterns written to all probed instances before any is read back, so a stride that aliases two instances returns a neighbour's pattern and fails: the I3C CSR windows, the GPIO interfaces, the mailbox pairs and the log engines at their first and last instance, and the four watchdogs (`CMP` through the `KEY` unlock, one key write per register write), the three I2C controllers (`TARGET_ID`), the four UARTs (`SCR`) and the three telemetry receivers (`INTR_ENABLE`) at every instance. A reset read alone cannot tell N registers from one aliased register or from an undecoded window answering OKAY with the reset word, so every multi-instance block carries a co-resident leg.
* The PVT wrapper is proven at its consumer: `smc_external_req_o` must present a read request carrying the probed address while the access is in flight, not merely complete.
* The fabric refuses an address inside a unit's aperture but past its decoded extent (`memmap.adoc`, Address Space Organization). A read and a write past the core 0 watchdog's 36-byte extent and past `smc_cpu_ctrl`'s 704-byte extent must each answer an error, and the watchdog's `CMP` must keep its reset value across them; the error code is not asserted, since no document fixes it.
* Left open and named, not claimed: the DTP control window (`tb_top` leaves its AXI-Lite response idle, so an access there would never complete) and the bus error units (outside the local and global apertures at the reset `REGION_SIZE`, where SEP_IN accesses answer DECERR).

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_peripheral_instance_decode_test_seq` on the SEP_IN AXI sequencer: sweep the I3C, GPIO, mailbox, watchdog and log-engine instances, then the single-instance blocks with the I2C, UART and telemetry co-resident legs, then route the PVT access; name the two unreachable cells, require the exact-value compare count and the access count to have reached their floors, and print the cell ledger. The leaf re-checks the scoreboard compare count and books a protocol-VIP record.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-PERIPHERAL-INSTANCE` |The cell ledger: one line per block or instance cell closed with the measured evidence behind it, including `past-decoded-extent-refused`, plus one line per cell left NOT closed in this bench with the tie-off or aperture limit that prevents it. The NOT-closed lines are recorded gaps, not compares
|`CHK-PERIPHERAL-INSTANCE-DECODE` |Summary line: cells closed, the scoreboard exact-value compare count against its floor, the access count, the PVT external-port active cycles and the number of cells left open. Logged after the per-block compares and both floors have held
|`CHK-PERIPHERAL-INSTANCE-FLOOR` |The leaf requires the scoreboard's `sys_axi_value_checks_seen` to have reached `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` before this token is logged
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every probed block matches its non-zero generated reset, every probed instance returns its own co-resident pattern, the PVT access drives the external port, and the scoreboard books at least `EXPECTED_VALUE_CHECKS` compares. The DTP window and the bus error units are recorded as not closed. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The error code of the read and write past the core 0 watchdog's and `smc_cpu_ctrl`'s decoded extents is not asserted, since no document fixes it; each is held only to answering an error with `CMP` unchanged.
