|`CHK-OUT-NS0-EQUALITY` |An `allow_ns` 0 deny entry refuses the prot 0 write (DECERR, sentinel kept,
write count unchanged) and lets the prot 0b010 write pass (OKAY, landed)
|`CHK-OUT-NS1-EQUALITY` |An `allow_ns` 1 deny entry refuses the prot 0b010 write and lets the prot 0
write pass, landed
|`CHK-OUT-NS-FALLTHROUGH` |The prot 0b010 write does not select permit entry 1, falls through to
deny entry 2 and is DECERR, and the prot 0 write matches entry 1 and lands
|`CHK-OUT-PROT-BITS-IGNORED` |Writes with prot 0, 1, 4 and 5 are DECERR and writes with prot 2, 3, 6
and 7 are OKAY and land, each landed write presenting its driven `awprot` at the SYS_OUT AW
handshake
|`CHK-OUT-BURST0-SINGLE-ONLY` |With `allow_burst` 0 the single-beat write is DECERR and the 2-beat
write is OKAY with both beats landed and `awlen` 1
|`CHK-OUT-BURST1-BOTH` |With `allow_burst` 1 both the single-beat write and the 2-beat write are
DECERR with the sentinels kept
|`CHK-OUT-BURST-FALLTHROUGH` |The 2-beat write that the `allow_burst` 0 entry 1 does not select is
matched by the `allow_burst` 1 entry 2 and is DECERR
|`CHK-OUT-SRCID-WILDCARD` |The M-mode and Xvisor window writes land with the deny entries disabled;
`src_id` 0 deny entries then refuse the writes on the direct, the M-mode remap and the Xvisor remap
paths, all three DECERR with their three sentinels kept
|`CHK-OUT-GROUPID-INERT` |An entry with `group_id` 7 still matches: the write at 0x0200_B800 is
DECERR with the sentinel kept
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The step stamps S1 to S9 are recorded in order with strictly increasing time, each
checker line is printed after its step in the fixed order, the fence terms NS_LEGS to RESTORED are
in order, and the SEP_IN and JTAG access counts reach 90 and exactly 23; a control-flow invariant,
not a DUT compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |One entry per bounded wait the run took -- fuse-sense, JTAG and SEP_IN access
bounds, the 64-cycle write-count hold and the 200-cycle responder poll; the compares are the bounded
waits themselves, so an expired bound raises before this line
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-OUT-NS0-EQUALITY`, `CHK-OUT-NS1-EQUALITY`, `CHK-OUT-NS-FALLTHROUGH`,
`CHK-OUT-PROT-BITS-IGNORED`, `CHK-OUT-BURST0-SINGLE-ONLY`, `CHK-OUT-BURST1-BOTH`,
`CHK-OUT-BURST-FALLTHROUGH`, `CHK-OUT-SRCID-WILDCARD` and `CHK-OUT-GROUPID-INERT` hold: every
matched write is DECERR with its sentinel kept, the write count unchanged and no SYS_OUT AW or W
valid, and every unmatched write is OKAY, lands each beat and presents its driven `awprot` and
`awlen`. `CHK-NONVAC` and `CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` are printed after both access floors. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.

'''''

[[sec-369-smc_outfilt_deny_concurrency_test]]
===== 369 `smc_outfilt_deny_concurrency_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_outfilt_deny_concurrency_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, JTAG) for the denied and control reads and writes, the 40-write
flood and the 12-write reconfiguration group (each group under an `AxiTimingProfile` with
`b_ready_delay` 64), and `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, SEP_IN) for programming outbound entries 1 to 4 and
the DMA registers; the SMC DMA (`CONFIG`, `NEXT_ID_0`, `DONE_0`, `STATUS_0`, source, destination,
length, stride and repetition registers); SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem` backdoor, sentinel
preset, DMA source payload 0x1122_3344_5566_7788 at 0x0200_0000) and the `tb_top` probes
`tb_output_axi_write_count`, `tb_output_axi_read_count`, `tb_output_axi_awvalid`,
`tb_output_axi_wvalid` and `tb_output_axi_arvalid`, with the three valids counted at every
`clk_smc_i` rise; JTAG channel signals `jtag_axi_awvalid`, `jtag_axi_awready`, `jtag_axi_bvalid`,
`jtag_axi_bready`, `jtag_axi_rvalid`, `jtag_axi_rready` and `jtag_axi_rresp`; `tb_fuse_sense_done`,
`tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` after the fuse-sense wait

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Denied outbound reads and writes answer DECERR on every
response beat without reaching SYS_OUT, many denials stay outstanding together, an admitted DMA job
completes alongside a denial, and an entry reprogrammed under load never reverses.

*Test Coverage*:

* `index.adoc` (Blocked Transactions): a blocked transaction is steered to the error subordinate and
terminates with DECERR on `BRESP` or `RRESP`. With deny entry 1 over 0x0200_2000..0x0200_2FFF a JTAG
single-beat read and a 4-beat read answer DECERR on every R beat, the SYS_OUT read count does not
advance and `tb_output_axi_arvalid` stays low for 64 `clk_smc_i` cycles; the read data is printed,
not compared. A control read outside the range at 0x0200_3000 is OKAY, returns
0x0123_4567_89AB_CDEF, raises the read count by one and raises `arvalid`.
* The three denial classes (`fabric.adoc` Outbound Filtering, `index.adoc` Match Then Permit): a
write at 0x0200_2400 refused by a clear permission, a prot 2 write at 0x0200_4100 refused by an
`allow_ns` 1 entry 2, and a 4-beat write at 0x0200_6000 not selected by the `allow_burst` 0 entry 3
and refused by the `allow_burst` 1 entry 4. Each is DECERR, keeps its sentinels, holds the SYS_OUT
write count for 64 cycles and raises no SYS_OUT AW or W valid.
* `fabric.adoc` (Outbound Filtering; transaction-limit table): the outbound filter permits unmatched
traffic, so every denial needs a matching entry, and each error subordinate holds 32 outstanding
transactions. Forty denied 8-byte writes over 0x0200_8000..0x0200_8FFF are issued as one outstanding
group under a delayed `bready`; all forty are DECERR, all forty sentinels are kept and the write
count does not move. The peak of AW minus B handshakes on the JTAG channel is printed, not compared.
* `dma.adoc` (Transfer Configuration, `NEXT_ID_0`, `DONE_0`): a linear DMA copy of 8 bytes from
0x0200_0000 to 0x0200_A000 is submitted by reading `NEXT_ID_0` with `CONFIG.ENABLED_ND` set and one
repetition, a denied JTAG write at 0x0200_8800 is issued meanwhile, and `DONE_0` must rise above its
baseline within 50 polls of 20 cycles. The DMA payload lands at the destination, which no deny entry
covers, and the denied word keeps its sentinel.
* Reconfiguration under load: with permit entry 1 over 0x0200_C000..0x0200_CFFF and twelve JTAG
writes outstanding, a SEP_IN write turns entry 1 into a deny entry. The documents do not say from
which point the new entry governs transactions already in flight, so the leaf
requires only consistency: the responses in issue order are OKAY then DECERR with at most one
transition, the SYS_OUT write count rises by the number of OKAY responses, each OKAY landed its word
and each DECERR kept its sentinel, and the entry reads back as the deny word.
* Entries 1 to 4 and the DMA `CONFIG` return to the values they had at the start.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for `tb_fuse_sense_done` (200000 `clk_smc_i` cycles bound), require the three fuse and reset
probes resolvable and start the watcher on the SYS_OUT valids and the JTAG channel handshakes.
. Read `FILTER_CONFIG` of outbound entries 1 to 4 (reset word, not enabled) and the DMA `CONFIG`,
preset the sentinel 0x5A5A_5A5A_5A5A_5A5A at the probe addresses, the DMA payload at 0x0200_0000 and
the control word at 0x0200_3000, and read the sentinels back.
. Error injection. Point: outbound deny entry 1 (0x0000_0000_0100_0010) over
0x0200_2000..0x0200_2FFF. Kind: a single-beat JTAG read at 0x0200_2100 and a 4-beat read at
0x0200_2200 through the deny entry. Expected response: DECERR on every R beat, with the SYS_OUT read
count and `arvalid` unchanged for 64 cycles. Then JTAG-read 0x0200_3000 outside the range and
compare it with the control word.
. Error injection. Point: outbound deny entry 1, the `allow_ns` 1 deny entry 2 over
0x0200_4000..0x0200_4FFF, and the `allow_burst` 0 deny entry 3 over 0x0200_6000..0x0200_6007 below
the `allow_burst` 1 deny entry 4 over 0x0200_6000..0x0200_6FFF. Kind: a JTAG write at 0x0200_2400
refused by a clear permission, a prot 2 write at 0x0200_4100 refused by `allow_ns`, and a 4-beat
write at 0x0200_6000 that entry 3 does not select and entry 4 refuses. Expected response: each
DECERR with sentinels kept.
. Error injection. Point: outbound deny entry 1 over 0x0200_8000..0x0200_8FFF. Kind: forty denied
8-byte JTAG writes issued as one outstanding group under the 64-cycle `bready` delay. Expected
response: forty DECERR, forty sentinels kept and an unchanged write count.
. Error injection. Point: outbound deny entry 1 over 0x0200_8000..0x0200_8FFF, while a DMA job runs.
Kind: a denied JTAG write at 0x0200_8800 started after the DMA copy is launched. Expected response:
DECERR with the sentinel kept, while the DMA payload lands at 0x0200_A000. Before it, write the DMA
`CONFIG` and the source, destination, length 8, zero stride and one-repetition registers and read
`NEXT_ID_0` to launch the copy; poll `DONE_0` for the completion.
. Program entry 1 as the permit word 0x0000_0000_0100_0013 over 0x0200_C000..0x0200_CFFF, start
twelve JTAG writes, wait for the first AW handshake (200-cycle bound), write the deny word to entry
1 over SEP_IN, wait for the group, and require the response order, the write count delta, the
per-word outcome and the entry read-back.
. Write the reset words back to entries 1 to 4 and the saved `CONFIG` back to the DMA, read each
back, require at least 71 SEP_IN accesses and exactly 59 JTAG accesses, then print the wait record
and the ordered-fence line.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-OUT-DENY-READ-RRESP` |The denied single-beat and 4-beat JTAG reads return exactly 1 and 4 R
beats, DECERR on every one, leave the SYS_OUT read count unchanged and `arvalid` low for 64 cycles, while the control read
outside the range is OKAY with 0x0123_4567_89AB_CDEF, raises the read count by one and raises
`arvalid`; the denied read data is printed and not compared
|`CHK-OUT-DENY-CLASSES` |The write refused by a clear permission, the prot 2 write refused by an
`allow_ns` 1 entry and the 4-beat write refused after the `allow_burst` 0 entry does not select it
are each DECERR with their sentinels kept, the write count held and no SYS_OUT AW or W valid
|`CHK-OUT-DENY-FLOOD` |All forty denied writes are answered DECERR with their forty sentinels kept
and the SYS_OUT write count unchanged; the peak of outstanding writes (AW minus B handshakes) is
at least 2
|`CHK-OUT-DENY-ADMIT-SIMULTANEOUS` |The denied JTAG write at 0x0200_8800 is DECERR with its sentinel
kept while the DMA job completes (`DONE_0` rises above its baseline within the poll bound) and the
8-byte payload lands at 0x0200_A000
|`CHK-OUT-RECONFIG-OUTSTANDING` |The twelve writes complete OKAY then DECERR in issue order with at
most one transition, the write count rises by the number of OKAY responses, each OKAY landed its
word, each DECERR kept its sentinel and entry 1 reads back as the deny word; which writes the new
entry governs is not required
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The step stamps S1 to S7 and the fence terms SEEDED to CLEANED are recorded in order
with strictly increasing time, each checker line is printed after its step, and the access counts
reach at least 71 SEP_IN and exactly 59 JTAG; a control-flow invariant, not a DUT compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |One entry per bounded wait the run took -- fuse-sense, JTAG and SEP_IN access
bounds, the 64-cycle read and write holds, the 200-cycle in-flight poll and responder poll and the
DMA `DONE_0` poll; the compares are the bounded waits themselves, so an expired bound raises before
this line
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-OUT-DENY-READ-RRESP`, `CHK-OUT-DENY-CLASSES`, `CHK-OUT-DENY-FLOOD`,
`CHK-OUT-DENY-ADMIT-SIMULTANEOUS` and `CHK-OUT-RECONFIG-OUTSTANDING` hold: every denied access is
DECERR on every response beat with no SYS_OUT beat and its sentinels kept, the DMA payload lands
while a denial is answered, and the twelve reconfigured writes never go from DECERR back to OKAY.
`CHK-NONVAC` and `CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` are printed after both access counts are met. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The read data of the denied reads and the peak of outstanding JTAG writes (AW minus
B handshakes) during the flood are printed and not compared. Which of the twelve in-flight writes
the reprogrammed entry governs is not required, because the documents do not say from which point a
new entry governs transactions already in flight; only the consistency of the response order is
required.

'''''

[[sec-370-smc_outfilt_priority_perm_test]]
===== 370 `smc_outfilt_priority_perm_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_outfilt_priority_perm_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, JTAG) for the 8-byte reads and writes with a chosen AxPROT and
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, SEP_IN) for programming outbound entries 0 to 8, 14 and 15; SYS_OUT responder
memory (`sys_out_mem` backdoor, a seed word preset at every probe address) and the `tb_top` probes
`tb_output_axi_write_count`, `tb_output_axi_read_count`, `tb_output_axi_awvalid`,
`tb_output_axi_wvalid`, `tb_output_axi_arvalid`, `tb_output_axi_awaddr` and `tb_output_axi_araddr`,
with the valids counted at every `clk_smc_i` rise, and `u_output_axi_if` members `awvalid`,
`awready`, `awprot`, `awcache`, `arvalid`, `arready`, `arprot` and `arcache` sampled at the AW and
AR handshakes; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` after the
fuse-sense wait

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-REP: the seed draws the offsets and the channel of the priority probes.

*Objective*: The outbound filter passes unmatched traffic, an allow entry is
not an allowlist, the lowest-numbered matching entry decides, and each channel follows its own
permission bit and entry.

*Test Coverage*:

* `fabric.adoc` (Outbound Filtering) and `index.adoc` (instance table): the SMC outbound filter
permits traffic that matches no entry. Before any filter register is written, a JTAG write at
0x0200_0100 and a JTAG read at 0x0200_0108 with prot 0b110 are OKAY, the write lands and the read
returns the seeded word, each presenting one SYS_OUT handshake with the driven address, prot and
AxCACHE 0b0011 (`fabric.adoc`: an initiator's AxCACHE is kept outside the alias remap regions).
* An allow entry is not an allowlist: with permit entry 1 over 0x0200_2000..0x0200_2FFF and deny
entry 2 over 0x0200_3000..0x0200_3FFF, a write at 0x0200_2100 and a write at 0x0200_5100, which no
entry covers, are OKAY and land, and only the write at 0x0200_3100 is DECERR.
* `index.adoc` (Match, Then Permit): the lowest-numbered matching entry alone is consulted. With
deny entry 3 below permit entry 4 over 0x0200_6000..0x0200_6FFF the write is DECERR; with the two
words swapped it is OKAY and lands.
* `filter_ctrl.rdl` (`read_allowed`, `write_allowed`): with a read-only entry 5 the read at
0x0200_7100 returns its seed and the write is DECERR; with a write-only entry the write at
0x0200_7108 lands and the read is DECERR.
* `index.adoc` (AW and AR decoded independently): over 0x0200_8000..0x0200_8FFF deny entry 6
(`allow_ns` 1) and permit entry 7 select different entries for one address: the prot 0b010 read at
0x0200_8100 is DECERR and the prot 0 write at the same address is OKAY and lands.
* Strict priority on the pairs (0, 1), (7, 8) and (14, 15): each pair is programmed with the lower
entry denying over overlapping ranges and probed in the overlap, then with the two words swapped;
the offset and the channel are drawn from the run's seed and printed, and the lower entry's decision
(DECERR, then OKAY) must decide each probe.
* A denied access is DECERR, keeps the SYS_OUT seed, moves neither SYS_OUT counter and raises no
SYS_OUT valid or handshake; a passed access presents exactly one handshake whose address, prot and
AxCACHE are the driven ones. All eleven entries are written back to their reset words.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for `tb_fuse_sense_done` (200000 `clk_smc_i` cycles bound), require the three fuse and reset
probes resolvable and start the SYS_OUT valid and handshake watcher.
. Read `FILTER_CONFIG` of outbound entries 0 to 8, 14 and 15 and compare each with the reset word;
JTAG-write 0x0200_0100 and JTAG-read 0x0200_0108 with prot 0b110, both OKAY.
. Error injection. Point: outbound permit entry 1 (0x0000_0000_0100_0013) over
0x0200_2000..0x0200_2FFF and deny entry 2 (0x0000_0000_0100_0010) over 0x0200_3000..0x0200_3FFF.
Kind: a JTAG write at 0x0200_3100 under the deny entry, beside writes at 0x0200_2100 under the
permit entry and at 0x0200_5100 under no entry. Expected response: only 0x0200_3100 is DECERR; the
other two are OKAY. Disable both entries.
. Error injection. Point: outbound deny entry 3 below permit entry 4 over 0x0200_6000..0x0200_6FFF.
Kind: a JTAG write at 0x0200_6100 decided by the lower deny entry. Expected response: DECERR. Swap
the two words, read both back and JTAG-write 0x0200_6108 (OKAY); disable both.
. Error injection. Point: outbound entry 5 over 0x0200_7000..0x0200_7FFF, read-only
(0x0000_0000_0100_0011) then write-only (0x0000_0000_0100_0012). Kind: a JTAG write at 0x0200_7100
through the read-only entry, then a JTAG read at 0x0200_7108 through the write-only entry. Expected
response: the write at 0x0200_7100 is DECERR while its read is OKAY with the seed; the write at
0x0200_7108 is OKAY while its read is DECERR. Disable the entry.
. Error injection. Point: outbound `allow_ns` 1 deny entry 6 (0x0000_0000_0100_0110) and permit
entry 7 over 0x0200_8000..0x0200_8FFF. Kind: a JTAG read at 0x0200_8100 with prot 0b010 that selects
the deny entry. Expected response: DECERR, while the JTAG write at the same address with prot 0
selects entry 7 and is OKAY. Disable both.
. Error injection. Point: each entry pair (0, 1), (7, 8) and (14, 15), lower entry deny and higher
entry permit over overlapping ranges. Kind: one probe at the seed-drawn address and channel in the
overlap. Expected response: DECERR. Swap the words, probe again and require OKAY, disable the pair.
. For each probe: a denied access must hold the matching SYS_OUT counter for 64 `clk_smc_i` cycles,
keep the seed and raise no valid or handshake; a passed access must raise its counter by exactly one
(200-cycle poll), land or return the seed and present exactly one handshake with the driven address,
prot and AxCACHE.
. Write the reset words back to all eleven entries, read every register back and compare, require
exactly 160 SEP_IN accesses and 19 JTAG accesses, then print the wait record and the ordered-fence
line.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-OUT-DEFAULT-PASS-RESET` |With no filter register written the JTAG write at 0x0200_0100 and
read at 0x0200_0108 are OKAY, the write lands and the read returns its seeded word, each with
exactly one SYS_OUT handshake carrying the driven address, prot 0b110 and AxCACHE 0b0011
|`CHK-OUT-ALLOW-NOT-ALLOWLIST` |The writes at 0x0200_2100 under the permit entry and at 0x0200_5100
under no entry are OKAY and land, and only the write at 0x0200_3100 under the deny entry is DECERR
with its seed kept
|`CHK-OUT-PRIO-DENY-OVER-PERMIT` |With deny entry 3 below permit entry 4 the write at 0x0200_6100 is
DECERR, keeps its seed, moves no counter and raises no SYS_OUT valid
|`CHK-OUT-PRIO-PERMIT-OVER-DENY` |With the words swapped the write at 0x0200_6108 is OKAY, lands and
presents one handshake with the driven address and prot
|`CHK-OUT-PER-CHANNEL` |With the read-only entry the write is DECERR and the read returns its seed;
with the write-only entry the write lands and the read is DECERR, each refused access keeping its
seed and moving no counter
|`CHK-OUT-RD-WR-DIFF-ENTRY` |The prot 0b010 read at 0x0200_8100 selects deny entry 6 and is DECERR
while the prot 0 write at the same address selects permit entry 7 and is OKAY and lands
|`CHK-OUT-PRIO-PAIRS` |In each of the pairs (0, 1), (7, 8) and (14, 15) the overlap probe is DECERR
when the lower entry denies and OKAY when it permits, on the seed-drawn channel and offset, all
three pairs visited
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The step stamps S1 to S7 and the fence terms RESET_PASS to CLEANED are recorded in
order with strictly increasing time, each checker line is printed after its step in the fixed order,
and the access counts are exactly 160 SEP_IN and 19 JTAG; a control-flow invariant, not a DUT
compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |One entry per bounded wait the run took -- fuse-sense, JTAG and SEP_IN access
bounds, the 64-cycle write and read holds and the 200-cycle responder poll; the compares are the
bounded waits themselves, so an expired bound raises before this line
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-OUT-DEFAULT-PASS-RESET`, `CHK-OUT-ALLOW-NOT-ALLOWLIST`,
`CHK-OUT-PRIO-DENY-OVER-PERMIT`, `CHK-OUT-PRIO-PERMIT-OVER-DENY`, `CHK-OUT-PER-CHANNEL`,
`CHK-OUT-RD-WR-DIFF-ENTRY` and `CHK-OUT-PRIO-PAIRS` hold: unmatched traffic passes, the
lowest-numbered matching entry decides every overlap, each channel follows its own permission bit
and entry, every refusal is DECERR with the seed kept and no SYS_OUT beat, and every passed access
presents its driven address, prot and AxCACHE. `CHK-NONVAC` and `CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` are printed
after both exact access counts. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.

'''''

[[sec-371-smc_outremap_prot_srcid_test]]
===== 371 `smc_outremap_prot_srcid_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_outremap_prot_srcid_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, JTAG) for the 8-byte writes and reads with each AxPROT value 0
to 7 and `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, SEP_IN) for programming and restoring the M-mode output remap regions
1 and 4, the Xvisor output remap region 1 and alias remap region 6 (`REGION_START`, `REGION_END`,
`REGION_ATTRS`); SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem` backdoor) and the `tb_top` probes
`tb_output_axi_write_count`, `tb_output_axi_read_count`, `tb_output_axi_last_addr` and
`tb_output_axi_last_wdata`; `u_output_axi_if` members `awvalid`, `awready`, `awaddr`, `awprot`,
`awuser`, `arvalid`, `arready`, `araddr`, `arprot` and `aruser` sampled at every AW and AR handshake
on `clk_smc_i`; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` after the
fuse-sense wait

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: AxPROT passes unchanged through the M-mode remap, the Xvisor remap,
the direct path and an alias remap hit, and the AxUSER source ID of each path is observed and
printed.

*Test Coverage*:

* `fabric.adoc` (Protection Bit Pass-Through): all protection bits are passed through the fabric
without modification. A JTAG write with each prot value 0 to 7 through the M-mode window
(0xC110_0000, region 1 programmed with `REGION_ATTRS` 0x8000_0000_0250_0000) lands at 0x0250_0040 +
8p and presents `awprot` equal to p at the SYS_OUT AW handshake; the same sweep through the Xvisor
window (0xC190_0000, region 1 with 0x8000_0000_02A0_0000) lands at 0x02A0_0040 + 8p.
* The direct path (`fabric.adoc` Outbound Traffic Flow, `output_remap.rdl` `REGION_ATTRS.valid`):
addresses outside the remap windows (0x0200_0040 and 0x0200_0140 + 8p) are not remapped; eight
writes and eight reads with prot 0 to 7 land at their own addresses with `awprot` and `arprot` equal
to p and the seeded read words returned.
* After an alias remap hit (`fabric.adoc` Alias Remapping, `alias_remap.rdl`): region 6 over
0x0203_0000..0x0203_1000 with `REGION_ATTRS` 0x8000_0000_0010_0000 moves a prot 0b101 write at
0x0203_0040 to 0x0213_0040 with `awprot` still 0b101.
* `fabric.adoc` (Output Remapping, Outbound Traffic Flow; source ID by traffic path
table): each remap sets its own AxUSER source ID and the table names `SMC_ID` for the direct path,
`MMODE_ID` through the M-mode remap and `OTHER_ID` through the Xvisor remap. The numeric values are
not stated in the documents, so the leaf prints the `awuser` and `aruser` of
three writes and three reads on each path and requires only that they are resolvable and constant
across the requests of a path.
* `output_remap.rdl` (`REGION_ATTRS.valid`: a clear region passes accesses with their address
unchanged): M-mode region 4, programmed with offset 0x02B0_0000 and `valid` clear, passes a write
and a read at 0xC140_0100 through at their own address; the `awuser` and `aruser` of that access are
printed beside the direct and M-mode ones, and which source ID a clear region carries is not stated.
* The remap registers are read at their reset words before programming and restored and read back at
the end.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for `tb_fuse_sense_done` (200000 `clk_smc_i` cycles bound), require the three fuse and reset
probes resolvable and start the AW and AR handshake sampler.
. Read M-mode regions 1 and 4, Xvisor region 1 and alias `REGION_ATTRS` of region 6 at their reset
words; write the six programmed words (M-mode 1 0x8000_0000_0250_0000, M-mode 4
0x0000_0000_02B0_0000, Xvisor 1 0x8000_0000_02A0_0000, alias START 0x0203_0000, END 0x0203_1000 and
ATTRS 0x8000_0000_0010_0000) and read each back; take the SYS_OUT write and read counts.
. JTAG-write 0xC110_0040 + 8p with prot p for p = 0 to 7; each must be OKAY, raise the write count
by one with the remapped address and data, land at 0x0250_0040 + 8p, not land at the window address,
present exactly one AW handshake at the remapped address and carry `awprot` equal to p.
. Repeat the sweep through the Xvisor window 0xC190_0040 + 8p into 0x02A0_0040 + 8p.
. JTAG-write 0x0200_0040 + 8p and JTAG-read 0x0200_0140 + 8p with prot p for p = 0 to 7; each must
land or return its seed at its own address with `awprot` or `arprot` equal to p.
. JTAG-write 0x0203_0040 with prot 0b101 and require it at 0x0213_0040 with `awprot` 0b101.
. On the direct path at 0x0200_0100, the M-mode path at 0xC110_0100 and the Xvisor path at
0xC190_0100, issue three prot 0 writes and three prot 0 reads each; require each channel's `awuser`
or `aruser` constant across the three requests and print it.
. JTAG-write and JTAG-read 0xC140_0100 through the clear M-mode region 4, require the address
unchanged and print `awuser` and `aruser`.
. Restore the six registers to their reset words and read each back, require at least 81 SEP_IN and
JTAG accesses in total, then print the wait record and the ordered-fence line.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-PROT-MMODE` |The eight JTAG writes with prot 0 to 7 through the M-mode window land at the
remapped addresses 0x0250_0040 + 8p and present `awprot` equal to p at the SYS_OUT AW handshake
|`CHK-PROT-XVISOR` |The eight JTAG writes with prot 0 to 7 through the Xvisor window land at
0x02A0_0040 + 8p and present `awprot` equal to p
|`CHK-PROT-DIRECT` |Eight writes and eight reads with prot 0 to 7 outside the remap windows land or
return at their own addresses and present `awprot` and `arprot` equal to p
|`CHK-PROT-AFTER-REMAPS` |The prot 0b101 write that hits alias region 6 lands at 0x0213_0040 and
presents `awprot` 0b101, so the alias remap leaves AxPROT unchanged
|`CHK-SRCID-DIRECT-OBSERVE` |Measures and prints the `awuser` and `aruser` of three writes and three
reads on the direct path; no source ID value is compared, only that each is resolvable and constant
across the requests
|`CHK-SRCID-MMODE-OBSERVE` |Measures and prints the `awuser` and `aruser` of three writes and three
reads through the M-mode remap; no source ID value is compared, only that each is resolvable and
constant
|`CHK-SRCID-XVISOR-OBSERVE` |Measures and prints the `awuser` and `aruser` of three writes and three
reads through the Xvisor remap; no source ID value is compared, only that each is resolvable and
constant
|`CHK-VALID0-SRCID-OBSERVE` |Records the `awuser` and `aruser` of the write and read through the
clear M-mode region 4, which land at their own address, beside the direct and M-mode values, without
comparing them
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The step stamps S1 to S8 are recorded in order with strictly increasing time, each
checker line is printed after its step in the fixed order, and the SEP_IN plus JTAG access count
reaches the floor of 81; a control-flow invariant, not a DUT compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the fuse-sense bounds, the 50 us per-access bound, the 200-cycle
SYS_OUT responder poll of each JTAG access and the passive handshake sampler as a line; the compares
are the bounded accesses themselves, so an expired bound raises before this line
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-PROT-MMODE`, `CHK-PROT-XVISOR`, `CHK-PROT-DIRECT` and `CHK-PROT-AFTER-REMAPS`
hold: every access lands at its remapped or direct address, returns or lands its word and presents
the driven AxPROT. The four source-ID checkers (`CHK-SRCID-DIRECT-OBSERVE`,
`CHK-SRCID-MMODE-OBSERVE`, `CHK-SRCID-XVISOR-OBSERVE` and `CHK-VALID0-SRCID-OBSERVE`) report what
was measured and are held only to resolvability and constancy per path. `CHK-NONVAC` and
`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` are printed after the access floor of 81. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The `awuser` and `aruser` source IDs of the direct, M-mode and Xvisor paths are
printed and held only to resolvability and constancy per path, because the documents do not state
their numeric values; which source ID a clear region carries is not stated, so the `awuser` and
`aruser` of the access through the clear M-mode region 4 are printed without a compare.

'''''

[[sec-372-smc_outremap_window_translate_test]]
===== 372 `smc_outremap_window_translate_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_outremap_window_translate_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, JTAG) for the 8-byte probe writes and the 12-write outstanding
group, and `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI, SEP_IN) for the M-mode and Xvisor output remap `REGION_ATTRS`
registers (regions 0 to 7 of each window); SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem` backdoor, a
sentinel preset at each probe address) and the `tb_top` probes `tb_output_axi_write_count`,
`tb_output_axi_awvalid`, `tb_output_axi_awready` and `tb_output_axi_awaddr`, with the AW handshake
addresses recorded at every `clk_smc_i` rise; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and
`tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` after the fuse-sense wait

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Each programmed region of the M-mode and Xvisor output remaps
replaces the upper address bits of its 1 MiB slot and keeps the low 20 bits, regions stay
independent, an unmapped or invalid region passes addresses through, and clearing valid under load
never reverses.

*Test Coverage*:

* `output_remap.rdl` (`REGION_ATTRS.offset` [55:0], `valid` [63]) and `fabric.adoc` (Fabric
Topology): each output remap divides its 8 MiB window at 0xC100_0000 (M-mode) or 0xC180_0000
(Xvisor) into eight 1 MiB regions and replaces address bits [55:20] with the region's offset. All
sixteen `REGION_ATTRS` read the reset word with `valid` clear, and with every region clear a write
through each window lands at its own address.
* Regions 0, 3 and 7 of the M-mode remap (offsets 0x0240_0000, 0x0250_0000, 0x0260_0000) and of the
Xvisor remap (0x0270_0000, 0x0280_0000, 0x0290_0000) are programmed with `valid` set; a write at
region base + 0x1A8 lands at offset + 0x1A8 with exactly one AW handshake at that address and
nothing at the window address.
* Window edges: the first address of the M-mode window (0xC100_0000) lands at 0x0240_0000 and the
last 8 bytes (0xC17F_FFF8) at 0x026F_FFF8; the first of the Xvisor window (0xC180_0000) lands at
0x0270_0000 and the last (0xC1FF_FFF8) at 0x029F_FFF8. The 8 bytes below the M-mode window
(0xC0FF_FFF8) raise no AW handshake and no SYS_OUT write for 64 `clk_smc_i` cycles; the response is
printed, not compared, because the documents do not state the response to an address outside both
windows.
* `fabric.adoc` (Outbound Traffic Flow): traffic outside the remap windows goes direct to the system
NoC, so writes at 0xC200_0008 and 0x4200_0008 reach SYS_OUT unchanged.
* Region independence: with Xvisor regions 1 and 5 programmed (0x02A0_0000, 0x02B0_0000), writes
through regions 0, 3, 7, 1 and 5 land at their own offsets and writes through the unprogrammed
regions 2 and 4 pass unchanged at their own addresses.
* `output_remap.rdl` (`valid`: a clear region passes accesses unchanged): `valid` of M-mode region 0
is cleared over SEP_IN while twelve JTAG writes into that region are outstanding. The documents do
not say from which point a cleared `valid` governs writes already in flight,
so the leaf requires only that every write is OKAY, lands exactly once at either the remapped or the
identity address, the write count rises by twelve, and in issue order no write lands remapped after
one landed unmapped and the landing changes at most once.
* All programmed regions return to their reset word.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for `tb_fuse_sense_done` (200000 `clk_smc_i` cycles bound) and start the AW-address recorder.
. Read `REGION_ATTRS` of regions 0 to 7 of the M-mode and the Xvisor remap and compare each with the
reset word.
. JTAG-write 0xC100_0040 and 0xC180_0040 with every region clear; each must land at its own address,
with the sentinels at 0x0240_0040 and 0x0270_0040 untouched.
. Write and read back `REGION_ATTRS` (`valid` plus offset) of M-mode regions 0, 3, 7 and Xvisor
regions 0, 3, 7.
. JTAG-write region base + 0x1A8 of M-mode regions 0, 3, 7 and then of Xvisor regions 0, 3, 7; each
must be OKAY, raise the write count by one (200-cycle poll), land at offset + 0x1A8, leave its
window address unchanged and present exactly one AW handshake at the landing address.
. JTAG-write 0xC0FF_FFF8 and require no AW and a constant write count for 64 cycles with the
sentinels kept; then the four window edges and the two direct addresses with the same per-probe
checks.
. Program Xvisor regions 1 and 5, then write through regions 0, 3, 7, 2, 4, 1 and 5 at offset 0x40
and require each landing as above.
. Start a group of twelve JTAG writes at 0xC100_0400 + 8k, clear `valid` of M-mode region 0 over
SEP_IN, wait for the group and the write count, and require each write at exactly one of the two
addresses and the landing order to change at most once, remapped first.
. Restore all eleven programmed `REGION_ATTRS` to the reset word, require at least 83 SEP_IN and
JTAG accesses in total, then print the wait record and the ordered-fence line.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-OUTREMAP-IDENTITY-RESET` |All sixteen `REGION_ATTRS` read the reset word with `valid` clear
and the JTAG writes at 0xC100_0040 and 0xC180_0040 land at their own addresses with the translated
addresses 0x0240_0040 and 0x0270_0040 untouched
|`CHK-MMODE-REGIONS` |Writes at base + 0x1A8 of M-mode regions 0, 3 and 7 land at 0x0240_01A8,
0x0250_01A8 and 0x0260_01A8, OKAY, with one AW handshake at the landing address and the window
address unchanged
|`CHK-XVISOR-REGIONS` |Writes at base + 0x1A8 of Xvisor regions 0, 3 and 7 land at 0x0270_01A8,
0x0280_01A8 and 0x0290_01A8 with one AW handshake at the landing address and the window address
unchanged
|`CHK-MMODE-EDGES` |The first and last 8 bytes of the M-mode window land at 0x0240_0000 and
0x026F_FFF8, and the write at 0xC0FF_FFF8 below the window raises no AW handshake and holds the
write count for 64 cycles with its sentinels kept; its response is printed and not compared
|`CHK-XVISOR-EDGES` |The first and last 8 bytes of the Xvisor window land at 0x0270_0000 and
0x029F_FFF8, each OKAY with one AW handshake at the landing address
|`CHK-XVISOR-INDEPENDENT` |With Xvisor regions 1 and 5 added, regions 0, 3, 7, 1 and 5 still land at
their own offsets and the unprogrammed regions 2 and 4 pass their writes unchanged
|`CHK-OUTREMAP-VALID-TOGGLE` |The twelve writes outstanding while `valid` is cleared are all OKAY,
each lands at exactly one of the remapped or identity address, the write count rises by twelve and
the landing order changes at most once from remapped to identity; which writes the clear governs is
not required
|`CHK-OUTROUTE-DIRECT-ADDRS` |The writes at 0xC200_0008 and 0x4200_0008, outside both windows, reach
SYS_OUT at their own addresses with one AW handshake each
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The step stamps S1 to S9 are recorded in order with strictly increasing time, each
checker line is printed after its step in the fixed order, and the SEP_IN plus JTAG access count
reaches the floor of 83; a control-flow invariant, not a DUT compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |One entry per bounded wait the run took -- fuse-sense, SEP_IN and JTAG access
bounds, the 200-cycle write-count poll and the 64-cycle write hold; the compares are the bounded
waits themselves, so an expired bound raises before this line
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-OUTREMAP-IDENTITY-RESET`, `CHK-MMODE-REGIONS`, `CHK-XVISOR-REGIONS`,
`CHK-MMODE-EDGES`, `CHK-XVISOR-EDGES`, `CHK-OUTROUTE-DIRECT-ADDRS`, `CHK-XVISOR-INDEPENDENT` and
`CHK-OUTREMAP-VALID-TOGGLE` hold: every probe lands at its translated or own address with its low 20
bits kept and exactly one AW handshake, the region registers read their reset words at the start and
after the restore, and the twelve writes under a cleared `valid` land once each with at most one
change of landing. `CHK-NONVAC` and `CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` are printed after the access floor of 83.
Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The response to the write at 0xC0FF_FFF8, below the M-mode window, is printed and
not compared, because the documents do not state the response to an address outside both windows.
Which of the twelve in-flight writes a cleared `valid` governs is not required, because the
documents do not say from which point it takes effect; only the landing consistency is required.

'''''

[[sec-373-smc_alias_remap_attr_test]]
===== 373 `smc_alias_remap_attr_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_alias_remap_attr_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master for the alias-remap and `DMA_CTRL` register
programming; JTAG AXI agent (`jtag_axi_agent` sequencer, AxCACHE 0b0011 on every access) for the
traffic; SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem`, backdoor seed and readback); the output interface
`u_output_axi_if` of the bench top, `awvalid`/`awready`/`awaddr`/`awcache` and
`arvalid`/`arready`/`araddr`/`arcache` sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge;
`tb_output_axi_write_count`
through the output responder counters; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and
`tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; registers `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and
`REGION_ATTRS` of alias-remap regions 2, 4, 5 and 6, and `DMA_CTRL` `CONFIG` (`ENABLED_ND`, bit 10),
`DONE_0`, `NEXT_ID_0`, `STATUS_0`, the destination, source, length, stride and repetition words

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Alias remap replaces AxCACHE, holds attributes, shares one table.

*Test Coverage*:

* A write or read that hits a valid alias-remap region leaves with the region's `REGION_ATTRS`
  cacheable field (bits [59:56]) in place of the initiator's AxCACHE (`alias_remap.rdl`
  `REGION_ATTRS`; `fabric.adoc`, Alias Remapping). Region 2 is programmed with cacheable 0xF, 0xB
  and 0x2, and each value is shown on AWCACHE and on ARCACHE at the output handshake while the
  word lands unchanged.
* An access outside the region's `REGION_START`/`REGION_END` span keeps the initiator's own AxCACHE,
  0b0011 for the JTAG AXI manager, whatever the cacheable field of the neighbouring region says.
* Cacheable 0 on a valid region: AWCACHE and ARCACHE are measured and printed, and each may be
  only 0 or 0b0011; the expected value is an owner value that is still pending, so the leg
  measures it and does not compare against one.
* The 8-byte `REGION_ATTRS` word is held across 4-byte writes: a write of the offset half
  (+0) leaves valid and cacheable, and a write of the upper half (+4) leaves the offset
  (`alias_remap.rdl`, `REGION_ATTRS` offset [55:12], cacheable [59:56], valid [63]). The
  translated landing address and AWCACHE after each half write show the held bits in use.
* The JTAG initiator and the SMC DMA share one remap table: with region 5 valid the JTAG write and
  the DMA source and destination of an 8-byte copy are translated by the same offset, and with the
  DMA copy running in region 6 a group of eight JTAG writes through region 5 all land translated.
* Every programmed `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and `REGION_ATTRS` word reads 0 at reset
  and again after the cleanup writes (`alias_remap.rdl`, reset 0).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), start the output
  interface watcher, and read `REGION_ATTRS` of regions 2, 4, 5 and 6 over SEP_IN expecting 0.
. Program region 2 (`REGION_START` 0x0200_2000, `REGION_END` 0x0200_3000, read back) and, for each
  of cacheable 0xF, 0xB and 0x2, write `REGION_ATTRS` valid with that cacheable value, read it back,
  JTAG-write 0x0200_2100 and JTAG-read 0x0200_2108 with the SYS_OUT words seeded; require OKAY, the
  word landed unchanged and exactly one AW and one AR handshake at the unchanged address carrying
  the cacheable value.
. Rewrite `REGION_ATTRS` of region 2 with valid and cacheable 0xF, then JTAG-write 0x0200_4100 and
  JTAG-read 0x0200_4108 outside the region; require AWCACHE and ARCACHE 0x3.
. Rewrite `REGION_ATTRS` of region 2 with valid and cacheable 0, JTAG-write 0x0200_2110 and
  JTAG-read 0x0200_2118, and record AWCACHE and ARCACHE; the sequence requires each to be 0 or 0x3.
. Program region 4 (`REGION_START` 0x0200_6000, `REGION_END` 0x0200_7000) with `REGION_ATTRS`
  valid, cacheable 0xB and offset 0x0010_0000, then write 4 bytes of 0x0020_0000 at +0 and read the
  8-byte word expecting 0x8B00_0000_0020_0000; JTAG-write 0x0200_6100 and require it to land at
  0x0220_6100 with AWCACHE 0xB.
. Write 4 bytes of 0x8200_0000 at +4 of region 4 `REGION_ATTRS` and read the 8-byte word expecting
  0x8200_0000_0020_0000; JTAG-write 0x0200_6108 and require it to land at 0x0220_6108 with AWCACHE
  0x2.
. Program region 5 (`REGION_START` 0x0201_0000, `REGION_END` 0x0201_2000, `REGION_ATTRS`
  0x8300_0000_0040_0000), seed the translated source 0x0241_0100 with 0x1122_3344_5566_7788 and
  sentinels at the untranslated addresses, JTAG-write 0x0201_0010 and require it at 0x0241_0010 with
  AWCACHE 0x3; start a DMA copy of 8 bytes from 0x0201_0100 to 0x0201_0200 and poll `DONE_0` up to
  50 times at 20 `clk_smc_i` cycles; require the payload at 0x0241_0200 and the sentinel kept at
  0x0201_0200.
. Program region 6 (`REGION_START` 0x0201_4000, `REGION_END` 0x0201_6000, `REGION_ATTRS`
  0x8300_0000_0050_0000), seed the translated source 0x0251_4100 with the payload, start a DMA
  copy of 8 bytes from 0x0201_4100 to 0x0201_4200, and while it runs issue a group of eight JTAG
  writes at 0x0201_0300 + 8k; require every write OKAY and landed at 0x0241_0300 + 8k with the
  untranslated address untouched, the payload at 0x0251_4200, the sentinel kept at 0x0201_4200 and
  `DONE_0` advanced.
. Write 0 to `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and `REGION_ATTRS` of regions 2, 4, 5 and 6 and read each
  back expecting 0; stop the watcher, log the bounded waits, and require the nine step stamps in
  increasing order, the eight checker lines in their order, the JTAG access count equal to 21 and
  the combined SEP_IN and JTAG access count at least 111.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ALIAS-CACHE-REPLACE-AW` |A JTAG write hitting region 2 presents AWCACHE 0xF, then 0xB, then
0x2 at the output handshake, replacing the 0b0011 the manager drives, with one AW handshake at the
unchanged address and the word landed unchanged; any other value or an unresolved probe fails
|`CHK-ALIAS-CACHE-REPLACE-AR` |A JTAG read hitting region 2 presents ARCACHE 0xF, then 0xB, then 0x2
at the output handshake with one AR handshake and the seeded word returned
|`CHK-ALIAS-CACHE-MISS` |A write at 0x0200_4100 and a read at 0x0200_4108, outside region 2 while it
is valid with cacheable 0xF, carry AWCACHE and ARCACHE 0x3 and land at their own addresses
|`CHK-ALIAS-CACHE-ZERO-OBSERVE` |Measures and prints AWCACHE and ARCACHE of a hit on valid region 2
with cacheable 0; the sequence fails only if either is neither 0 nor 0x3, and the value the DUT
presents is recorded, not compared against an expected one
|`CHK-ALIAS-ATTR-HOLD-OFFSET-HALF` |After the 4-byte write of the offset half at +0, the
8-byte `REGION_ATTRS` read returns 0x8B00_0000_0020_0000 and a JTAG write at 0x0200_6100 lands
at 0x0220_6100 with AWCACHE 0xB
|`CHK-ALIAS-ATTR-HOLD-UPPER-HALF` |After the 4-byte write at +4, the 8-byte `REGION_ATTRS` read
returns 0x8200_0000_0020_0000 and a JTAG write at 0x0200_6108 lands at 0x0220_6108 with AWCACHE 0x2
|`CHK-ALIAS-SHARED-DMA` |With region 5 valid, the JTAG write at 0x0201_0010 lands at
0x0241_0010 and the DMA copy reads the translated source and writes its payload at 0x0241_0200
while the sentinel at 0x0201_0200 stays
|`CHK-ALIAS-SHARED-SIMULTANEOUS` |Eight JTAG writes through region 5 all land at 0x0241_0300 + 8k
with the untranslated addresses untouched while the DMA copy through region 6 lands its payload at
0x0251_4200, keeps the sentinel at 0x0201_4200 and advances `DONE_0` within the poll bound
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The nine steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed after its step and in order, and the access count reached its floor of 111; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (fuse sense, reset releases, SEP_IN and
JTAG accesses, group await, output write-count poll, DMA `DONE_0` poll) with their bounds; the
expiry of any of them raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: all ten checkers hold: the three region-2 values replace AxCACHE on both channels,
the miss keeps 0x3, the offset and upper half writes keep the other half and land at the shifted
address with AWCACHE 0xB and 0x2, the JTAG and DMA traffic is translated by the same table and
the 21 JTAG accesses and the access floor of 111 are met. `CHK-ALIAS-CACHE-ZERO-OBSERVE` records the
cacheable-0 value without comparing it. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: AWCACHE and ARCACHE of a hit on a valid region with cacheable 0 are measured and
printed, each required only to be 0 or 0b0011, because the expected value is an owner value that is
still pending.

'''''

[[sec-374-smc_alias_remap_translate_test]]
===== 374 `smc_alias_remap_translate_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_alias_remap_translate_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master for the alias-remap register programming; JTAG AXI
agent (`jtag_axi_agent` sequencer) for the traffic, including a twelve-write outstanding group;
SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem`, sentinel seed 0x5A5A_5A5A_5A5A_5A5A and backdoor readback);
`tb_output_axi_awvalid`/`awready`/`awaddr` and `arvalid`/`arready`/`araddr` with `awcache`/`arcache`
of `u_output_axi_if` sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge; `tb_remap_jtag_aw_hit` and
`tb_remap_jtag_ar_hit` OR-ed over the observed window; `tb_output_axi_write_count` through the
output responder counters; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for
the bring-up wait; registers `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and `REGION_ATTRS` of alias-remap regions
0 to 7

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Alias remap adds the region offset: edges, carry, open cases.

*Test Coverage*:

* All eight alias-remap regions read `REGION_ATTRS` 0 at reset, and with nothing programmed a JTAG
  write and read pass at their own addresses with the initiator's AxCACHE 0x3 (`alias_remap.rdl`,
  reset 0; `fabric.adoc`, Alias Remapping).
* A region with valid clear is transparent: region 3 programmed with `REGION_ATTRS` valid 0 lands
  the write at its own address.
* A hit adds the stored offset (`REGION_ATTRS` offset [55:12], in 4 KiB pages) to the address and
  keeps address bits [11:0] (`alias_remap.rdl`). Regions 0, 3 and 7 are programmed with different
  offsets, and the write and the read at the same source each reach the translated address, with
  the source left at the sentinel.
* The span is `REGION_START` inclusive to `REGION_END` non-inclusive (`alias_remap.rdl`): the first
  and last page of region 3 translate, the page at `REGION_END` and the page below `REGION_START`
  keep their own address.
* The offset addition carries into bit 32: region 5 over 0x0000_FFFF_F000 to 0x0001_0000_0000 moves
  a write at 0x0000_FFFF_F7A8 to 0x0001_0000_07A8.
* Overlapping regions 1 and 2: where an address that hits both lands is not fixed by the register
  description, so the leg requires one of three landings (either offset alone or the summed
  offset, 0x0290_E010) and prints which, and prints the response and the hit-probe level without
  comparing them.
* Empty (`REGION_START` equal to `REGION_END`) and inverted regions: the register description fixes
  no behaviour, so each write is required to answer OKAY and to land at its own address or at the
  region offset past it, and the landing is printed.
* An offset changed over SEP_IN while a twelve-write JTAG group is outstanding: the register
  description fixes no point at which a new offset takes effect, so every write is required to
  answer OKAY and to land at exactly the old or the new offset, in issue order with at most one
  old-to-new switch and no new-to-old, and the AW addresses match the landing.
* Every programmed `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and `REGION_ATTRS` word reads 0 after the
  cleanup writes.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), start the output
  interface watcher, and read `REGION_ATTRS` of regions 0 to 7 over SEP_IN expecting 0.
. With nothing programmed, JTAG-write 0x0200_0100 and JTAG-read 0x0200_0108; require OKAY, the word
  at the same address, one AW or AR handshake at that address with AxCACHE 0x3 and no handshake on
  the other channel.
. Program region 3 (`REGION_START` 0x0200_4000, `REGION_END` 0x0200_6000) with `REGION_ATTRS`
  0x0300_0000_0020_0000 (valid clear), read it back, JTAG-write 0x0200_4100 and require it at
  0x0200_4100 with AxCACHE 0x3.
. Program region 0 (0x0200_8000 to 0x0200_9000, `REGION_ATTRS` 0x8300_0000_0010_0000) and region 7
  (0x0200_C000 to 0x0200_D000, 0x8300_0000_0030_0000), set region 3 to 0x8300_0000_0020_0000, then
  JTAG-write 0x0200_87A8, 0x0200_5A50 and 0x0200_C3F8 and require them at 0x0210_87A8, 0x0220_5A50
  and 0x0230_C3F8 with the sources at the sentinel; JTAG-read the same three sources and require
  the AR addresses to be the translated ones and the words seeded there to return.
. JTAG-write 0x0200_4008 (to 0x0220_4008), 0x0200_5FF8 (to 0x0220_5FF8), 0x0200_6008 and
  0x0200_3FF8 (both at their own address); require one AW handshake per write at the landing
  address and no AR handshake.
. Program region 5 (0x0000_FFFF_F000 to 0x0001_0000_0000, `REGION_ATTRS` 0x8300_0000_0000_1000),
  JTAG-write 0x0000_FFFF_F7A8 and require it at 0x0001_0000_07A8 with 0x0000_0000_07A8 at the
  sentinel.
. Program regions 1 and 2 over 0x0200_E000 to 0x0200_F000 with offsets 0x0040_0000 and 0x0050_0000,
  clear the hit-probe record, JTAG-write 0x0200_E010 and require the word at exactly one of
  0x0240_E010, 0x0250_E010 and 0x0290_E010 with the AW address equal to it; the response and
  `tb_remap_jtag_aw_hit` are printed.
. Error injection. Point: alias regions 4 and 6. Kind: an empty region (`REGION_START` and
  `REGION_END` both 0x0201_0000, offset 0x0060_0000) and an inverted region (`REGION_START`
  0x0201_2000, `REGION_END` 0x0201_1000, offset 0x0070_0000), then JTAG writes at 0x0201_0010,
  0x0201_1010 and 0x0201_2010. Expected response: OKAY and a landing at exactly one of the source,
  source plus 0x0060_0000 and source plus 0x0070_0000; each landing and its offset are printed.
. Rewrite region 3 `REGION_ATTRS` to 0x8300_0000_0020_0000, seed old and new landing words, start a
  JTAG group of twelve 8-byte writes at 0x0200_5000 + 8k, write 0x8300_0000_0030_0000 to region 3
  `REGION_ATTRS` over SEP_IN while it runs, wait for the group and for the output write count,
  read the attribute back, and require each write OKAY, landed at exactly one of the two offsets and
  not at the source, no new-to-old switch, at most one old-to-new switch and AW addresses equal to
  the memory landing.
. Write 0 to `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and `REGION_ATTRS` of regions 0 to 7 and read each back
  expecting 0; stop the watcher, log the bounded waits, and require the ten step stamps in
  increasing order, the nine checker lines in their order and the combined SEP_IN and JTAG access
  count at least 123; the test also requires the JTAG access count to be 30.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-ALIAS-RESET-IDENTITY` |With nothing programmed a JTAG write at 0x0200_0100 and read at
0x0200_0108 reach the same addresses with AxCACHE 0x3 and the seeded word returns
|`CHK-ALIAS-VALID0-TRANSPARENT` |Region 3 programmed with valid clear leaves the write at
0x0200_4100 at its own address and not at 0x0220_4100, with AWCACHE 0x3
|`CHK-ALIAS-OFFSET-LOW12` |Writes at 0x0200_87A8, 0x0200_5A50 and 0x0200_C3F8 land at 0x0210_87A8,
0x0220_5A50 and 0x0230_C3F8 with address bits [11:0] kept, the sources keep the sentinel, and one AW
handshake appears per write at the landing address
|`CHK-ALIAS-RD-WR` |Reads at the same three sources issue AR at the translated addresses and return
the words seeded there, with no AW handshake
|`CHK-ALIAS-RANGE-EDGES` |The first and last page of region 3 translate by 0x0020_0000
while the page at `REGION_END` and the page below `REGION_START` land at their own
addresses, one AW per write and no AR
|`CHK-ALIAS-CARRY` |The write at 0x0000_FFFF_F7A8 lands at 0x0001_0000_07A8 and the no-carry address
0x0000_0000_07A8 keeps the sentinel
|`CHK-ALIAS-OVERLAP-OBSERVE` |The write over overlapping regions 1 and 2 lands at exactly one of the
three candidate addresses with AW at that address; the response, the landing and the hit probe are
printed, and the choice between the two offsets is recorded, not asserted
|`CHK-ALIAS-EMPTY-REGION-OBSERVE` |Each write through an empty or inverted region answers OKAY and
lands at exactly one of the source and the two offset addresses; which one is recorded, not asserted
|`CHK-ALIAS-REPROGRAM-OUTSTANDING` |All twelve writes answer OKAY and each lands at the old or the
new offset, in issue order with no new-to-old switch and at most one old-to-new switch, with the AW
addresses equal to the memory landing; the switch point is printed, not asserted
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The ten steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was printed
after its step and in order, and the access count reached its floor of 123; a control-flow invariant
that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (fuse sense, reset releases, SEP_IN and
JTAG accesses, output write-count poll, group completion) with their bounds; the expiry of any
raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: all eleven checkers hold: reset identity and valid-clear transparency, the offset
translation on both channels with bits [11:0] kept, the span edges, the carry into bit 32, each
open case landing at one of its allowed addresses, and the 30 JTAG accesses and the floor of 123.
The overlap choice, the empty-region landing and the reprogramming switch point are recorded without
a fixed expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: Where a write that hits overlapping regions 1 and 2 lands is not fixed by the
register description, so one of three landings is required and which one, the response and the
hit-probe level are printed without a compare. The register description fixes no behaviour for an
empty or inverted region, so each landing is printed. It fixes no point at which a new offset takes
effect, so the old-to-new switch point of the twelve outstanding writes is printed, not asserted.

'''''

[[sec-375-smc_axi_inbound_ports_burst_test]]
===== 375 `smc_axi_inbound_ports_burst_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_axi_inbound_ports_burst_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`), SYS_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master
(`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_*`, `jtag_axi_agent`); a per-port
R-channel watcher on `s_axi_rvalid`/`rready`/`rlast`, `sys_axi_rvalid`/`rready`/`rlast` and
`jtag_axi_rvalid`/`rready`/`rlast` that records the beat count of every read burst; the inbound
filter probes `tb_inb_write_hit`, `tb_inb_read_hit`, `tb_inb_isolate_write` and
`tb_inb_isolate_read` counted on the SYS_IN watcher; `env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for the
observe-only reads; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the
bring-up wait; the scoreboard per-bus access counts for `SEP_IN AXI`, `SYS_IN AXI` and `JTAG AXI`;
the SPM memory window at `SMC_TOP_SPM_MEMORY_BASE_ADDR`, inbound filter entry 0 (`START_ADDR`,
`END_ADDR`, `FILTER_CONFIG`), outbound filter entry 1 (`START_ADDR`, `FILTER_CONFIG`),
`SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 and the read-only `CHIP_CONFIG` words (`VERSION_LO`, `VERSION_HI`,
`CHIP_ID`, `LC_STATE`)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Round trips and INCR bursts on all three inbound AXI ports.

*Test Coverage*:

* An 8-byte write with all eight strobes and an 8-byte read round trip through each of the three
  inbound ports, SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG, into the SPM window (`fabric.adoc`, Interfaces, AXI
  Interface Widths: 64-bit data, 8-bit strobe; the SPM window is plain read-write storage).
* INCR bursts of 2, 4 and 16 beats of 8 bytes into the SPM on each port: each beat reads back at its
  own address, the first and last beat singly and the whole burst as one INCR read of the same
  length, with RLAST on the last beat (`fabric.adoc`, Topology).
* A 256-beat INCR burst (AxLEN=255, 2 KiB inside one 4 KiB page) written and read back on SEP_IN,
  every beat compared in order, the longest INCR burst AXI4 allows.
* Observe-only reads on the register island over SEP_IN: a 4-beat read of 4-byte beats at
  `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, a 3-beat and a 4-beat read of 8-byte beats at outbound filter
  `FILTER_CONFIG` entry 1 whose fourth beat lies past its block extent, and 4-beat FIXED and WRAP
  reads. `fabric.adoc` names the converters but fixes no response for a burst at a register block,
  so the response codes and beats are printed and nothing is compared; each read must complete
  within the 50 000 ns guard with resolved data.
* After each FIXED and WRAP read a single read of `SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 returns the written
  0xC0DE_0103 with OKAY (`scratch.rdl`, `SCRATCH` read-write), so the burst left the register island
  usable.
* The inbound filter entry 0 is opened to pass everything for the run and restored to its register
  description reset values (`FILTER_CONFIG` 0x3000, `START_ADDR` 0x0, `END_ADDR` 0x7) at the end.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), start one R-channel
  watcher per port, then over SEP_IN write inbound filter entry 0 `START_ADDR` 0x0, `END_ADDR`
  0x00FF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFF and `FILTER_CONFIG` pass-all, write `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 with
  0xC0DE_0100 + i as 4-byte writes, and read the four `CHIP_CONFIG` words (OKAY required, values
  printed).
. On SEP_IN at the SPM window base plus 0x4_0000: write the 8-byte word 0x0123_4567_89AB_CDEF with
  wstrb 0xFF and read it back; then for 2, 4 and 16 beats write the INCR burst at offsets 0x100,
  0x200 and 0x400, read the first and last beat singly and the whole burst as one read, requiring
  OKAY, the exact beat values and exactly one read burst of the requested beats on the watcher.
. Repeat the same on SYS_IN at the window plus 0x1000 with the word 0xFEDC_BA98_7654_3210.
. Repeat the same on JTAG at the window plus 0x2000 with the word 0xA5A5_5A5A_C3C3_3C3C; then
  require no unresolved R-channel probe on SYS_IN.
. Write a 256-beat INCR burst at the SPM base plus 0x5_0000 on SEP_IN and read it back as one
  256-beat INCR read, requiring every beat equal and RLAST on beat 256.
. Add the register addresses to `expected_decerr_addrs` and issue on SEP_IN a 4-beat read of 4-byte
  beats at `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 and a 3-beat read of 8-byte beats at outbound filter
  `FILTER_CONFIG` entry 1, tolerating an error response; record each response and beat.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, outbound filter `FILTER_CONFIG` entry 1, whose fourth 8-byte beat
  (entry 1 `FILTER_CONFIG` plus 24) lies past the block extent. Kind: a 4-beat INCR read of 8-byte
  beats that crosses the block extent, tolerating an error response. Expected response: the read
  completes within the guard with resolved data; the response and beats are recorded and printed,
  not compared. Add the past-extent address to `expected_decerr_addrs` first and print the
  observe-only line for steps 6 and 7.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the register island at outbound filter `START_ADDR` entry 1 and
  `FILTER_CONFIG` entry 1. Kind: a 4-beat FIXED read and a 4-beat WRAP read at a register block,
  each tolerating an error response. Expected response: each read completes within the guard with
  resolved data, its response and beats printed and not compared, and after each a single read of
  `SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 returns 0xC0DE_0103 with OKAY.
. Restore inbound filter entry 0 (`FILTER_CONFIG` 0x3000, `START_ADDR` 0x0, `END_ADDR` 0x7) and
  write `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 with 0; stop the watchers, require every R burst closed with
  RLAST, the per-port access counts 41 on SEP_IN, 14 on SYS_IN and 14 on JTAG in both the sequence
  and the scoreboard, the nine step stamps in increasing order and the six checker lines in step
  order.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-IPB-WIDTH-ROUNDTRIP` |On each of SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG the 8-byte write with wstrb 0xFF
answers OKAY and the 8-byte read returns exactly the word written, with OKAY; the SYS_IN
inbound-filter hit and isolate cycle counts are printed on the same line, not compared
|`CHK-IPB-INCR-MEMORY` |On each port the 2-, 4- and 16-beat INCR writes answer OKAY, the first and
last beat read singly equal the beat written, and the whole-burst read returns every beat in order
as one burst of the requested length with RLAST on the last beat
|`CHK-IPB-INCR-256` |The 256-beat INCR read returns the 256 beats written, in order,
with OKAY and RLAST on beat 256
|`CHK-IPB-INCR-REG-OBS` |Measures and prints the response codes and beats of the 4-beat,
3-beat and block-crossing register-island reads without comparing them; the reads must
complete within the guard with resolved data
|`CHK-IPB-REJECT-READ-OBS` |Measures and prints the response and beats of the FIXED and the WRAP
read at the register island without comparing them; both must complete within the guard
|`CHK-IPB-REJECT-RECOVERY` |After the FIXED read and again after the WRAP read, a single read of
`SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 returns 0xC0DE_0103 with OKAY
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The nine steps were stamped in strictly increasing time and each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step; a control-flow invariant, with the per-port access
counts compared against the scoreboard
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at 200
000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns with no timeout allowed); the expiry of any
raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-IPB-WIDTH-ROUNDTRIP`, `CHK-IPB-INCR-MEMORY`, `CHK-IPB-INCR-256` and
`CHK-IPB-REJECT-RECOVERY` hold with exact word and beat compares and OKAY on every port, and the
per-port access counts of 41, 14 and 14 match the scoreboard. `CHK-IPB-INCR-REG-OBS` and
`CHK-IPB-REJECT-READ-OBS` record the register-island burst responses without comparing them.
Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The response codes and beats of the 4-beat, 3-beat and block-crossing
register-island reads and of the FIXED and WRAP reads are printed and not compared, because the
fabric document fixes no response for a burst at a register block. The SYS_IN inbound-filter hit
and isolate cycle counts and the four `CHIP_CONFIG` words are printed without a compare.

'''''

[[sec-376-smc_ext_window_routing_test]]
===== 376 `smc_ext_window_routing_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_ext_window_routing_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`) with per-access items that tolerate an
error response; per-access probe watcher on `clk_smc_i` sampling `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active`,
`tb_axil_external_arvalid`, `tb_axil_external_araddr`, `tb_axil_external_awvalid` and
`tb_axil_external_awaddr` from before the access until 8 `clk_smc_i` cycles after it completes;
`tb_axil_external_active` sampled idle before the first access; the reference integration's
AXI-Lite error terminator behind the supplementary region and the eFuse SHIM model behind
`efuse_bank_ctrl`; `env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for the accesses that may answer DECERR;
`tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; the
external window base (`smc_external`), the supplementary region base and the `STRAPS_LO` word of the
mandatory region

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: eFuse SHIM and external window accesses route to the right port.

*Test Coverage*:

* The eFuse SHIM range at the base of the `smc_external` window is routed to the eFuse controller
  and forwarded on `efuse_bank_ctrl`; it never appears on the external port (`memmap.adoc`, AXI-Lite
  External Window). The first SHIM word reads the `EFUSE_BANK_INIT_TIME` reset value 0x20
  (`init_time` reset in the reference SHIM model's `efuse_shim_ctrl.rdl`; `memmap.adoc` leaves the
  SHIM adopter-defined) with OKAY while `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` rises and no external AR or AW
  is presented.
* The last words of the SHIM range raise `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` and present nothing on the
  external port. `EFUSE_SHIM_SIZE` is a parameter that `memmap.adoc` does not give a value for, so
  the sequence measures the first word at which `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` stops rising by
  scanning reads upward in 4-byte steps and prints it, never comparing it with a stated value.
* The first address past the SHIM range keeps `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` low for the whole access;
  which block answers it is not stated, so its response, data and whether an external request
  appeared are printed.
* The supplementary region (`memmap.adoc`, AXI-Lite External Window; `smc_external.rdl`) is passed
  to the external port: a read and a write at its base each present a request carrying the
  address and answer DECERR from the reference integration's terminator.
* The mandatory region beyond the SHIM range and the supplementary region are treated identically
  by the hardware (`memmap.adoc`): a read at +4 and a write at +8 of each present on the external
  port the same number of address-matching AR and AW cycles and raise no eFuse activity.
* Return paths: a read of the strap word `STRAPS_LO` answers OKAY from the external port and a
  supplementary read answers DECERR (`memmap.adoc`, the reference integration terminates the region
  with DECERR); the data word returned with that DECERR is not fixed by any document, so the
  sequence prints it and does not compare it; the external port's R and B channels are not probed by the bench, so the
  response and data are observed at SEP_IN together with the AR address match on the port.
* The last word of the window is presented on the external port and the address one past the
  window top does not reach the eFuse leg; the window extent is not pinned, so the response and
  data of the past-window read are printed.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish, require `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active`, `tb_axil_external_active`,
  `tb_axil_external_arvalid` and `tb_axil_external_awvalid` all 0, then read the window upward from
  offset 4 in 4-byte steps (at most 256 reads, DECERR waived) until `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` does
  not rise, requiring no external request on any read that did raise it and a measured extent of
  at least 8; print the extent.
. Read the window base expecting `EFUSE_BANK_INIT_TIME` 0x20 with OKAY, `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active`
  high and no external AR or AW cycle.
. Read the measured extent minus 8 and minus 4, each requiring `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` high and
  no external AR or AW cycle; print the responses and data.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the first address past the measured SHIM extent. Kind: a read one
  word past the SHIM range, DECERR waived. Expected response: `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` stays low
  for the whole access; the response, data and whether an external AR appeared are printed.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the supplementary region base, terminated by the reference
  integration's AXI-Lite error terminator. Kind: a read, then a write of 0xA5A5_0001, into the
  terminated region. Expected response: DECERR on each, with an external AR and then an external AW
  carrying the address; the read data word is printed.
. For the mandatory region beyond the SHIM range (from `STRAPS_LO`) and for the supplementary
  region, read at +4 and write 0x5A5A_0002 at +8; require the external AR and AW address match in
  each, no eFuse activity, and the same AR and AW match counts in both regions; print the responses.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the supplementary region base. Kind: a read of the region the
  reference integration terminates with DECERR. Expected response: DECERR, its data printed. Before
  it, read `STRAPS_LO` requiring OKAY, an external AR carrying the address and no eFuse activity, and
  print the data.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the last word of the window (window base plus 0x3F_FFF8) and the
  address one past the window top (window base plus 0x40_0000). Kind: a read at the window edge,
  DECERR waived, and a read past the window. Expected response: the last word is presented on the
  external port with an AR carrying the address, and the past-window read keeps
  `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` low; both responses and data are printed. Then log the bounded waits
  and require the eight step stamps in increasing order, the seven checker lines in order, at least
  20 SEP_IN accesses issued, and the scoreboard to have checked at least as many SEP_IN items as
  were issued.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SHIM-BASE-ROUTED` |The read at the window base answers OKAY with the `EFUSE_BANK_INIT_TIME`
reset value 0x20 from the reference SHIM model's RDL (the SHIM is adopter-defined), raises
`tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` and produces no external AR or AW cycle
|`CHK-SHIM-LAST-WORD-ROUTED` |The reads at the measured extent minus 8 and minus 4 each raise
`tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` and produce no external AR or AW cycle; their responses and data are
printed, not compared, and the extent itself is measured, not compared with a stated size
|`CHK-SHIM-PAST-RANGE-NOT-EFUSE` |The read one word past the measured SHIM extent keeps
`tb_axil_efuse_bank_active` low for the whole access; its response, data and external-request level
are printed, since no document names the block that answers it
|`CHK-EXT-SUPPLEMENTARY-ROUTED` |The read and the write at the supplementary base each present an
external AR or AW carrying the address and answer DECERR
|`CHK-EXT-REGIONS-IDENTICAL` |The read at +4 and the write at +8 of the mandatory region beyond the
SHIM range and of the supplementary region are each presented on the external port with the same AR
and AW match counts in both regions and no eFuse activity; the responses are printed, not compared
|`CHK-EXT-RESPONSE-RETURN` |The `STRAPS_LO` read answers OKAY from the external port and the
supplementary read answers DECERR (`memmap.adoc`); the data returned with that DECERR is
printed and not compared, because no document fixes it; the strap data is printed with no pinned
value, and the response as driven on the port is not observable by the bench
|`CHK-EXT-WINDOW-TOP` |The last word of the window is presented on the external port and the read
one past the window top does not raise `tb_axil_efuse_bank_active`; the responses and data of both
reads are printed, since the window extent is not pinned
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits
at 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, each SEP_IN access at 50 000 ns, the extent scan at 256
reads, and the fixed 8-cycle probe drain that waits on no state); the expiry of any raises,
so the line is a record and not a compare
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The eight steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 20 SEP_IN accesses were issued; a
control-flow invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-SHIM-BASE-ROUTED`, `CHK-EXT-SUPPLEMENTARY-ROUTED`,
`CHK-EXT-REGIONS-IDENTICAL`,
`CHK-EXT-RESPONSE-RETURN` (its DECERR data word is printed, not compared) and the probe
conditions of `CHK-SHIM-LAST-WORD-ROUTED`,
`CHK-SHIM-PAST-RANGE-NOT-EFUSE` and `CHK-EXT-WINDOW-TOP` hold with the stated responses, data and
probe levels. The measured SHIM extent and the responses printed by the observe legs are recorded
without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The SHIM extent is measured by scanning and printed, not compared with a stated
size, because the memory map gives no value for `EFUSE_SHIM_SIZE`. The responses and data of the
last SHIM words, of the word past the SHIM range (no document names the block that answers it), of
the +4 and +8 accesses in both regions and of the window-top reads (the window extent is not
pinned) are printed, not compared. The data word returned with the supplementary DECERR and the
strap data are printed with no pinned value. The external port's R and B channels are not probed by
the bench, so the response as driven on the port is observed only at SEP_IN.

'''''

[[sec-377-smc_gap_decode_response_test]]
===== 377 `smc_gap_decode_response_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_gap_decode_response_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`), SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_*`,
`jtag_axi_agent`), all with items that tolerate an error response;
`env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs`
for every address that may answer DECERR; `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge
during the admission probe; inbound filter entry 0 (`START_ADDR`, `END_ADDR`, `FILTER_CONFIG`);
`tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; the local
and global bases at their `SMC_BASE_CONFIG` reset values; the unit apertures of `smc.rdl` (debug
module, outbound filter control, mailbox, DMA and zeroer control, CPU control)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Gap, SLVERR-window and debug aperture responses on all ports.

*Test Coverage*:

* The address gap between apertures answers DECERR (`memmap.adoc`, Address Space Organization;
  `smc.rdl`, `ocah_gap_resp`): the first and last word of the gap at offsets 0xC000 to 0xFFFF read
  DECERR with the error-slave word 0xBADCAB1E and write DECERR from SEP_IN at the local base.
* The gap at offsets 0x3_8300 to 0x3_8FFF between the zeroer and CPU control apertures gives the
  same responses for both directions.
* The same two gaps answer identically from SYS_IN and JTAG at the local base and from all three
  ports at the global base.
* The window at offsets 0x1_7000 to 0x1_7FFF is documented to answer writes with SLVERR
  (`memmap.adoc`);
  the register description declares DECERR for the gap, so the write response is printed and not
  compared, and each write must complete. Reads of the first and last window word must answer DECERR
  with 0xBADCAB1E.
* The window is bounded by its neighbours: the word just below it (offset 0x1_6200, past the
  outbound filter control extent) answers the unit's past-extent response, DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E
  for the read as declared by `smc.rdl` (`ocah_past_extent_resp`), and the word just above it
  (offset 0x1_8000, the mailbox base) reads OKAY (`smc.rdl`, mailbox placement); the write responses
  of both are printed.
* The window responses are the same from all three ports at both bases: the reads answer
  DECERR/0xBADCAB1E and the write response is equal in every port and base combination.
* The first, a middle and the last word of the debug-module aperture answer DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E
  for reads and DECERR for writes from all three ports at both bases (`smc.rdl`, debug module
  `ocah_hole_resp`; the aperture extent comes from the generated map and is not stated in a
  document).
* Inbound filter entry 0 is opened to pass everything for the run and restored to its register
  description reset values at the end, with a readback of each.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the three
  bring-up signals, write inbound filter entry 0 `START_ADDR` 0, `END_ADDR` 0x00FF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFF
