  and `FILTER_CONFIG` pass-all over SEP_IN as 8-byte writes, then read the local base from SYS_IN
  while sampling `tb_inb_read_hit` (bounded by 6 000 cycles), requiring OKAY and the hit bit seen.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN at the local base, the gap at offsets 0xC000 to 0xFFFF. Kind:
  reads of the first (0xC000) and last (0xFFF8) word of the gap. Expected response: DECERR with
  0xBADCAB1E.
. Error injection. Point: the same two gap words from SEP_IN at the local base. Kind: writes.
  Expected response: DECERR.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN at the local base, the gap at offsets 0x3_8300 to 0x3_8FFF between
  the zeroer and CPU control apertures. Kind: a read and a write of its first (0x3_8300) and last
  (0x3_8FF8) word. Expected response: DECERR on both directions and 0xBADCAB1E on the reads.
. Repeat steps 2 to 4 for the five other port and base combinations (SYS_IN and JTAG at the local
  base, SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG at the global base).
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN at the local base, the window at offsets 0x1_7000 to 0x1_7FFF.
  Kind: a write and a read of its first (0x1_7000) and last (0x1_7FF8) word. Expected response: the
  reads answer DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E; each write must complete and its response is printed, not
  compared.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN at the local base, the word at offset 0x1_6200 just below the
  window, past the outbound filter control extent. Kind: a read and a write past the unit's decoded
  extent. Expected response: the read answers DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E, after requiring the generated
  past-extent read response of the outbound filter control to be DECERR; the write response is
  printed. Then read the mailbox base above the window requiring OKAY, and write it, printing the
  response.
. Repeat step 6 for the five other port and base combinations and require every write response to
  equal the one seen from SEP_IN at the local base.
. Error injection. Point: the debug-module aperture, from each of the six port and base
  combinations. Kind: a read and a write of its first, a middle and its last 8-byte-aligned word.
  Expected response: DECERR on the writes and DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E on the reads.
. Restore inbound filter entry 0 `FILTER_CONFIG`, `END_ADDR` and `START_ADDR` to their register
  description reset values and read each back with an exact compare; log the bounded waits and
  require the nine step stamps in increasing order, the ten checker lines in order and at least 122
  SEP_IN-reachable accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-GAP-READ-DECERR` |The reads at offsets 0xC000 and 0xFFF8 from SEP_IN at the local base answer
DECERR with rdata 0xBADCAB1E, after the admission probe read answered OKAY with the filter hit seen
|`CHK-GAP-WRITE-DECERR` |The writes at offsets 0xC000 and 0xFFF8 from SEP_IN
at the local base answer DECERR
|`CHK-GAP-ZEROER-CPU-DECERR` |The reads at offsets 0x3_8300 and 0x3_8FF8 answer DECERR with
0xBADCAB1E and the writes answer DECERR
|`CHK-GAP-PORT-BASE-MATRIX` |Both gaps answer the reads (DECERR, 0xBADCAB1E) and
writes (DECERR) the same from SYS_IN and JTAG at the local base and from all three
ports at the global base, ten legs in all
|`CHK-SLVERR-WINDOW-WRITE-FIRST` |The write at offset 0x1_7000 completes; its response is printed
beside the SLVERR the memory map states and is not compared
|`CHK-SLVERR-WINDOW-WRITE-LAST` |The write at offset 0x1_7FF8 completes; its response is printed
beside the SLVERR the memory map states and is not compared
|`CHK-SLVERR-WINDOW-READ` |The reads at offsets 0x1_7000 and 0x1_7FF8 answer DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E
|`CHK-SLVERR-WINDOW-NEIGHBOURS` |The word below the window answers DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E for the
read and the mailbox base above it reads OKAY; the write responses of both are printed against their
declared responses and are not compared
|`CHK-SLVERR-WINDOW-PORT-BASE` |The window reads answer DECERR/0xBADCAB1E from all three ports at
both bases and the write response is equal across the six port and base combinations; its value is
recorded, not compared with an expected code
|`CHK-DEBUG-APERTURE-DECERR` |The first, a middle and the last word of the debug-module aperture
answer reads with DECERR and 0xBADCAB1E and writes with DECERR from all three ports at both bases
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The nine steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 122 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at 200
000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, the admission probe at 6 000 cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns with no
timeout allowed); the expiry of any raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every gap and debug-aperture read answers DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E and every such
write DECERR on all six port and base combinations, the window reads answer DECERR/0xBADCAB1E with
equal write responses across combinations, the neighbour reads answer DECERR and OKAY as stated, and
the access floor of 122 is met. The window and neighbour write responses are recorded, not compared
with an expected code. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The write responses of the window at offsets 0x1_7000 to 0x1_7FFF are printed and
not compared, because the memory map states SLVERR while the register description declares DECERR
for the gap; the write responses of the word below the window and of the mailbox base are likewise
printed. The debug-module aperture extent comes from the generated map and is not stated in a
document.

'''''

[[sec-378-smc_inbound_concurrency_limits_test]]
===== 378 `smc_inbound_concurrency_limits_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_inbound_concurrency_limits_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) issuing outstanding
groups of 4 to 33 reads; SYS_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and
JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_agent`) started in the same `clk_smc_i` cycle for the concurrent legs;
a stall watcher on the SEP_IN handshakes (`SmcAxiPortWatch` on `s_axi`) counting stalled AR, R, AW
and B cycles; `env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for the DECERR reads; `tb_fuse_sense_done`,
`tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; the scoreboard exact-value
compare count (`sys_axi_value_checks_seen`); registers inbound filter entry 0, `SCRATCH_COLD` and
`WARM_SCRATCH` words 0 to 7, the SPM words at `SMC_TOP_SPM_MEMORY_BASE_ADDR` plus 0x8_0000,
`REGION_SIZE` and `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, GPIO interface 0 `ACCESS_FILTER`,
`AVS_CFG_0` and the system timer `OCTS_CTRL`; the unmapped page just below the M-mode region and the
outside-window address 0x8000_0000

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Outstanding limits and concurrent reads on inbound ports.

*Test Coverage*:

* Outstanding reads at and one past each documented fabric limit (`fabric.adoc`, SMC Fabric
  Transaction Limits): 32 per AXI ID bucket in the fabric demultiplexers, 32 for each error
  subordinate, 8 per manager and subordinate of the local AXI4 crossbar and 4 for the AXI4-Lite
  crossbar. Groups of 32, and of 33 on one AXI ID, over 32 distinct seeded registers; 32 and 33
  reads of the unmapped page; 8 and 9 reads of one scratch register; 4 and 5 reads of four
  registers on the AXI4-Lite side. Every read must complete within the guard with its own
  register's value or DECERR, so a dropped, merged or mis-routed response fails; the limit itself is
  observed through the stall cycles, which are printed and not asserted.
* Two outstanding reads on one port, one inside the window and one at an address outside it
  (`memmap.adoc`, Address Space Organization), are each answered by their own address, in both issue
  orders and on both SYS_IN and SEP_IN.
* Reads issued simultaneously from two and from all three inbound ports to distinct targets, to the
  same target, and with one port reading an address that answers DECERR beside another port's
  valid read: each returns its own value or DECERR.
* A read and a write issued together on SEP_IN: the read returns `REGION_SIZE` and the write is read
  back.
* Registers return their register-description reset values (`smc.rdl`, `REGION_SIZE` reset
  0x0100_0000) and every seeded or programmed word is restored at the end.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, require the `REGION_SIZE` reset to be 0x0100_0000, seed `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 7 with
  0xC0DE_0900 + i, `WARM_SCRATCH` words 0 to 7 with 0xC0DE_0A00 + i and 16 SPM words, program
  inbound filter entry 0 pass-all and read its `FILTER_CONFIG` back, and start the SEP_IN stall
  watcher.
. Issue 32 outstanding SEP_IN reads cycling over the 32 seeded registers, then 33 on one AXI ID,
  requiring each to return its own register's value with OKAY.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the unmapped page just below the M-mode region. Kind: 32 and then
  33 outstanding reads on distinct AXI IDs, at and one past the error subordinate's limit. Expected
  response: DECERR on each within the guard.
. Issue 8 and then 9 outstanding SEP_IN reads of `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, requiring 0xC0DE_0900.
. Issue 4 and then 5 outstanding SEP_IN reads cycling over GPIO 0 `ACCESS_FILTER`, `AVS_CFG_0`,
  `OCTS_CTRL` and `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL`, requiring each register's reset value.
. Error injection. Point: SYS_IN and then SEP_IN, the outside-window address 0x8000_0000. Kind: a
  read outside the window issued in one outstanding group with a `REGION_SIZE` read, in both orders.
  Expected response: DECERR for the outside read and OKAY with 0x0100_0000 for the `REGION_SIZE`
  read, each answered by its own address.
. Start reads in the same cycle from SEP_IN and SYS_IN, from SEP_IN and JTAG, from SYS_IN and JTAG,
  and from all three with the targets (`REGION_SIZE`, `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL`)
  rotated, each bounded by 50 000 ns, requiring each port's own target value.
. Start `REGION_SIZE` reads from all three ports in the same cycle, requiring OKAY with 0x0100_0000
  on each.
. Error injection. Point: one port of each of the six ordered port pairs, at 0x8000_0000 on SEP_IN
  and SYS_IN or the unmapped page on JTAG. Kind: a read that answers DECERR started in the same cycle
  as the other port's `REGION_SIZE` read. Expected response: DECERR beside OKAY with 0x0100_0000.
. Issue a `REGION_SIZE` read and a write of 0xC0DE_0B11 to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 1 together on SEP_IN,
  require OKAY on both and read the word back as 0xC0DE_0B11.
. In the teardown write 0 to the scratch and warm scratch words, restore inbound filter entry 0 to
  its register description reset values and read `FILTER_CONFIG` back, stop the stall watcher and
  print the stall totals; log the bounded waits and require the ten step stamps in increasing order,
  the nine checker lines in order, at least 247 accesses and at least 115 scoreboard exact-value
  compares.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-LIMIT-FABRIC-32` |The 32 outstanding SEP_IN reads of 32 distinct registers and the 33 reads on
one AXI ID all complete OKAY within the guard, each with its own register's value; the stall cycles
are printed and the limit is not asserted
|`CHK-LIMIT-ERRSLV-32` |The 32 and the 33 outstanding SEP_IN reads of the unmapped page on distinct
AXI IDs all answer DECERR within the guard; the stall cycles are printed, not compared
|`CHK-LIMIT-LOCAL-XBAR-8` |The 8 and the 9 outstanding SEP_IN reads of `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 all
return 0xC0DE_0900 within the guard; the stall cycles are printed, not compared
|`CHK-LIMIT-AXIL-XBAR-4` |The 4 and the 5 outstanding SEP_IN reads of the four AXI4-Lite-side
registers all return their register-description reset values within the guard; the stall
cycles are printed, not compared
|`CHK-SAME-PORT-OUTSTANDING` |On SYS_IN and on SEP_IN a `REGION_SIZE` read (OKAY, 0x0100_0000) and a
read of 0x8000_0000 (DECERR) in one outstanding group are each answered by their own address, with
the out-of-window read first and second
|`CHK-CONCURRENT-DISTINCT-TARGETS` |Simultaneous reads from SEP_IN and SYS_IN,
SEP_IN and JTAG, SYS_IN and JTAG, and from all three with the targets rotated, each
return the value of their own target
|`CHK-CONCURRENT-SAME-TARGET` |Simultaneous `REGION_SIZE` reads from SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG
all return OKAY with 0x0100_0000
|`CHK-CONCURRENT-DECERR-BESIDE-VALID` |For each of the six ordered port pairs a read answers DECERR
while the other port's simultaneous `REGION_SIZE` read returns OKAY with 0x0100_0000
|`CHK-CONCURRENT-READ-WRITE` |A `REGION_SIZE` read and a `SCRATCH_COLD` word 1 write issued together
on SEP_IN both answer OKAY, the read returns 0x0100_0000 and the write reads back 0xC0DE_0B11
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The ten steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was printed
in order and no earlier than its step, and the access floor of 247 and the scoreboard's floor of 115
exact-value compares were reached; a control-flow invariant that catches a truncated run
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at
200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns with no timeout allowed, each
concurrent join at 50 000 ns, the watcher join at 1 000 ns); the expiry of any raises, so the
line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every outstanding and concurrent read returns its own register's reset or seeded
value, or DECERR where the address is unmapped or outside the window, in every group and in every
port combination, the read and write on SEP_IN complete, and the scoreboard books at least 115
exact-value compares over at least 247 accesses. The stall cycles at each limit are recorded without
an expected count. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The stall cycles at each outstanding limit are printed and not asserted; the limit
itself is only observed, every read being required to complete with its own value or DECERR.

'''''

[[sec-379-smc_inbound_outside_window_decerr_test]]
===== 379 `smc_inbound_outside_window_decerr_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_inbound_outside_window_decerr_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) and SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`), 4-byte accesses that tolerate an
error response; `env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for every address expected to answer DECERR;
a passive probe watcher on `clk_smc_i` counting the cycles of `tb_output_axi_awvalid`,
`tb_output_axi_arvalid`, `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 and `tb_inb_write_hit` bit 0, and counting
unresolved samples; the output responder counters (`tb_output_axi_write_count`,
`tb_output_axi_read_count`); `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for
the bring-up wait; registers inbound filter entry 0 (`START_ADDR`, `END_ADDR`, `FILTER_CONFIG`),
`REGION_SIZE` of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG` and `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, at the reset `LOCAL_BASE` and
`GLOBAL_BASE`; the first and last words of the M-mode and Xvisor regions

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: DECERR outside both windows and at BASE+REGION_SIZE.

*Test Coverage*:

* Both inbound apertures are sized by `REGION_SIZE`, which resets to 16 MiB (`memmap.adoc`, Memory
  Map; `smc_base_config.rdl`, `REGION_SIZE` reset 0x0100_0000): a read and a write at
  `BASE + REGION_SIZE` answer DECERR from SEP_IN and SYS_IN at both the local and the global base,
  and the read data is printed.
* The word just below each base answers DECERR for a read and a write on both ports
  (`memmap.adoc`; `fabric.adoc`, Fabric Topology).
* The last word below `BASE + REGION_SIZE` is routed to the local fabric rather than refused by the
  region demux: it is answered within the guard on both ports at both bases with no request on the
  output interface. Which response comes back is not separated from a region-demux DECERR by the
  bench, so the response and data are printed and not compared.
* Addresses outside both windows answer DECERR for a read and a write on both ports: below the local
  window (0x0000_1000), between the windows (0x8000_0000), above both (0xD000_0000) and a 56-bit
  address above 4 GiB (0x0000_0100_0000_0000); the read data is printed.
* No refused access reaches the output interface: `tb_output_axi_awvalid`/`arvalid` cycle counts and
  the output write and read counters do not move across the DECERR accesses, while an in-window
  read of `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, seeded with a non-zero pattern over SEP_IN, moves
  `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 so the observation is live.
* At the reset `REGION_SIZE` the first and last word of the M-mode and Xvisor regions lie beyond
  both windows and answer DECERR for reads and writes on both ports at both bases (`memmap.adoc`: an
  address inside neither aperture answers DECERR, and the remap regions forward accesses from SMC
  initiators only).
* Inbound filter entry 0 is opened to pass everything for the run and restored to its register
  description reset values at the end, with a readback of `FILTER_CONFIG`.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, start the probe watcher, register every expected DECERR address, program inbound filter
  entry 0 pass-all over SEP_IN and read its `FILTER_CONFIG` back.
. Sample the output counters and valid cycle counts, read `REGION_SIZE` on SEP_IN and SYS_IN
  requiring its reset 0x0100_0000, then read `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 at both bases on both ports
  requiring the pattern seeded in step 1 and require `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 to have moved.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, `BASE + REGION_SIZE` at the local and the global base.
  Kind: a read and a write at the first address past each aperture. Expected response: DECERR on
  every access.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, the word 4 bytes below each base. Kind: a read and a
  write just below the aperture. Expected response: DECERR.
. Read and write the last word below `BASE + REGION_SIZE` at both bases on both ports; print the
  responses and read data, and require no change in the output `awvalid` and `arvalid` cycle counts.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, the four outside-window classes (0x0000_1000,
  0x8000_0000, 0xD000_0000 and 0x0000_0100_0000_0000). Kind: a read and a write at each. Expected
  response: DECERR; the read data is printed.
. Read `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 over SYS_IN requiring the seeded pattern and `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 to have moved, then
  require the output counters and `awvalid`/`arvalid` cycle counts unchanged from step 2 and no
  unresolved probe sample.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, the first and last word of the M-mode and Xvisor
  regions at both bases, beyond both windows at the reset `REGION_SIZE`. Kind: a read and a write at
  each. Expected response: DECERR, with the output interface still silent.
. Restore inbound filter entry 0 `FILTER_CONFIG`, `START_ADDR` and `END_ADDR` to their register
  description reset values and read `FILTER_CONFIG` back with an exact compare; log the bounded
  waits and require the eight step stamps in increasing order, the six checker lines in order and at
  least 90 accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-REGION-SIZE-LIMIT-DECERR` |`REGION_SIZE` reads 0x0100_0000 on both ports, the in-window
`SCRATCH_COLD` control reads the seeded pattern at both bases on both ports, and the read and write at `BASE +
REGION_SIZE` answer DECERR on SEP_IN and SYS_IN at both bases; the read data is printed
|`CHK-BELOW-BASE-DECERR` |The read and the write at the word below the local base and below the
global base answer DECERR on both ports
|`CHK-WINDOW-LAST-WORD-ROUTED` |The read and the write at the last word below `BASE + REGION_SIZE`
are answered within the guard on both ports at both bases with the output `awvalid` and `arvalid`
cycle counts unchanged; the responses and read data are printed, not compared
|`CHK-OUTSIDE-WINDOW-DECERR` |The read and the write at each of the four outside-window address
classes answer DECERR on both ports; the read data is printed, not compared
|`CHK-OUTSIDE-NO-OUTPUT-REQUEST` |Across the DECERR accesses the output `awvalid` and `arvalid`
cycle counts and the write and read counters stay unchanged with no unresolved probe sample, while
the in-window control read returns the seeded pattern and moves `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0
|`CHK-REMAP-REGION-RESET-DECERR` |At the reset `REGION_SIZE` the first and last word of the
M-mode and Xvisor regions answer DECERR to a read and a write on both ports at both bases, with
the output interface still silent
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The eight steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 90 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at 200
000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns with no timeout allowed; the probe watcher
waits on nothing); the expiry of any raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every read and write at `BASE + REGION_SIZE`, below each base, in the four outside
classes and in the M-mode and Xvisor regions answers DECERR on both ports at both bases, the
in-window controls return the seeded pattern and `REGION_SIZE` returns 0x0100_0000, the output interface sees no
request, and at least 90 accesses are issued. The last-word responses and every printed read
data are recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The read data of the DECERR accesses at `BASE + REGION_SIZE` and in the four
outside-window classes is printed and not compared. The responses and read data of the last word
below `BASE + REGION_SIZE` are printed, not compared, because the bench does not separate that
answer from a region-demux DECERR.

'''''

[[sec-380-smc_inbound_window_port_matrix_test]]
===== 380 `smc_inbound_window_port_matrix_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_inbound_window_port_matrix_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`), SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_*`,
`jtag_axi_agent`); `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 and `tb_inb_isolate_read` sampled on every `clk_smc_i`
edge during the admission probe; a passive watcher on `tb_output_axi_awvalid` and
`tb_output_axi_arvalid` through the window-word step; a second watcher on `tb_remap_jtag_ar_hit` and
`tb_remap_jtag_aw_hit`, counted while `jtag_axi_arvalid` or `jtag_axi_awvalid` is high;
`env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for the last-word accesses; `tb_fuse_sense_done`,
`tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; registers inbound filter entry
0, `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, core 0 watchdog `CTRL` at the
local base, the SPM word at base plus 0xE_0000, the last window word at base plus 0xFF_FFF8 and
`SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3, at the local base 0xC000_0000 and the global base 0x4000_0000

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Window reads and storage on all three ports at both bases.

*Test Coverage*:

* The local base reads back as itself from every inbound port: `LOCAL_BASE` reads 0xC000_0000 from
  SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG at the local base (`smc_base_config.rdl`, `LOCAL_BASE` reset;
  `memmap.adoc`, Memory Map).
* The three base registers sit at their own offsets and do not alias: `GLOBAL_BASE` 0x4000_0000 at
  +0x0, `LOCAL_BASE` 0xC000_0000 at +0x8 and `REGION_SIZE` 0x0100_0000 at +0x10 of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG`
  read from each port (`smc_base_config.rdl` resets; `fabric.adoc`, Fabric Topology).
* Both bases reach the same resources (`memmap.adoc`): the same three reads at the global base
  return values equal to the local-base reads on every port, with OKAY, never DECERR.
* On SYS_IN and SEP_IN at each base the first window word reads the core 0 watchdog `CTRL` register
  description reset 0 and keeps it after a write of 0 (both data compares cannot fail on this
  two-state bench; the OKAY responses are the decode evidence), a pattern written to a middle word of the SPM
  reads back exactly, and neither is refused by the region demux; no request appears on the output
  interface. The last window word is unmapped and its response is not separated from a
  region-demux DECERR by the bench, so it is answered within the guard and printed, not compared.
* A value written through one base is read back through the other, from a different port, for each
  of SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG as the writer, so the two bases address one storage and the input
  multiplexer merges the initiators (`fabric.adoc`, Fabric Topology).
* JTAG at both bases reads `REGION_SIZE` 0x0100_0000 and writes and reads `SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 at
  its own address; the alias remap is at reset and transparent (`fabric.adoc`, Alias Remapping), so
  the data lands untranslated. The remap hit vectors the bench lifts are not described by any
  document, so they are sampled and printed, not compared.
* Inbound filter entry 0 is opened to pass everything for the run and restored with the scratch
  words at the end.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, write inbound filter entry 0 `START_ADDR` 0, `END_ADDR` 0x00FF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFF and
  `FILTER_CONFIG` pass-all over SEP_IN, then read the local base from SYS_IN while sampling
  `tb_inb_read_hit` (bounded by 6 000 cycles), requiring OKAY and the hit bit seen.
. At the local base read `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` from SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG,
  each with an exact compare against 0x4000_0000, 0xC000_0000 and 0x0100_0000.
. Repeat the nine reads at the global base and require every value equal to the local-base read of
  the same register and port.
. Error injection. Point: SYS_IN and then SEP_IN at each base, the last window word at base plus
  0xFF_FFF8. Kind: a read and a write of the unmapped last window word, tolerating an error
  response. Expected response: answered within the guard with no request on the output interface;
  the response is printed. In the same pass, with the output watcher running: read core 0 watchdog
  `CTRL` expecting 0, write 0 to it and read it back; write a distinct 8-byte pattern to the SPM
  word at base plus 0xE_0000 and read it back exactly; then require `tb_output_axi_awvalid` and
  `arvalid` never high.
. Write 4-byte patterns to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 through SEP_IN at the local base and read them
  through SYS_IN and JTAG at the global base; word 1 through SYS_IN at the global base, read through
  JTAG and SEP_IN at the local base; word 2 through JTAG at the local base, read through SEP_IN and
  SYS_IN at the global base; each read is an exact compare.
. With the remap watcher running, for each base read `REGION_SIZE` from JTAG requiring 0x0100_0000,
  write a pattern to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 and read it back exactly; require the remap hit probes to
  have been sampled while a JTAG request was valid and print their values.
. Write 0 to `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 and read each back expecting 0; restore inbound filter
  entry 0 `FILTER_CONFIG`, `END_ADDR` and `START_ADDR` to their register description reset values
  and read each back with an exact compare; log the bounded waits and require the seven step stamps
  in increasing order, the seven checker lines in order and at least 79 accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-WIN-LOCAL-BASEREG-PORTS` |`LOCAL_BASE` reads 0xC000_0000 with OKAY from SEP_IN, SYS_IN and
JTAG at the local base, after the admission probe read answered OKAY with the filter hit seen
|`CHK-WIN-LOCAL-REGS-PORTS` |`GLOBAL_BASE` reads 0x4000_0000 at +0x0, `LOCAL_BASE`
0xC000_0000 at +0x8 and `REGION_SIZE` 0x0100_0000 at +0x10 from each of the three ports,
each offset returning its own register
|`CHK-WIN-GLOBAL-RESET-PORTS` |The same three reads at the global base return the same values on
each port, equal to the local-base reads, all OKAY
|`CHK-SYS-SEP-WINDOW-WORDS` |On SYS_IN and SEP_IN at both bases the first window word reads the
watchdog `CTRL` reset 0 and again 0 after the write (data compares that cannot fail on this
two-state bench; the OKAY responses are the decode evidence), the middle SPM word returns the written
pattern, and `tb_output_axi_awvalid` and `arvalid` are never high; the last word is answered within
the guard and its response and data are printed, not compared
|`CHK-WIN-CROSS-BASE-STORAGE` |A `SCRATCH_COLD` pattern written through one base is read back
exactly through the other base from two different ports, for the writers SEP_IN (word 0),
SYS_IN (word 1) and JTAG (word 2)
|`CHK-JTAG-LOCAL-WINDOW` |JTAG reads `REGION_SIZE` 0x0100_0000 and writes and reads back
`SCRATCH_COLD` word 3 at both bases; the remap hit vectors sampled while a JTAG request is
valid are printed, not compared
|`CHK-JTAG-CROSS-PORT-STORAGE` |The word JTAG wrote is read exactly through SEP_IN and SYS_IN, and
the words SEP_IN and SYS_IN wrote are read exactly through JTAG
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The seven steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 79 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at
200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, the admission probe at 6 000 cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns
with no timeout allowed, the watcher joins at one clock edge); the expiry of any raises, so the
line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: the base registers read their reset values from every port at both bases, the first
window word and the middle SPM word behave as stated with no output request, the cross-base and
cross-port patterns read back exactly, JTAG reads `REGION_SIZE` and its scratch word back at both
bases, and at least 79 accesses are issued. The last-word responses and the remap hit vectors are
recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The response and data of the last window word are printed and not compared, because
the bench does not separate that answer from a region-demux DECERR. The remap hit vectors sampled
during the JTAG requests are printed, not compared, because no document describes them. The
watchdog `CTRL` compares against 0 cannot fail on this two-state bench; the OKAY responses are the
decode evidence.

'''''

[[sec-381-smc_instance_storage_isolation_test]]
===== 381 `smc_instance_storage_isolation_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_instance_storage_isolation_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) for every register
array; SYS_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master
(`jtag_axi_*`, `jtag_axi_agent`) for the port step; the scoreboard per-bus access counts for
`SEP_IN AXI`, `SYS_IN AXI` and `JTAG AXI`; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and
`tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` required high after the bring-up wait; registers `SCRATCH_COLD` and
`SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` words 0 to 7 of `misc_wrap`, alias remap `REGION_START` entries 0 to 7, M-mode
and Xvisor remap `REGION_ATTRS` entries 0 to 7, inbound and outbound filter control `START_ADDR`
entries 0 to 15, the 65 `GPIO_INTF` `ACCESS_FILTER` entries, and inbound filter entry 0 for the
port step

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: Write-all-then-read-all isolation of each register array.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every instance of an array keeps its own storage: all instances are written with distinct patterns
  before any is read, so a stride that aliases two instances returns a neighbour's pattern and fails
  an exact compare, and each instance is restored and read back at the end.
* `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 7 (`scratch.rdl`, `SCRATCH[8]`, read-write 32-bit; `memmap.adoc`, Spare
  SMC Register Blocks).
* `SCRATCH_COLD` and `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` (`misc_wrap.rdl`) are separate blocks: with both resident,
  no index of one holds a pattern written to the other.
* The eight alias remap `REGION_START` registers at a 0x20 stride hold their own address field
  (`alias_remap.rdl`, `start_addr` [55:12]; `smc.rdl`, array placement).
* The eight M-mode and eight Xvisor remap `REGION_ATTRS` offset fields (`smc.rdl` arrays, enable
  bits clear) hold their own patterns and neither array shows the other's.
* The sixteen inbound and sixteen outbound filter control `START_ADDR` registers at a 0x20 stride
  hold their own patterns and neither array shows the other's (`smc.rdl`); `FILTER_CONFIG` is not
  touched.
* The 65 `GPIO_INTF` `ACCESS_FILTER` registers at a 0x10 stride each hold their own AWPROT and
  ARPROT requirement fields (`gpio_intf.rdl`), in two rounds of different distinct pairs with the
  filter enables clear.
* A 32-bit `SCRATCH_COLD` word written through an 8-byte write with strobe 0x0F from each of SEP_IN,
  SYS_IN and JTAG is read back exactly by all three ports, and the next word stays 0.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles) and require
  `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` all high.
. Write eight distinct 32-bit patterns to `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 7, read all eight back with an
  exact compare, write 0 to all and read 0 back.
. Write eight distinct patterns to `SCRATCH_COLD` and eight different ones to `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM`,
  read all sixteen back exactly, require no index to hold the other block's pattern, then restore
  both blocks to 0 with a readback.
. Write eight distinct address-field patterns to alias remap `REGION_START` entries 0 to 7, read all
  back exactly, restore 0 and read it back.
. Write distinct offset patterns to the eight M-mode and eight Xvisor `REGION_ATTRS` entries, read
  all sixteen back exactly, require no cross-array pattern, restore 0 and read it back.
. Write distinct 64-bit patterns to the sixteen inbound and sixteen outbound `START_ADDR` entries,
  read all thirty-two back exactly, require no cross-array pattern, restore the `START_ADDR`
  register description reset value and read it back.
. Write distinct protection patterns to all 65 `GPIO_INTF` `ACCESS_FILTER` entries and read all back
  exactly, then repeat with a second distinct pairing; restore the reset word and read it back.
. Program inbound filter entry 0 pass-all and read `FILTER_CONFIG` back; from each of SEP_IN, SYS_IN
  and JTAG write a distinct pattern to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 as an 8-byte write with strobe 0x0F,
  read it back exactly through all three ports, and require `SCRATCH_COLD` word 1 to read 0; restore
  word 0 and the inbound filter entry to their register description reset values with readbacks.
. Log the bounded waits and require the nine step stamps in increasing order, the seven checker
  lines in order, at least 700 accesses over the three ports and, per port, a scoreboard access
  count no lower than the number issued.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-SCRATCH-COLD-ISOLATION` |With all eight `SCRATCH_COLD` words resident each reads back exactly
its own pattern, and after the restore each reads 0
|`CHK-SCRATCH-COLD-WARM-SEPARATE` |With `SCRATCH_COLD` and `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` both resident each
index reads its own pattern and none holds the other block's pattern
|`CHK-ALIAS-REMAP-ISOLATION` |The eight alias remap `REGION_START` registers at a 0x20 stride each
read back exactly their own pattern with all eight resident, and read 0 after the restore
|`CHK-OUTPUT-REMAP-ISOLATION` |The eight M-mode and eight Xvisor `REGION_ATTRS` offset fields
each read back their own pattern, no M-mode pattern appears in the Xvisor array or the reverse,
and all read 0 after the restore
|`CHK-FILTER-CTRL-ISOLATION` |The sixteen inbound and sixteen outbound `START_ADDR`
registers each read back their own pattern with no cross-array pattern, and read
their reset value after the restore
|`CHK-GPIO-INSTANCE-ISOLATION` |All 65 `GPIO_INTF` `ACCESS_FILTER` registers each read their own
protection pattern with all resident in two rounds, and read the reset word after the restore
|`CHK-SCRATCH-32BIT-PORTS` |A 32-bit pattern written to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 by an 8-byte write
with strobe 0x0F from each of SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG reads back exactly through all three ports,
word 1 stays 0 after each, and word 0 reads 0 after the restore
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The nine steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 700 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at 200
000 `clk_smc_i` cycles and each port's AXI accesses at 50 000 ns); the expiry of any raises, so the
line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every instance of every array reads back exactly its own pattern with all instances
resident, no cross-block or cross-array pattern appears, every restore reads back its reset value,
the three ports read back the 32-bit scratch word, and at least 700 accesses are issued with the
scoreboard counting at least as many on each port as the sequence issued. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.

'''''

[[sec-382-smc_invalid_probe_recovery_test]]
===== 382 `smc_invalid_probe_recovery_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_invalid_probe_recovery_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`), SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_*`,
`jtag_axi_agent`), 4-byte probes that tolerate an error response;
`env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs`
for the SEP_IN probe addresses; `tb_inb_read_hit` bit 0 sampled on every `clk_smc_i` edge during the
admission read; `tb_fuse_sense_done`, `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the
bring-up wait; registers inbound filter entry 0, `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE`, `REGION_SIZE` and
`CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0; the outside-window addresses
0xBFFF_FFFC, 0x8000_0000, 0xD000_0000 and 0x0000_0100_0000_0000 and the gap addresses at offsets
0xC000, 0x3_8300 and 0x1_6200 from the local base and the first address past the core 0 watchdog's
decoded extent

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Valid accesses answer OKAY after DECERR probe runs.

*Test Coverage*:

* Runs of 1, 32 and 33 back-to-back DECERR probes, alternating read and write, from SEP_IN and
  SYS_IN at addresses outside both windows (`memmap.adoc`, Address Space Organization): every probe
  answers DECERR, and the next three reads of `GLOBAL_BASE` 0x4000_0000, `LOCAL_BASE` 0xC000_0000
  and `REGION_SIZE` 0x0100_0000 (`smc_base_config.rdl` resets) answer OKAY with those values. The
  run lengths straddle the 32-transaction limit of the error subordinate (`fabric.adoc`, SMC Fabric
  Transaction Limits).
* The same runs from SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG at addresses inside the window but in a gap or past a
  unit's decoded extent, followed by a `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` read that answers OKAY with its
  register description reset value 0x1F00_0000 (`smc_base_config.rdl`).
* A write followed by reads of `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 through SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG returns the
  written word after the probe runs (`scratch.rdl`, read-write).
* A run of 33 consecutive gap probes on SEP_IN answers DECERR on every read and write, with every
  read returning the error-slave word 0xBADCAB1E and each probe finishing inside the 50 000 ns
  guard.
* Inbound filter entry 0 is opened to pass everything for the run and restored to its register
  description reset values at the end, with a readback of each.
* The read data of the probes in the runs is printed, not compared, because no document fixes it
  outside the mixed run.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, program inbound filter entry 0 pass-all over SEP_IN, then read `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` from
  SYS_IN expecting 0x1F00_0000 while sampling `tb_inb_read_hit` (bounded by 6 000 cycles), requiring
  OKAY and the hit bit seen.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and then SYS_IN, the four outside-window addresses. Kind: runs of
  1, 32 and 33 back-to-back probes, even probes reads and odd probes writes. Expected response:
  DECERR on each; after each run `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` read OKAY with
  0x4000_0000, 0xC000_0000 and 0x0100_0000.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, SYS_IN and then JTAG, the four gap and past-extent addresses
  inside the window. Kind: runs of 1, 32 and 33 back-to-back probes. Expected response: DECERR on
  each; after each run `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` reads OKAY with 0x1F00_0000.
. Write 0x5A3C_96E1 to `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 over SEP_IN and read it back, read it back from SYS_IN
  and JTAG, and restore it to 0 and read 0 back; every access OKAY with exact values.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN, the gap addresses at offsets 0xC000, 0x3_8300 and 0x1_6200. Kind:
  33 consecutive probes cycling the three addresses, alternating read and write. Expected response:
  DECERR on each, 0xBADCAB1E on each read, and each probe finishing within 50 000 ns.
. Restore inbound filter entry 0 `FILTER_CONFIG`, `END_ADDR` and `START_ADDR` to their register
  description reset values and read each back with an exact compare; log the bounded waits and
  require the five step stamps in increasing order, the four checker lines in order and at least 406
  accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-RECOVERY-OUTSIDE-WINDOW` |After each of the runs of 1, 32 and 33 outside-window probes from
SEP_IN and SYS_IN, every probe answered DECERR and `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE`
read OKAY with 0x4000_0000, 0xC000_0000 and 0x0100_0000, after the admission read answered OKAY with
the filter hit seen; the probe read data is printed, not compared
|`CHK-RECOVERY-GAP-PAST-EXTENT` |After each of the runs of 1, 32 and 33 gap and past-extent probes
from SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG, every probe answered DECERR and `CLOCK_GATE_CONTROL` read OKAY with
0x1F00_0000; the probe read data is printed, not compared
|`CHK-RECOVERY-WRITE-READBACK` |The `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 write answers OKAY and the word reads back
as 0x5A3C_96E1 through SEP_IN, SYS_IN and JTAG, and reads 0 after the restore
|`CHK-GAP-RUN-BOUNDED` |33 consecutive gap probes on SEP_IN all answer DECERR within the guard, the
reads returning 0xBADCAB1E; the worst measured latency is printed
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The five steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 406 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits at 200
000 `clk_smc_i` cycles, the admission read at 6 000 cycles, each AXI access at 50 000 ns with no
timeout allowed); the expiry of any raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every probe in every run answers DECERR, every valid read after a run answers OKAY
with its register description reset value or written word, the mixed run's reads return 0xBADCAB1E
inside the guard, and at least 406 accesses are issued. The probe read data of the 1-, 32- and
33-probe runs and the worst mixed-run latency are recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The read data of the probes in the 1-, 32- and 33-probe runs is printed and not
compared, because no document fixes it outside the mixed run; the worst measured latency of the
mixed run is printed.

'''''

[[sec-383-smc_outstage_order_test]]
===== 383 `smc_outstage_order_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_outstage_order_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) for register
programming; JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_agent`) for the traffic, including a two-write group and a
write left in flight; the SMC DMA frontdoor (`DMA_CTRL` `CONFIG` `ENABLED_ND` bit 10, `DONE_0`,
`NEXT_ID_0`, `STATUS_0`, destination, source, length, stride and repetition words); the reset agent
(`reset_agent` sequencer) driving the cold reset with its asserted and released states waited on
`powergood`, `rst_cold_stable_ref_clk_n`, `rst_primary_ref_clk_n`, `rst_primary_smc_clk_n` and
`rst_wdt_smc_clk_n`; SYS_OUT responder memory (`sys_out_mem`, sentinel seed
0x5A5A_5A5A_5A5A_5A5A and backdoor readback); a watcher on `clk_smc_i` sampling
`tb_output_axi_awvalid`, `awready`, `awaddr`, `wvalid`, `arvalid`, `bvalid` and `bready`; the output
responder counters `tb_output_axi_write_count` and `tb_output_axi_read_count`;
`tb_output_axi_resp_hold` to hold the output responses; `tb_fuse_sense_done` (waited high at start
and low after the reset on `clk_ref_i`), `tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n`; registers
M-mode and Xvisor output remap `REGION_ATTRS` entry 0, alias remap `REGION_START`, `REGION_END` and
`REGION_ATTRS` region 2, and outbound filter control `FILTER_CONFIG`, `START_ADDR` and `END_ADDR`
entries 1 and 2

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Outbound stage order: alias remap, output remap, filter, output.

*Test Coverage*:

* The outbound filter decides on the address after the output remap (`fabric.adoc`, Outbound
  Filtering and Fabric Topology): with deny entries (entry enabled, allow_burst, no read or write
  permission) over the remap targets 0x0240_0000 and 0x0260_0000, writes into the M-mode and Xvisor
  windows answer DECERR and leave their sentinels; with the entries moved over the window addresses
  the same writes answer OKAY and land at the remapped addresses, for both remaps.
* The alias remap acts before the output remap (`fabric.adoc`, Fabric Topology and Alias Remapping;
  `alias_remap.rdl`, `output_remap.rdl`): a write at 0x0300_0100 that alias region 2 moves by
  0xBE00_0000 into the M-mode window lands at 0x0240_0100, and neither 0x0300_0100 nor the
  alias-translated address is written.
* A request the filter blocks never reaches the output interface (`axi_filter` documentation,
  Blocked Transactions): the blocked write answers DECERR, `tb_output_axi_awvalid` and
  `wvalid` stay low and `tb_output_axi_write_count` is unchanged over 64 `clk_smc_i` cycles, both
  sentinels are kept, and a permitted write beside it lands and advances the write count by one.
* A DMA write on the direct path and a JTAG write on the remapped path issued together both complete
  and land: the DMA payload at its destination and the JTAG word at the remapped address, with the
  JTAG write accepted at the output before `DONE_0` advances.
* With `tb_output_axi_resp_hold` set, a second JTAG write is accepted at the output before the first
  one's response; no B handshake occurs and the write count does not advance while held, and after
  the release both answer OKAY and land at their direct and remapped addresses.
* A cold reset with a write in flight: the interrupted write's fate (timeout, response, memory) is
  printed and not compared, because no document states what an observer must see; afterwards a fresh
  JTAG write and read at a new address answer OKAY with an exact readback.
* After the reset the M-mode remap `REGION_ATTRS` reads its register description reset value, and
  every programmed word is restored.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), require
  `tb_output_axi_resp_hold` idle, start the output watcher, and over SEP_IN program M-mode and
  Xvisor remap `REGION_ATTRS` entry 0 valid with targets 0x0240_0000 and 0x0260_0000, alias region 2
  (`REGION_START` 0x0300_0000, `REGION_END` 0x0300_1000, `REGION_ATTRS` valid with offset
  0xBE00_0000), each read back, and read outbound `FILTER_CONFIG` entries 1 and 2 expecting 0x3000
  with the enable clear; seed the probe words.
. Error injection. Point: outbound entries 1 and 2 as deny entries over the remap targets
  0x0240_0000 and 0x0260_0000 (4 KiB, readback 0x0000_0000_0100_3010). Kind: JTAG writes into the
  M-mode and Xvisor windows at offset 0x40, whose post-remap addresses the entries cover. Expected
  response: DECERR, no AW or W valid, an unchanged write count and sentinels kept. Then move the
  entries over the two window bases and JTAG-write the same words, requiring OKAY, one write count
  each and the words at the remapped addresses.
. Switch entries 1 and 2 off, JTAG-write 0x0300_0100 and require OKAY, one write at the output and
  the word at 0x0240_0100 with sentinels kept at 0x0300_0100 and at the alias-translated address.
. Error injection. Point: outbound entry 1 as a deny entry over 0x0240_0000. Kind: a JTAG write into
  the M-mode window at offset 0x200 that the filter blocks. Expected response: DECERR, `awvalid` and
  `wvalid` low and the write count unchanged for 64 cycles, sentinels kept. Then JTAG-write offset
  0x1000 requiring OKAY, the word at the remapped address and the write count advanced by one.
. Switch entry 1 off, start a DMA copy of 8 bytes from 0x0200_0000 to 0x0200_B000 and, during it,
  JTAG-write the M-mode window at offset 0x300; poll `DONE_0` up to 50 times at 20 cycles, require
  the JTAG AW at the output at 0x0240_0300 accepted before `DONE_0` advanced and both words landed;
  restore `DMA_CONFIG`.
. Set `tb_output_axi_resp_hold`, start a JTAG group of two writes, one to 0x0200_C000 and one to the
  M-mode window at offset 0x400, wait up to 200 cycles for two AW handshakes, and require the group
  incomplete, no B handshake, no response at the initiator and an unchanged write count; release
  the hold and require both OKAY and landed at 0x0200_C000 and 0x0240_0400.
. Error injection. Point: the reset agent, with a JTAG write to 0x0200_D000 held at the output by
  `tb_output_axi_resp_hold`. Kind: a cold reset (asserted and released states bounded on the reset
  signals) applied while the write is in flight, timeouts allowed on that write. Expected response:
  the fate of the interrupted write is printed, not compared, and after `tb_fuse_sense_done` falls
  and rises again a fresh JTAG write at 0x0200_E000 and its read answer OKAY with an exact word.
  Set the hold and wait for the write's AW at the output before the reset.
. Read outbound `FILTER_CONFIG` entries 1 and 2 expecting 0x3000 and M-mode remap `REGION_ATTRS`
  expecting its reset value; restore outbound entries 1 and 2, the M-mode, Xvisor and alias remap
  words and read each back; log the bounded waits and require the eight step stamps in increasing
  order, the seven checker lines in order, at least 91 SEP_IN accesses and a scoreboard JTAG count
  within one of the JTAG accesses issued.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-STAGE-FILTER-POST-REMAP` |Deny entries over the remap targets answer the M-mode and Xvisor
window writes with DECERR and leave the sentinels, while the same writes answer OKAY and land at the
remapped addresses once the entries cover the window addresses instead
|`CHK-INT-REMAP-FILTER` |For both remaps the filter decides on the post-remap address: the refused
writes show no `awvalid` or `wvalid` cycle at the output and the same words land once only the
window-address entries exist, with every probe resolvable
|`CHK-STAGE-ALIAS-THEN-OUTPUT` |The write at 0x0300_0100 lands at 0x0240_0100, and the sentinels at
0x0300_0100 and at the alias-translated address are kept
|`CHK-STAGE-BLOCKED-NOTHING-ON-OUTPUT` |The blocked write answers DECERR, `awvalid` and `wvalid`
stay low and the write count is unchanged across 64 cycles, both sentinels are kept, and the
permitted write lands and advances the write count by one
|`CHK-STAGE-SIMULTANEOUS` |`DONE_0` advances within the poll bound, the JTAG AW at the output is
accepted before it, and the DMA payload and the JTAG word land at their destinations
|`CHK-STAGE-SECOND-WHILE-PENDING` |Under the response hold two AW handshakes reach the output with
no B handshake and an unchanged write count, and after the release both writes answer OKAY and land
at 0x0200_C000 and 0x0240_0400
|`CHK-STAGE-RESET-IN-FLIGHT` |The interrupted write's timeout, response and memory content are
printed and not compared; the fresh JTAG write at 0x0200_E000 and its read answer OKAY and the read
returns the word written; the counters and output valid levels around the reset are printed
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The eight steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line
was printed in order and no earlier than its step, the access floor was reached and the
scoreboard counted the JTAG accesses; a control-flow invariant that catches a truncated
run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the fuse waits at 200 000 `clk_smc_i`
cycles, the output responder observation, the AW polls at 200 cycles, the 64-cycle window, the DMA
poll at 50 by 20 cycles, the reset asserted and released waits and each AXI access at 50 000 ns);
the expiry of any raises, so the line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every refused write answers DECERR with nothing on the output, every permitted
write answers OKAY and lands at its post-remap address, the alias-then-output landing is exact, the
DMA and JTAG writes both land with the JTAG AW first, the second write is accepted while the first
is pending, the post-reset write and read answer OKAY with the exact word, and at least 91 SEP_IN
accesses are issued. The interrupted write's fate is recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The timeout, response and memory content of the write interrupted by the cold reset
are printed and not compared, because no document states what an observer must see; the counters
and output valid levels around the reset are printed.

'''''

[[sec-384-smc_region_gated_units_decode_test]]
===== 384 `smc_region_gated_units_decode_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_region_gated_units_decode_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) and SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`), with items that require an exact
DECERR or tolerate any response; JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_agent`) for the observe-only leg;
`env.axi_monitor.expected_decerr_addrs` for every address expected to answer DECERR; a free-running
watcher on `clk_smc_i` recording `tb_output_axi_awaddr` while `tb_output_axi_awvalid` is high and
`tb_output_axi_araddr` while `tb_output_axi_arvalid` is high; the output responder counters
`tb_output_axi_write_count` and `tb_output_axi_read_count`; `tb_fuse_sense_done`,
`tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; registers `REGION_SIZE` of
`SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, inbound filter entry 0, `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0, PLIC `PRIORITY` word 0 and
`CORE3_SEIP_CLAIM_COMPLETE`, CLINT `MSIP` word 0 and `MTIME`, and `CAUSE` and `LOCAL_ENABLE` of the
bus-error units of cores 0 to 3

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: DECERR until REGION_SIZE covers PLIC, CLINT and BEU units.

*Test Coverage*:

* The inbound port reaches a unit only while its whole aperture lies below `BASE + REGION_SIZE`; at
  the reset value 0x0100_0000 the PLIC, CLINT and bus-error units lie beyond it and answer DECERR
  (`memmap.adoc`, Address Space Organization; `smu-smc.adoc`, Address Map and Aperture): a read and
  a write at the base of the PLIC, the CLINT and the four bus-error units answer DECERR from SEP_IN
  and SYS_IN. The read data is printed and not compared.
* The M-mode and Xvisor remap regions forward accesses from SMC initiators only and answer DECERR to
  the inbound port (`memmap.adoc`): with `REGION_SIZE` widened to 0x0200_0000 a read and a write at
  the first and last word of each region answer DECERR from both ports at the local and the global
  base, nothing appears on the output interface, the output counters do not move, and an in-window
  `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 write and read still work.
* The same first words of the two remap regions are accessed from JTAG and the response, and whether
  an AW or AR reached the output, are printed and not compared, because the memory map's statement
  for an SMC initiator is not pinned for this port.
* After `REGION_SIZE` is widened to 0x1000_0000 the units are decoded: CLINT `MSIP` word 0 and the
  four bus-error `CAUSE` registers read their register description reset values (`clint.rdl`,
  `bus_error_unit.rdl`) with OKAY and the PLIC first register answers OKAY, its reset being
  undeclared so the value is printed.
* The last register of each unit is reached and answers OKAY: PLIC `CORE3_SEIP_CLAIM_COMPLETE` and
  CLINT `MTIME` (reset undeclared, printed) and each bus-error `LOCAL_ENABLE` (compared with its
  reset value, `bus_error_unit.rdl`).
* An address past each unit's decoded extent and the last word of its aperture answer a read with
  DECERR and 0xBADCAB1E (`smc.rdl`, `ocah_past_extent_resp` of the PLIC, CLINT and bus-error units);
  the write response must equal its declared value.
* `REGION_SIZE` and inbound filter entry 0 are restored to their register description reset values
  with readbacks.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, start the output watcher, program inbound filter entry 0 pass-all over SEP_IN with
  readbacks, read `REGION_SIZE` expecting its reset 0x0100_0000 and keep it for the restore, and
  register the unit base addresses as expected DECERR addresses.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, the base register of the PLIC, the CLINT and the four
  bus-error units, which lie beyond `BASE + REGION_SIZE` at the reset value. Kind: a read and a write
  at each base register. Expected response: DECERR on each; the read data is printed.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN at the local and the global base, the M-mode and Xvisor
  remap regions brought inside the aperture by `REGION_SIZE` 0x0200_0000. Kind: 8-byte reads and
  writes at the first (offset 0x0100_0000) and last (0x017F_FFF8) word of the M-mode region and the
  first (0x0180_0000) and last (0x01FF_FFF8) word of the Xvisor region. Expected response: DECERR,
  with no AW or AR at the output and unchanged output counters throughout. First write `REGION_SIZE`
  0x0200_0000 and read it back; alongside, write `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 with 0x5A5A_C3C3, read it
  back exactly and clear it on each port.
. Error injection. Point: JTAG at the local base, the first word of the M-mode and the Xvisor
  regions. Kind: a read and a write at each, tolerating any response. Expected response: each
  access completes within the guard; each response, the output AW and AR addresses seen and the
  output counters before and after are printed, not compared.
. Write `REGION_SIZE` 0x1000_0000 and read it back; from both ports read PLIC `PRIORITY` word 0
  (OKAY), CLINT `MSIP` word 0 and the four bus-error `CAUSE` registers expecting their reset values
  with OKAY.
. From both ports read PLIC `CORE3_SEIP_CLAIM_COMPLETE` and CLINT `MTIME` requiring OKAY, and the
  four bus-error `LOCAL_ENABLE` registers expecting their reset value.
. Error injection. Point: SEP_IN and SYS_IN, the first address past each of the six units' decoded
  extent and the last word of its aperture. Kind: a read and a write at each. Expected response: the
  reads answer DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E, after requiring the generated past-extent read response to be
  DECERR, and each write response equals the declared one.
. Restore `REGION_SIZE` to 0x0100_0000 and read it back, restore inbound filter entry 0
  `FILTER_CONFIG`, `START_ADDR` and `END_ADDR` to their register description reset values and read
  each back; stop the watcher, log the bounded waits and require the eight step stamps in increasing
  order, the six checker lines in order and at least 157 accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLUSTER-UNITS-RESET-DECERR` |At the reset `REGION_SIZE` a read and a write at the base of the
PLIC, the CLINT and each of the four bus-error units answer DECERR on SEP_IN and SYS_IN; the read
data is printed and is not compared
|`CHK-REMAP-REGION-WIDENED-DECERR` |With `REGION_SIZE` 0x0200_0000 a read and a write at the first
and last word of the M-mode and Xvisor regions answer DECERR on both ports at both bases, the output
interface sees no request and the output counters stay unchanged, and the in-window `SCRATCH_COLD`
control reads back 0x5A5A_C3C3
|`CHK-REMAP-REGION-JTAG-OBSERVE` |Measures and prints the JTAG read and write responses at the first
word of each remap region together with the output AW and AR addresses and counters, without
comparing them; each access must complete within the guard
|`CHK-CLUSTER-UNITS-DECODED-AFTER-WIDEN` |After `REGION_SIZE` 0x1000_0000 the CLINT `MSIP` word 0
and the four bus-error `CAUSE` registers read their reset values with OKAY on both ports, and the
PLIC first register answers OKAY with its value printed
|`CHK-CLUSTER-UNITS-LAST-REGISTER` |The PLIC `CORE3_SEIP_CLAIM_COMPLETE` and CLINT
`MTIME` reads answer OKAY with their values printed, and each bus-error `LOCAL_ENABLE`
reads its reset value, on both ports
|`CHK-CLUSTER-UNITS-PAST-EXTENT` |The first address past each unit's decoded extent and the last
word of its aperture answer reads with DECERR and 0xBADCAB1E on both ports; the write response
equals its declared value; `REGION_SIZE` and inbound filter entry 0 read
back their reset values after the restore
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The eight steps were stamped in strictly increasing time, each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step, and at least 157 accesses were issued; a control-flow
invariant that catches a truncated run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the three fuse and reset waits
at 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles and each AXI access on the three ports at 50 000 ns with no
timeout allowed; the output watcher waits on nothing); the expiry of any raises, so the
line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every access to the gated units at the reset `REGION_SIZE` and to the remap regions
from SEP_IN and SYS_IN answers DECERR, the output interface stays silent, the widened units answer
OKAY with their reset values where declared, every past-extent and aperture-top read answers
DECERR with 0xBADCAB1E, `REGION_SIZE` is restored, and at least 157 accesses are issued. The JTAG
responses and the undeclared reset values are recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The read data of the DECERR accesses at the reset `REGION_SIZE` is printed and not
compared. The JTAG responses at the first word of each remap region, with the output addresses and
counters, are printed and not compared, because the memory map's statement for an SMC initiator is
not pinned for this port. The PLIC first register, PLIC `CORE3_SEIP_CLAIM_COMPLETE` and CLINT
`MTIME` have undeclared resets, so their values are printed.

'''''

[[sec-385-smc_region_zero_reset_recovery_test]]
===== 385 `smc_region_zero_reset_recovery_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_region_zero_reset_recovery_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`), SYS_IN
`ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`sys_axi_*`, `sys_in_axi_agent`) and JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_*`,
`jtag_axi_agent`), including outstanding groups that tolerate a timeout or an error response; the
reset agent (`reset_agent` sequencer) driving the cold reset with its asserted and released states
waited on `powergood`, `rst_cold_stable_ref_clk_n`, `rst_primary_ref_clk_n`, `rst_primary_smc_clk_n`
and `rst_wdt_smc_clk_n`; response holds `tb_sep_axi_r_hold`, `tb_sep_axi_b_hold`,
`tb_sys_axi_r_hold` and `tb_output_axi_resp_hold`, with `tb_sep_axi_r_raw_valid` and
`tb_sys_axi_r_raw_valid` showing a held read response; a watcher on `clk_smc_i` recording the
handshakes of `tb_output_axi_awvalid`/ `awready`/`awaddr` and `arvalid`/`arready`/`araddr`; the
output responder counters `tb_output_axi_write_count` and `tb_output_axi_read_count`; SYS_OUT
responder memory (`sys_out_mem`); `tb_inb_read_hit` and `tb_inb_write_hit` bit 0 (printed);
`tb_fuse_sense_done` (waited high, and low after each reset on `clk_ref_i`), `tb_fuse_reset_n` and
`tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n`; registers `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` of
`SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, inbound filter entry 0 and `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`, `decode`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: REGION_SIZE zero collapse and cold reset recovery.

*Test Coverage*:

* With `REGION_SIZE` written to 0 the local and global apertures collapse and a read and a write at
  `LOCAL_BASE` and at `GLOBAL_BASE` answer DECERR on SEP_IN and SYS_IN, while inbound filter entry 0
  stays pass-all (`fabric.adoc`, Local and Remote Resource Access; `smc-programming.adoc`, Address
  Map; `smc_base_config.rdl`, `REGION_SIZE`).
* With `REGION_SIZE` 0, JTAG accesses at offset 0x2800 from the local base and from the global base
  are not claimed by an SMC register: they leave through the output interface with
  `tb_output_axi_araddr` and `awaddr` equal to the address, are answered by the SYS_OUT responder
  (the seeded word read back, the written word held in the responder memory) and move the output
  read and write counters by one each (`fabric.adoc`, Outbound Traffic Flow).
* A cold reset is the recovery: `REGION_SIZE`, `GLOBAL_BASE` and `LOCAL_BASE` read their register
  description reset values 0x0100_0000, 0x4000_0000 and 0xC000_0000 (`smc_base_config.rdl`) with
  OKAY and `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 reads its reset word.
* A cold reset with 8 reads and 4 writes outstanding on each of SEP_IN and SYS_IN, with the R and B
  responses held: no read response is presented at either port at the release or for 64 cycles after
  the holds clear, and the first `REGION_SIZE` read afterwards answers OKAY with 0x0100_0000. The
  outstanding accesses may end in any response or none, so their fates are printed, as are the
  `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 afterwards (`fabric.adoc`, Fabric Topology, registered channels).
* A cold reset with a JTAG read and write pending at the output interface under the response hold:
  after the release the read and write counters never exceed the AR and AW handshakes issued since
  the reset over 64 cycles, so no response arrives without a request; whether the pre-reset address
  is re-issued is printed; a fresh JTAG write and read at 0x0200_0000 answer OKAY with an exact
  readback and `REGION_SIZE` reads its reset value.
* A reprogrammed window does not survive the reset: `GLOBAL_BASE` 0x8000_0000 and `REGION_SIZE`
  0x0200_0000 read back, and after a cold reset `GLOBAL_BASE`, `REGION_SIZE`, `LOCAL_BASE`, inbound
  filter entry 0 and `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 read their reset words.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Require the four response holds idle, start the output watcher, wait for the fuse sense, read
  `GLOBAL_BASE`, `LOCAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` over SEP_IN expecting their reset values, and
  program inbound filter entry 0 pass-all with an exact readback of each word.
. Error injection. Point: `REGION_SIZE` of `SMC_BASE_CONFIG`, written 0 over SEP_IN. Kind: a
  collapsing aperture size, followed by a read and a write of `LOCAL_BASE` and `GLOBAL_BASE` from
  SEP_IN and from SYS_IN. Expected response: DECERR on all eight; the hit probe levels are printed.
. For the local and the global base seed the responder word at base plus 0x2800, JTAG-read it
  requiring the seed and an AR at the output carrying that address (bounded by 200 cycles),
  JTAG-write a new word requiring an AW carrying it, require the output read and write counters to
  advance by one each and the responder memory to hold the written word.
. Apply a cold reset (asserted and released states bounded on the reset signals,
  `tb_fuse_sense_done`
  seen low), wait for the fuse sense, then read `REGION_SIZE`, `GLOBAL_BASE` and `LOCAL_BASE`
  requiring their reset values and `SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 requiring its reset word.
. Error injection. Point: the reset agent, with 8 reads and 4 writes of `SCRATCH_COLD` outstanding
  on each of SEP_IN and SYS_IN under the SEP_IN R and B holds and the SYS_IN R hold. Kind: a cold
  reset applied once a held read response is seen on both ports (400-cycle bound). Expected
  response: no read response presented after the reset, both raw valids low for 64 cycles after the
  holds clear, and the first `REGION_SIZE` read afterwards OKAY with 0x0100_0000; the fates of the
  outstanding accesses and `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 are printed. Re-program inbound filter entry
  0 pass-all and set the holds before starting the groups; join the groups after the holds clear.
. Error injection. Point: the reset agent, with a JTAG read and write at 0x0200_0000 pending at the
  output interface under `tb_output_axi_resp_hold`. Kind: a cold reset applied after their AR and AW
  are seen at the output with the group incomplete. Expected response: after the hold clears and
  the fuse sense completes, for 64 cycles the output counters stay within the handshakes issued
  since the reset, and a fresh JTAG write and read at 0x0200_0000 answer OKAY with an exact
  readback while `REGION_SIZE` reads its reset value; whether the pre-reset address is re-issued is
  printed. Join the group before the fresh accesses.
. Write `GLOBAL_BASE` 0x8000_0000 and `REGION_SIZE` 0x0200_0000 with exact readbacks, apply a cold
  reset and wait for the fuse sense, then read `GLOBAL_BASE`, `REGION_SIZE`, `LOCAL_BASE`, inbound
  filter entry 0 `START_ADDR`, `END_ADDR` and `FILTER_CONFIG` and `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3, each
  expecting its reset word; log the bounded waits and require the seven step stamps in increasing
  order, the six checker lines in order and at least 44 SEP_IN accesses.

*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-REGION-ZERO-DECERR` |After `REGION_SIZE` is written 0 a read and a write at `LOCAL_BASE` and
at `GLOBAL_BASE` answer DECERR on SEP_IN and on SYS_IN, eight cases in all; the inbound filter hit
levels are printed, not compared
|`CHK-REGION-ZERO-JTAG-OUTBOUND` |With `REGION_SIZE` 0 the JTAG read and write at offset 0x2800
from each base answer OKAY from the SYS_OUT responder, with AR and AW on the output address bus
equal to the address and the read and write counters advanced by one each; the SMC register at
that address is not the one that answers
|`CHK-REGION-ZERO-RESET-RECOVERY` |After the cold reset `REGION_SIZE`, `GLOBAL_BASE`
and `LOCAL_BASE` read 0x0100_0000, 0x4000_0000 and 0xC000_0000 with OKAY and
`SCRATCH_COLD` word 0 reads its reset word
|`CHK-RESET-MID-INBOUND` |After a cold reset with 8 reads and 4 writes outstanding on each of SEP_IN
and SYS_IN the first `REGION_SIZE` read answers OKAY with 0x0100_0000 and neither raw read-response
valid is high at the release or for 64 cycles after the holds clear; the outstanding accesses' fates
and the `SCRATCH_COLD` words are printed, not compared
|`CHK-RESET-MID-OUTBOUND` |After a cold reset with the output response held the JTAG write and
read at 0x0200_0000 answer OKAY with an exact readback and `REGION_SIZE` reads 0x0100_0000,
and over 64 cycles the output write and read counters never exceed the AW and AR handshakes
since the reset; whether the pre-reset address is re-issued and the interrupted accesses'
fates are printed, not compared
|`CHK-RESET-RESTORES-WINDOW` |After `GLOBAL_BASE` 0x8000_0000 and `REGION_SIZE` 0x0200_0000 and a
cold reset, `GLOBAL_BASE` and `REGION_SIZE` read 0x4000_0000 and 0x0100_0000 and `LOCAL_BASE`,
inbound filter entry 0 and `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3 read their reset words
|`CHK-NONVAC` |The seven steps were stamped in strictly increasing time and each checker line was
printed in order and no earlier than its step; a control-flow invariant that catches a truncated
run, not a DUT-failable compare
|`CHK-TIMEOUT-PATHS` |Records the bounded waits of the run (the fuse waits at 200 000 `clk_smc_i`
cycles, the handshake polls at 200 cycles, the hold poll at 400 cycles, the 64-cycle windows, the
reset asserted and released waits, the fuse-clear waits on `clk_ref_i` and each AXI access at 50 000
ns, with timeouts allowed only on accesses interrupted by a reset); the expiry of any raises, so the
line is a record and not a compare
|===

*Pass Criteria*: every access at the collapsed apertures answers DECERR, the JTAG accesses reach the
responder with the exact address, the registers and filter read their reset words after each cold
reset, no read response or response without a request appears after the resets, and at least 44
SEP_IN accesses are issued. The fates of accesses interrupted by a reset, the hit probe levels and
the re-issued address are recorded without an expected value. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The inbound filter hit probe levels, the fates of the accesses outstanding when each
cold reset is applied (they may end in any response or none), the `SCRATCH_COLD` words read
afterwards and whether the pre-reset JTAG address is re-issued are printed and not compared.

'''''

[[sec-386-smc_xbar_outstanding_limits_test]]
===== 386 `smc_xbar_outstanding_limits_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: FABRIC

*Source Module*: `smc_xbar_outstanding_limits_test`

*BFM / Model*: SEP_IN `ocah_axi_vip` (AXI) master (`s_axi_*`, `sys_axi_agent`) issuing outstanding
groups of 4 to 24 accesses; JTAG AXI master (`jtag_axi_agent`) started in the same `clk_smc_i` cycle
as a SEP_IN group for the two-manager leg; a stall watcher on the SEP_IN handshakes
(`SmcAxiPortWatch` on `s_axi`) counting stalled AR, R, AW and B cycles; `tb_fuse_sense_done`,
`tb_fuse_reset_n` and `tb_rst_warm_smc_clk_n` for the bring-up wait; the scoreboard exact-value
compare count (`sys_axi_value_checks_seen`); registers `SCRATCH_COLD` and `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` words
0 to 7, the read-only `CHIP_CONFIG` words (`VERSION_LO`, `VERSION_HI`, `CHIP_ID`, `LC_STATE`) and
the SPM words at `SMC_TOP_SPM_MEMORY_BASE_ADDR` plus 0x8_0000

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/fabric.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`, `fabric`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Outstanding read groups over the AXI-Lite and local crossbars.

*Test Coverage*:

* Outstanding reads at, above and across subordinates of the AXI4-Lite crossbar, whose limit is 4
  per manager and per subordinate (`fabric.adoc`, SMC Fabric Transaction Limits): 4 reads of
  `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3; 5 and 8 reads of the same registers; 12 interleaved reads over
  `SCRATCH_COLD`, `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` and `CHIP_CONFIG`; and a SEP_IN group of 4 beside a JTAG group
  of 4 started in the same cycle. Every read must complete OKAY within the guard with the word of
  its own register (`scratch.rdl`, `SCRATCH` read-write; `CHIP_CONFIG` read-only: `VERSION_LO`,
  `VERSION_HI` and `CHIP_ID` equal their `chip_config.rdl` resets, `LC_STATE` is hardware driven and
  equal to its first reading).
* Outstanding reads on the local AXI4 crossbar, whose limit is 8 per manager and per subordinate
  (`fabric.adoc`): 8 reads of SPM words; 9 and 16 reads of SPM words; 24 interleaved reads over the
  SPM, `SCRATCH_COLD` and `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM`; and a 16-member group of 8 SPM reads and 8 SPM writes
  whose written words read back exactly.
* The document gives the limits but not whether an access past the limit stalls or errors, so the
  groups above the limits are required to complete OKAY with correct data and the stall cycles are
  printed, not asserted.
* The `SCRATCH_COLD` and `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` words are restored to 0 at the end.

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for the fuse sense to finish (bounded by 200 000 `clk_smc_i` cycles), sample the bring-up
  signals, seed `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 7 with 0xC0DE_0500 + i, `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` words 0 to 7
  with 0xC0DE_0600 + i and 16 SPM words, read the four `CHIP_CONFIG` words, and start the SEP_IN
  stall watcher.
. Issue 4 outstanding SEP_IN reads of `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3, requiring OKAY and each word.
. Issue 5 and then 8 outstanding reads of `SCRATCH_COLD` words, requiring OKAY and each word.
. Issue 12 interleaved reads over `SCRATCH_COLD` words 0 to 3, `SCRATCH_COLD_WARM` words 0 to 3 and
