[[sec-323-smc_jtag_dm_cmderr_command_test]]
===== 323 `smc_jtag_dm_cmderr_command_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_jtag_dm_cmderr_command_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI), ocah_jtag_vip

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/jtag.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Debug Module `command` writes over the DMI while `abstractcs.cmderr` is nonzero: the stored command is replaced, a Quick Access write replaces cmderr 4 with 2, and nothing executes.

*Test Coverage*:

* The RISC-V debug specification ignores `command` writes while `cmderr` is nonzero. This Debug Module stores the written value and, for a command type other than Access Register, sets `cmderr` to 2. The leaf holds the Debug Module to that behaviour, which the Debug section of `hw/sys/smc/doc/cpu.adoc` ("Abstract Command Writes While cmderr Is Set") documents, so a regenerated Debug Module that changes it fails here.
* An Access Register command (`0x00321000`, 64-bit read of x0) to a hart that is not halted ends with `busy` 0 and `cmderr` 4 (halt/resume); `command` reads back the written value.
* A Quick Access write (`0x01000000`) while `cmderr` is 4 leaves `cmderr` 2 and `command` reading back `0x01000000`.
* An Access Register write (`0x00321001`) while `cmderr` is 2 leaves `cmderr` 2 and `busy` 0, so nothing executed, and `command` reads back `0x00321001`.
* Writing 1s to `cmderr` clears it to 0.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_jtag_dm_cmderr_command_test_seq`: release `debug_reset_n`, activate the Debug Module over the DMI as `smc_jtag_dmi_smoke_test` does, clear `cmderr`, then make the three `command` writes and the clear above, reading `abstractcs` until `busy` is 0 and reading `command` back after each write. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds. The protocol-VIP record's byte golden is the `cmderr` sequence 4, 2, 2, 0.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-CLEAR` |`cmderr` reads 0 after 1s are written to it
|`CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-HALTRESUME` |`cmderr` 4 and the written `command` read back after an Access Register command to a hart that is not halted
|`CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-OVERWRITE` |`cmderr` 2 and the Quick Access `command` read back after a write made while `cmderr` was 4
|`CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-STORE` |`cmderr` still 2, `busy` 0 and the new `command` read back after an Access Register write made while `cmderr` was 2
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-CLEAR`, `CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-HALTRESUME`, `CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-OVERWRITE`, `CHK-JTAG-DM-CMDERR-STORE` hold after their compares. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-210-smc_dfd_cla_mmr_sweep_test]]
===== 210 `smc_dfd_cla_mmr_sweep_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_mmr_sweep_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the cells are the stated reset values and access classes of
the register description.

*Objective*: Every software-owned CLA MMR register driven half at a time against its generated RDL contract and restored.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every software-writable register of the `smc_cla/cla` block in the generated map less the one named exclusion, each written with the ones pattern its RDL software-access type allows and then restored to its RDL reset. The register lists are derived from the map on every run.
* Each write goes out as two narrower half-register accesses, so the byte lanes over the other half are deasserted and each readback also proves the untouched half held its value.
* `CDbgClaCtrlStatus` is excluded: `ClaLock` latches `enable_cla` forever and `EnableEap` arms the action bus of all 16 EAPs, so it is driven by `smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test` instead.
* The registers of the block with no software-writable field are hardware-driven status and carry no write expectation; their reset content is read by `smc_remap_cla_test`.
* *Map and design disagree*: the generated map declares `Rsvd` (bit 63) of `CDbgClaCounter0Cfg` to `CDbgClaCounter3Cfg` plain read-write, while the vendored MMR specification (`cla_mmrs.yml`) gives it a single legal value of 0 under a WARL register, and the design reads 0 after a write of 1. The generation of `dfd_cla.rdl` from that specification drops the legal-value constraint. The leaf holds those bits to the specified value 0 rather than the map's contract and fails if one reads back the written value or the map stops declaring it read-write, so the entry is revisited either way.

* `CDbgClaTimestamp`, which the generated map declares `sw = rw; hw = rw` for both fields and the sweep leaves out as hardware-driven, is driven on its own with the CLA enabled (pairs left disabled). It advances by itself while the CLA is enabled, the CLA's time tick counting it up: a whole-register write reads back at or above the written value, and an upper half written alone reads back exactly above a still-counting lower half (`CHK-CLA-TIMESTAMP`). The map's `hw = rw` matches: hardware writes the register every cycle it ticks, so the value software reads is its own write carried forward, never below it. The capture register and the capture bit of `CDbgClaTimestampConfig` stay unexercised because the only trigger is the cross-trigger input, which the bench ties to 0.
* One offset of the block's register hole (0x310, between `CDbgClaTimestampOffset` and `CDbgSignalMask0Hi`) is read and written with all ones.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_mmr_sweep_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-TIMESTAMP` |With the CLA enabled, `CDbgClaTimestamp` written whole reads back at or above the written value, and its upper half written alone reads that value; a readback below the write or a wrong upper half fails it
|`CHK-CLA-MMR-HOLE` |The read and the all-ones write to the hole complete, a read that completes OKAY returns 0, and the registers on either side hold their values; a hang, a non-zero OKAY read or a moved neighbour fails it
|`CHK-CLA-MMR-WRITE-SWEEP` |Every swept CLA MMR register read its generated RDL reset, returned exactly the software-writable bits written by each half-register access (the legal-value-pinned counter `Rsvd` bits read their specified value 0 instead) while the other half kept its value, drove 0 in every bit no field occupies, and read its RDL reset back after the two restore writes; a wrong readback, a half-write that spilled into the other half, or a driven undeclared bit fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-MMR-HOLE`, `CHK-CLA-MMR-WRITE-SWEEP`, `CHK-CLA-TIMESTAMP` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: `CDbgClaCtrlStatus` is not driven here (it is driven by `smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test` instead), and the registers with no software-writable field carry no write expectation (their reset content is read by `smc_remap_cla_test`). The capture register and the capture bit of `CDbgClaTimestampConfig` stay unexercised, because their only trigger is the cross-trigger input, which the bench ties to 0.
'''''

[[sec-211-smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test]]
===== 211 `smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: Every CLA event-action pair of every node activated over the whole LogicalOp range, cleared through its own W2C bit, with the node walk reaching all four nodes.

*Test Coverage*:

* All 16 `CDbgNode<n>Eap<m>` pairs (4 nodes x 4 pairs), each driven over the four values of its 2-bit `LogicalOp` field while its own node is the one `CDbgClaCtrlStatus.CurrentNode` reports.
* `CDbgEapStatus.Node<n>Eap<m>`, the hardware-set activation status, read at reset, observed set for each pair, and cleared through the matching `Node<n>Eap<m>W2C` bit.
* The node walk: an activating pair of the current node with `DestNode` naming the next node moves `CurrentNode`, so all four node ids become current.
* The CLA is armed with `DisableGlobalClockHalt` and `DisableLocalClockHalt` set, so a clock-halt action cannot stop the bench clocks while the pairs are live, and `ClaLock` is held at 0 so the arming is reversible.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_node_eap_sweep_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-EAP-STATUS-RESET` |All 16 pair-activation bits of `CDbgEapStatus` read 0 before the CLA was armed; a bit already set fails it and makes no later activation attributable to this sweep
|`CHK-CLA-EAP-LOGICAL-OP-FIRE` |Each of the 16 pairs was driven over all four `LogicalOp` values while its own node was current and the hardware set that pair's `CDbgEapStatus` bit for at least one of them; a pair that never activates fails it
|`CHK-CLA-EAP-STATUS-W2C` |Every observed activation was cleared by pulsing that pair's own W2C bit and the status bit read 0 afterwards; a status bit that survives its W2C pulse fails it
|`CHK-CLA-NODE-TRAVERSAL` |`CurrentNode` reported node ids 0, 1, 2 and 3 in turn, each move driven by an activating pair of the then-current node whose `DestNode` named the next; a node the walk cannot reach fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-EAP-LOGICAL-OP-FIRE`, `CHK-CLA-EAP-STATUS-RESET`, `CHK-CLA-EAP-STATUS-W2C`, `CHK-CLA-NODE-TRAVERSAL` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-212-smc_dfd_trace_accumulator_fill_test]]
===== 212 `smc_dfd_trace_accumulator_fill_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_accumulator_fill_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Debug-bus trace driven into the DST packetizer until its accumulator bank fills and the trace RAM sink takes it.

*Test Coverage*:

* The DFD clock held on through `DFX_CTRL.DEBUG_CTRL.force_clk_en`, and every value of the 6-bit `DEBUG_BUS_MUX.Dbmid` field written in the normal debug mode its RDL description names, so every debug-bus mux of the array passes its lanes.
* The DST enabled with `Trdstformat` at the uncompressed value its own RDL description names, the trace funnel enabled, and the trace RAM sink given a 0x1000-byte window, written through the limit field's own bit positions, and activated.
* The CLA armed and `CDbgNode0Eap0.Action0` driven over all 64 values of its 6-bit field. Which action code starts a trace is published by no RDL, generated header or MMR specification, so the sweep names none and reads the outcome off the DUT.
* `Trdstcontrol.Trdstempty` and `Trdstramwplow`, both read at their RDL reset first, are the two hardware-driven witnesses that the accumulator bank left the empty state and that a filled bank was taken by the sink.

* After the hand-off the sink enable is cleared with the sink kept active and stop-on-wrap clear, and the action field is driven over its whole range again. The window has never wrapped in this run (the wrap flag is sticky, so this has to happen before any wrap), so the sink's wrap-flag update sees a sink neither enabled nor set to stop on wrap while trace still arrives. What a disabled sink does with that trace is not in the register contract, so the write pointer is recorded, not held to a value (`CHK-DST-TRACE-SINK-DISABLED`).

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_accumulator_fill_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-TRACE-SINK-DISABLED` |The sink control write that clears the enable with the sink active reads back exactly, and the action sweep that follows completes; a rejected write fails it. The write pointer is recorded, not held to a value
|`CHK-DST-TRACE-IDLE` |`Trdstcontrol.Trdstempty` reads its RDL reset of 1 and `Trdstramwplow` reads its RDL reset of 0 with the DFD clock held on and no trace running; either one already off its reset fails it and makes the later observations unattributable
|`CHK-DST-TRACE-ACCUMULATE` |At least one value of the 6-bit `Action0` field made the DUT clear `Trdstcontrol.Trdstempty`, so the debug bus reached the packetizer and its accumulator bank left the empty state; a sweep in which the bit never clears fails it
|`CHK-DST-TRACE-BANK-HANDOFF` |The `Trdstramwplow` write pointer field moved off 0 and stays inside the 0x1000-byte window, so the trace RAM sink took at least one filled bank from the accumulator and the bank went empty again; a pointer still at its reset, or a word that changed only in the wrap flag, fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-TRACE-ACCUMULATE`, `CHK-DST-TRACE-BANK-HANDOFF`, `CHK-DST-TRACE-IDLE`, `CHK-DST-TRACE-SINK-DISABLED` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: Which action code starts a trace is published by no RDL, generated header or MMR specification, so the sweep names none and reads the outcome off the DUT. What a disabled sink does with trace that still arrives is not in the register contract, so the write pointer after the sink enable is cleared is recorded, not held to a value.
'''''

[[sec-213-smc_dfd_cla_counter_edge_test]]
===== 213 `smc_dfd_cla_counter_edge_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_counter_edge_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: All four CLA counters driven from the action bus and read back counting and cleared, and every edge-detect select value walked.

*Test Coverage*:

* The four `CDbgClaCounter<n>Cfg` instances: `Target`, `UpperTarget` and `ResetOnTarget` are programmed, and the hardware-driven `Counter` and `UpperCounter` fields are read back after every value of the 6-bit `Action0` field. Which action code increments or clears a counter is published by no RDL, generated header or MMR specification, so the sweep names none.
* `CDbgSignalEdgeDetectCfg`: every value of both 7-bit select fields and both values of both polarity bits, written and read back with the CLA armed and the debug bus in normal debug mode.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_counter_edge_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-COUNTER-RESET` |All four counters read 0 in their hardware-driven counter fields before the CLA was armed; a counter already non-zero fails it and makes the counts below unattributable
|`CHK-CLA-COUNTER-COUNTS` |Every one of the four counters was read non-zero while `Action0` was driven over its whole range, so the action bus reaches each counter; a counter that never moves fails it
|`CHK-CLA-COUNTER-CLEARS` |Every counter seen counting was later read back at zero, so the counters are cleared by the action bus rather than left running; one that never returns to zero fails it
|`CHK-CLA-EDGE-SELECT-SWEEP` |Both edge-detect select fields took all 128 of their values and both polarity bits both of theirs, each read back exactly. This is a claim about the configuration surface: which debug-bus signal a select value names is not in the register contract, so no detected edge is claimed
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-COUNTER-CLEARS`, `CHK-CLA-COUNTER-COUNTS`, `CHK-CLA-COUNTER-RESET`, `CHK-CLA-EDGE-SELECT-SWEEP` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: Which action code increments or clears a counter is published by no RDL, generated header or MMR specification, so the sweep names none. Which debug-bus signal an edge-detect select value names is not in the register contract, so no detected edge is claimed; the select sweep is a claim about the configuration surface only.
'''''

[[sec-214-smc_dfd_trace_format_sweep_test]]
===== 214 `smc_dfd_trace_format_sweep_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_format_sweep_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The trace path run in the uncompressed format on a moving payload and two frame lengths.

*Test Coverage*:

* `Trdstformat` = 0, one of the three values the field's own RDL description names, written into the DST control register and read back.
* The CLA's own mux (`CDbgMuxSelLo`), the last stage in front of the trace, resets to off and would hold the traced bus at zero, so it is put in normal debug mode. The functional debug signals behind the DEBUG_BUS_MUX array hold still in this bench, so the array is put in its identifier output mode and the identifier whose return to normal mode moves the node 0 pair 0 snapshot is found by measurement. That mux's `Muxselseg0..7` are walked through the segment selects the description names (0, 1, 2, 4) while the trace is live, and the lanes are read through the snapshot after each. Without a changing bus a compressor emits nothing.
* `Trdstimpl.Trdstvendorframelength` changed part way through the run, which its description makes frame lengths of 64 and 192 bytes, so the packet path sees more than one frame size.
* `Trdstsyncmode` at the periodic-timestamp value its description names, with the shortest `Trdstsyncmax` period, so the periodic-sync path runs.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_format_sweep_test_seq` with `fmt` set to 0. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-FORMAT-IDLE` |With the DST enabled in this format and the sink armed, the packetizer reads empty and the sink write pointer reads its reset before the trace starts, so everything the run delivers is its own; either one already non-empty fails it
|`CHK-DST-FORMAT-STREAM` |This format moved the sink write pointer field off 0 to a position inside the 0x4000-byte window, so the compression the field selects carried a live stream to the trace RAM; a pointer that does not move, or a word that changed only in the wrap flag, fails it and reports the packetizer and funnel state
|`CHK-DST-FORMAT-PAYLOAD` |The measured mux was walked through every segment select the `Muxselseg` description names while the trace was running, and the lanes read through the snapshot took at least two different values; a rotation that does not run, no mux that moves the snapshot, or lanes that stay the same fails it
|`CHK-DST-FORMAT-FRAMELEN` |The frame length took both programmed values during the live trace, each read back exactly; a frame length that does not change fails it
|===

*Known limitation*: one compression mode per run, one leaf per mode. The packetizer can be emptied from software by clearing `Trdstenable` alone with `Trdstactive` held at 1, which the emptying stop before the odd-offset walk of `smc_dfd_trace_sink_concurrent_test` witnesses (with packets in flight it does not empty at every clock phase; see that card); clearing both together stops the DST clock first and leaves a partial bank behind. Re-running a second mode after that flush is not measured, so the modes keep a leaf each.



*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-FORMAT-FRAMELEN`, `CHK-DST-FORMAT-IDLE`, `CHK-DST-FORMAT-PAYLOAD`, `CHK-DST-FORMAT-STREAM` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: One compression mode per run: re-running a second mode after an in-run flush of the packetizer is not measured, so each mode keeps its own leaf.
'''''

[[sec-215-smc_dfd_trace_sink_window_test]]
===== 215 `smc_dfd_trace_sink_window_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_sink_window_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The trace stream blocked at the funnel, released, and taken into two sink window sizes.

*Test Coverage*:

* `Trfunneldisinput`, which the RDL splits into a low half for the N-trace sources and a high half for the DST sources, set over its whole DST half and then cleared, giving a deny leg and an allow leg on the same stimulus.
* The deny leg runs first because the sink's wrap flag is hardware-set and sticky, so a sink that has once taken data cannot be shown empty again.
* Two sink window sizes programmed through `Trdstramlimitlow`, 0x4000 and 0x400 bytes, written through the field's own bit positions because the register's plain read-write mask leaves the hardware-written limit field out. The allow leg runs the stream on until the write pointer has passed 0x400 without wrapping; the 0x400-byte window must then hold the same stream under its limit until the wrap flag sets.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_sink_window_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-FUNNEL-DENY` |With the DST half of `Trfunneldisinput` set, the sink write pointer stayed at its RDL reset across the whole `Action0` range; a pointer that moves fails it
|`CHK-DST-FUNNEL-ALLOW` |Clearing that field moved the sink write pointer field off 0 under the same stimulus, which is what makes the deny leg distinguishable from a dead trace path; a pointer field still at 0 fails it, even with the wrap flag set
|`CHK-DST-SINK-WINDOW` |In the 0x4000-byte window the write pointer passes 0x400 without wrapping; re-armed over 0x400 bytes, the same stream sets the wrap flag with every pointer sample at or under 0x400, so `Trdstramlimitlow` bounds the pointer; a pointer that never passes 0x400 in the large window, crosses 0x400 in the small one, or never wraps it fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-FUNNEL-ALLOW`, `CHK-DST-FUNNEL-DENY`, `CHK-DST-SINK-WINDOW` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-216-smc_dfd_cla_event_type_sweep_test]]
===== 216 `smc_dfd_cla_event_type_sweep_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_event_type_sweep_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 3600; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: Every event index driven into all three event selectors of every event-action pair of every node, with the node walk reaching all four nodes.

*Test Coverage*:

* `EventType0`, `EventType1` and `EventType2` of each of the four `CDbgNode<n>Eap<m>` pairs of each of the four nodes, each selector driven over all 64 values of its six-bit field: 3072 selector values in all. Each value is one index of the CLA event bus the selector compares against, so a pair left at its reset only ever exercises index zero.
* The pair's relation is left at its RDL reset, so a pair activates when and only when the selected event is asserted, and `CDbgEapStatus` is read after every value with the pair quiesced and its status cleared between values.
* A node's pairs can only set their status while that node is current, so after each node's sweep one of its pairs is re-programmed with an event index seen live and `DestNode` naming the next node, and `CurrentNode` is polled until the DUT reports the move.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_event_type_sweep_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-EVENT-SELECT-SWEEP` |All three selectors of all four pairs of all four nodes took every one of the 64 values their field offers and read back exactly, with `CurrentNode` reporting each node in turn; a value the register does not accept, or a node the walk never reaches, fails it
|`CHK-CLA-EVENT-SELECT-LIVE` |On every node the DUT set a pair-activation bit for at least one event index, so the selectors pick a live event bus rather than storing a value nothing reads; a node on which no index ever activates fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-EVENT-SELECT-LIVE`, `CHK-CLA-EVENT-SELECT-SWEEP` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-217-smc_dfd_trace_sink_readout_test]]
===== 217 `smc_dfd_trace_sink_readout_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_sink_readout_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The captured trace read back out of the sink RAM, with both sink modes and the deactivation edge.

*Test Coverage*:

* The sink's read side, which the other trace leaves never use: `Trdstramrplow` driven across the 0x400-byte window and `Trdstramdata` read at each position, after an all-zero baseline is taken from the same port before any trace has run. The trace first runs until the sink's wrap flag reports one pass of the window, so every position read holds a word the trace wrote.
* The window and pointer fields sit above two reserved bits and hardware writes them too, so the register's plain read-write mask leaves them out; they are written through each field's own bit positions.
* The read pointer is also placed on every 8-byte word inside the window's first 64-byte set, both on the empty buffer before the trace (with the write pointer moved to the same word) and after the fill, not only on set boundaries.
* `Trdstrammode` at both values of its one-bit field, each written with the sink active and enabled and read back.
* `Trdstramactive` taken from 1 to 0 with `Trdstramenable` held at 1, with a captured trace still in the window.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_sink_readout_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-SINK-BASELINE` |The sink RAM data port reads 0 at read pointer 0, and 0 with the write and read pointers together on each 8-byte word of the first set, with the sink armed and no trace captured; a non-zero read fails it and makes the read-out below prove nothing
|`CHK-DST-SINK-READOUT` |At least one of the words the RAM data port returned after the trace was captured is non-zero against that baseline, so the trace is readable back through the register interface; an all-zero read-out fails it
|`CHK-DST-SINK-MODE` |The sink was armed and run at both values of `Trdstrammode`, each read back exactly; a value the register does not accept fails it
|`CHK-DST-SINK-DEACTIVATE` |`Trdstramactive` went from 1 to 0 with the enable held and the change read back; a sink already inactive beforehand fails it
|===



*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-SINK-BASELINE`, `CHK-DST-SINK-DEACTIVATE`, `CHK-DST-SINK-MODE`, `CHK-DST-SINK-READOUT` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-218-smc_dfd_sink_mmr_sweep_test]]
===== 218 `smc_dfd_sink_mmr_sweep_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_sink_mmr_sweep_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the cells are the stated reset values and access classes of
the register description.

*Objective*: Every register of the DST, sink and funnel MMR sub-blocks written against its generated RDL contract and restored.

*Test Coverage*:

* All 24 registers of the `dst` (6), `dst_sink` (13) and `funnel` (5) sub-blocks of the SMC_CLA aperture, which the trace leaves otherwise write only at the handful of addresses they configure. Each is read at its RDL reset, written with every bit its fields declare, read back, restored and read back again.
* The 11 registers with a field the contract pins -- `sw = rw` and not also hardware-driven -- are held to giving the written value back. The sink and funnel control and pointer registers are `sw = rw; hw = rw`, so the RDL pins no readback value for them; they are written because the decode is what is exercised, and held to the one thing the contract does state.
* The 8 registers carrying a read-only, non-volatile bit have it checked against its RDL reset on all three reads, so a write that spills out of its own fields fails.
* No trace runs and no CLA is armed, so the enables written into `Trdstcontrol`, `Trdstramcontrol` and `Trfunnelcontrol` have nothing to act on. Those registers and the window and pointer registers are swept last and every register is restored.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_sink_mmr_sweep_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-DECODE` |Every one of the 24 registers read its RDL reset, gave back the written value in every bit the contract pins, and drove 0 in every bit no field occupies, before and after the write and after the restore; a wrong readback or a driven undeclared bit fails it
|`CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-READONLY` |Every read of a register carrying a read-only, non-volatile bit held that bit at its RDL reset across the write of every declared bit, so no write reached a field software does not own; a changed read-only bit fails it
|`CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-PAIR` |Two adjacent register pairs of the sink each took one double-width write carrying both registers, and both halves read back with the bits the contract pins taking the pattern and every read-only bit still at its RDL reset; every other access this leaf issues is one register wide
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-DECODE`, `CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-PAIR`, `CHK-DFD-SINK-MMR-READONLY` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The sink and funnel control and pointer registers are `sw = rw; hw = rw`, so the RDL pins no readback value for them; they are written because the decode is what is exercised and held only to what the contract states. No trace runs and no CLA is armed, so the enables written into `Trdstcontrol`, `Trdstramcontrol` and `Trfunnelcontrol` have nothing to act on.
'''''

[[sec-219-smc_dfd_ro_mmr_write_test]]
===== 219 `smc_dfd_ro_mmr_write_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_ro_mmr_write_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the cells are the stated reset values and access classes of
the register description.

*Objective*: Every read-only DFD MMR written, with the write required to be ignored.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every register of the `cla`, `dst`, `dst_sink` and `funnel` sub-blocks that the generated map gives no software-writable field (derived from the map on every run) -- the signal snapshots, the timestamps, the counters' hardware-driven halves, the sink data port and write pointer. The MMR write sweeps drive only registers that have a writable field, so the write decode of these addresses is otherwise never exercised.
* Each register is read twice before the write, so a register that is moving on its own is measured rather than assumed, and only the ones that held still are required to hold their value across the write. The rest are still written, because the decode is what is exercised.
* The CLA is checked disarmed before the sweep starts, so the hardware-driven registers are quiescent.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_ro_mmr_write_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DFD-RO-MMR-HELD` |Every register with no software-writable field that read the same value twice running returned it again after a software write of all ones; one that takes the value fails it unless it is a pinned deviation
|`CHK-DFD-RO-MMR-UNDECLARED` |Every read of every written register drove 0 in each bit no field of the register occupies, before and after the write; a driven undeclared bit fails it
|===

*Note*: `dst_sink/Trdstramwphigh` takes a software write and reads it back, and the map declares it `sw = rw; hw = rw`, so it is not on the read-only list. Every register that is on the list has to ignore the write.


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DFD-RO-MMR-HELD`, `CHK-DFD-RO-MMR-UNDECLARED` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: A register that is moving on its own between its two reads before the write is measured rather than required to hold its value across the write; it is still written, because the decode is what is exercised. `dst_sink/Trdstramwphigh` is not on the read-only list, as the map declares it `sw = rw; hw = rw`.
'''''

[[sec-253-smc_dfd_mmr_lane_test]]
===== 253 `smc_dfd_mmr_lane_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_mmr_lane_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Every DST, DST-sink and funnel MMR written one byte at a time, unmapped offsets of each block read and written, and the addresses past the SMC_CLA window refused with DECERR.

*Test Coverage*:

* The other DFD MMR leaves write whole registers. Here every register of the `dst`, `dst_sink` and `funnel` sub-blocks other than the sink's RAM data port (derived from the map on every run) takes a one-byte store of its low byte's complement, which covers only part of the register's 4-byte lane. The register may ignore the store or take it in its software-writable bits; no other byte may move. It is then written back whole and read back.
* Offsets inside each block's register hole are read and written: offset 0x40 of the DST block, which is also the sink's RAM data port offset in its own block, so the read has to be decoded as an ordinary register access; offset 0x8 of the sink block; and offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18 and 0x1C of the funnel block, the offsets the sink block gives its window start and limit registers. Each access has to complete, a read that completes without error has to return 0 in every bit, as any bit no field occupies does, and the registers on either side of the hole have to hold their values across an all-ones write.

* The SMC local crossbar decodes the DFD port to the SMC_CLA window, the base and size the generated header gives it (16 KiB, cross-checked against the decoded extent of the generated memory map), and sends every address above it to the error slave. A read and an all-ones write go to the first word past the window and to the last word of the unmapped gap above it, which ends where the next generated window starts (`0xC03FFFFC`). Each access has to answer DECERR, and none of the swept registers may move across them.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_mmr_lane_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DFD-MMR-BYTE` |Every swept register took a one-byte store of the low byte's complement, no other byte moved, the writable bits in the low byte took either their old or their new value, and the whole write-back read back exactly; a moved byte, a partial or corrupted low byte, or a failed write-back fails it
|`CHK-DFD-MMR-PAST-WINDOW` |The reads and writes past the SMC_CLA window each answered DECERR, and every swept register read the same value before and after; a hang, any other response or a moved register fails it
|`CHK-DFD-MMR-UNMAPPED` |The read and the write to each unmapped offset completed, the read returned 0 when it completed without error, and the neighbouring registers held their values; a hang, a non-zero read or a moved neighbour fails it
|===

*Design note*: the swept registers ignore a partial-lane store and an unmapped offset inside a block completes OKAY; the register contract pins neither outcome, so `CHK-DFD-MMR-BYTE` and `CHK-DFD-MMR-UNMAPPED` accept either.

*Design note*: with no N-trace sink block, the MMR fabric's window-limit legality check for that block decodes on the block index the funnel occupies, so it acts on writes to the funnel's unmapped offsets 0x10 to 0x1C. Those offsets hold no funnel register, so the observable effect is nil; the funnel accesses above are what exercise that check.


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DFD-MMR-BYTE`, `CHK-DFD-MMR-PAST-WINDOW`, `CHK-DFD-MMR-UNMAPPED` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The register contract pins neither whether a swept register takes a partial-lane store nor whether an unmapped offset inside a block completes OKAY, so the byte-store and unmapped-offset checks accept either outcome. The window-limit legality check that acts on the funnel's unmapped offsets 0x10 to 0x1C has no observable effect, because those offsets hold no funnel register.
'''''

[[sec-222-smc_dfd_dbm_mode_lock_test]]
===== 222 `smc_dfd_dbm_mode_lock_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_dbm_mode_lock_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: Every debug-bus mux mode programmed on every mux, then the CLA lock latched and held.

*Test Coverage*:

* `DEBUG_BUS_MUX.Dbmmode`, two bits, whose RDL description names four modes: off, normal debug, an identifier output mode and a toggle mode. Every other DFD leaf programs only normal debug, so a mux never leaves it. Each of the four is programmed into every one of the 64 values of the identifier field, because a mux takes a mode only while the programmed identifier is its own. The walk ends in the toggle mode, and every mux is then taken out of it into the identifier output mode, so the mode leaves toggle while the mux is still clocked.
* `CDbgClaCtrlStatus.ClaLock`, which the RDL describes as locking the CLA so its enable latches and stays latched. The MMR write sweep excludes that register because the bit cannot be undone, so nothing else tests the contract. It is set as the last act of the run, and a further write whose data has the bit clear has to leave it set. Each leaf is its own simulation and the run ends immediately afterwards, so nothing downstream inherits a locked CLA.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_dbm_mode_lock_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DBM-MODE-SWEEP` |All four values of `Dbmmode` were programmed into all 64 mux identifiers and read back, then all 64 were taken from the toggle mode into the identifier output mode and read back, 320 writes; a mode or identifier the register does not accept fails it
|`CHK-CLA-LOCK-LATCHED` |`ClaLock` read 0, took a software write of 1, and survived a further write to the same register whose data had the bit clear; a lock that does not take, or one that clears, fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-LOCK-LATCHED`, `CHK-DBM-MODE-SWEEP` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-223-smc_dfd_trace_sink_concurrent_test]]
===== 223 `smc_dfd_trace_sink_concurrent_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_sink_concurrent_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The trace sink read out through its MMR port while the trace is still writing it.

*Test Coverage*:

* `smc_dfd_trace_sink_readout_test` stops the trace before reading the sink back, so the sink's read and write sides never move together. This leaf keeps the trace running and drives the read pointer and the RAM data port underneath it, so the write pointer and the read pointer are in motion at the same time and the data port is taken while frames are still arriving. The write-pointer field, with the wrap flag in the same register masked out (field layout from the generated register map), is read at each of the eight read-side steps and has to change between at least one pair of consecutive steps.
* The sink's destination mode is changed between two live phases, so the mode selection is exercised with traffic in flight rather than on an idle sink.
* A third phase enables the DST in the compressed format and walks the frame shape: every combination of the frame-closure mode and the frame length. Where a packet lands inside the accumulator is the write byte boundary, and no register addresses it; the frame geometry is the only software lever that moves it, because it sets where a frame closes and whether a packet crossing that point is pushed back or the frame is closed early. The CLA mux is still off in this phase, so the traced bus holds still and the walk is a register-contract walk; whether packets arrive during it is not measured.
* Before the read side is driven, the trace runs until the sink's wrap flag reports one pass of the window, so every read-pointer position holds a word the trace wrote. The sink's pointer fields sit above two reserved bits and hardware writes them too, so they are programmed through each field's own mask; the register's plain read-write mask leaves them out.
* The compressed phase then puts the CLA's own debug-bus mux (`CDbgMuxSelLo`, off at reset, so the trace sampled a constant bus in every other leaf) in normal mode, puts every DEBUG_BUS_MUX identifier in the identifier output mode, and returns each to normal mode until the `Node0Eap0` debug-signal snapshot changes. The two bus states of that mux, read through the snapshot, must differ in an odd number of bytes. After an emptying stop the action field is walked until `Trdstempty` reads 0 with the bus switching, which restarts the compressed trace, and the bus is switched 160 times at the longest frame length. A run of equal odd-sized compressed packets walks the accumulator write offset through every position, including the odd ones above 32 that an uncompressed stream never reaches; the accumulator offset has no register view, so the next coverage measurement is its witness.
* A RAM-mode window is placed with `Trdstramstartlow` at 0x4000 bytes, one trace RAM size (16 KB) up, and a 0x400-byte limit past it. The value is legal for the byte-address field and out of the RAM's range by construction; the RAM indexes the low address bits, so the trace still lands in it. The held trace has to move the write pointer from the programmed start through that window, which is what the register view shows, and the start register is then written back to its reset. The staged-RAM write-side wrap is set by this window while the read side stays unwrapped, which executes the lapped arm of the sink's distance computation; the read-side wrap itself cannot be set, because the read address only advances through the tied memory write-out.
* A window whose limit is one 64-byte line above its start, the smallest the sink's byte-address fields describe, is programmed, its limit read back, and the trace held on into it.
* The leaf ends in the sink's memory mode (`Trdstrammode` = 1). The memory write-out is never accepted in this bench, so the frames the sink stages in its local RAM are never drained, it backpressures the DST, and in this state the sink's memory-mode flush also reaches the DST. The trace runs uncompressed with the periodic timestamp at its shortest period and the traced bus switched under each of 100 writes of the restarting action, so data and timestamp packets keep asking for space the backpressured sink does not free and the packetizer has to retry them. No register reports the backpressure: `Trdstempty` reads 0 after the 100 writes, which shows data in the DST with the trace held on, and it reads 0 for a stream draining into a RAM-mode sink too, so the leaf claims the flag, not the backpressure. Still in memory mode, the sink enable is then cleared with the sink active and stop-on-wrap set, and the trace is stopped the same way, so the sink's memory-mode stop terms and its empty computation see staged frames with nothing arriving; the sink control is read across that without a claim on the empty flag, and the trace is restarted. The sink is then re-armed in RAM mode and the stream has to resume, after which the RAM data port is read back to back while the stream writes, so register reads meet RAM writes; every wait is bounded, so a sink stuck in backpressure fails the leaf instead of stalling it. It runs last because a software stop after it does not empty the packetizer. The staged-RAM lap rows cannot be reached: the read side only advances through the tied memory write-out, and backpressure at half the staging RAM stops the write side long before it can lap.
* The uncompressed stream runs at the longest frame length the field offers, so the fixed-size packets carry the accumulator's write offset through every even position before a frame closes, and then at the shortest frame and stream lengths. With `Trdstempty` at 0 and the restarting action written before each of four write-pointer reads, the pointer has to advance at every read, so the stream is still running into the sink when the trace is stopped by clearing `Trdstenable` alone with `Trdstactive` held at 1, so the DST clock keeps running while the stream winds down with packets in flight, and the write pointer has to park. A register read takes a fixed number of `clk_smc_i` cycles and the DST, the sink and the read path all run on that clock, so the bound is a count of reads and holds at every sys-clock period. `Trdstempty` is then read over 32 polls and recorded without a claim; see the first known DUT behaviour below.
* The trace is then run into a sink with `Trdstramstoponwrap` set, and the sink enable is cleared afterwards with the sink kept active and the setting still held.
* `Trdstsyncmode` is walked through every value of its field under both values of `Trdsttimestampconfig`, on a fresh sink with a 0x10000-byte window, so the stream under one value does not carry the write pointer a whole lap, and the pointer is read before the walk and after each value and has to move under each. The RDL description publishes only the timestamp value of the sync mode and marks the others as not applicable, so the walk takes the whole field range. Under each value a short action burst is followed by the restarting action measured in the odd-offset walk, held for 24 writes: a sweep of the action field passes values that stop the trace as well as start it, so a sweep alone runs the stream for about eleven 64-byte frames and leaves it stopped, short of the shortest stream length.
* Last of all, frame mode is turned off in `CDbgDebugTraceCfg`, the uncompressed stream is held on and the enable cleared with the DST active, and `Trdstempty` is read over a bounded number of polls without a claim; the outcome is recorded below.

*Known limitation*: the accumulator's bank states are not visible at the register interface, so this leaf produces the boundary stimulus but cannot witness which bank state a given frame shape reaches. An uncompressed packet is a fixed 10 bytes against a 32-byte bank, so the boundary only ever lands on even offsets, and the long-frame stretch carries it through all of them; the odd offsets need odd-sized compressed packets, which the odd-offset walk produces. No checker claims `Trdstempty` returns to 1 after `Trdstenable` is cleared alone with `Trdstactive` held while packets are in flight; the packetizer does not empty at every clock phase of the stop (first known DUT behaviour below).

*Known DUT behaviour*, on this leaf's stimulus:

* Clearing `Trdstenable` alone with `Trdstactive` held at 1 while the uncompressed stream is running does not always bring `Trdstempty` back to 1. The falling enable puts the packetizer in flush mode on the next clock, and flush mode ends on the first frame close (`packetizer.sv`, `flush_mode_exit = frame_fill && !fifo_push`; `debug_sig_trace_gen.sv`). When the falling enable lands so that flush mode starts in the same clock as an ordinary frame close, flush mode ends at once, and the packet still in the generator pipeline lands in the accumulator after it: the FIFO reads empty, the accumulator holds that packet, no further frame close comes, and `Trdstempty` stays 0. At the shortest frame (64 bytes, a frame closing every six clocks under the uncompressed stream), of the six clock phases at which the stop can fall, one leaves `Trdstempty` at 0 for as long as the leaf polls and the other five read it back at 1 on the first poll. Which phase a run hits is set by the bench's clock periods and the register path's latency, not by the seed. The register description gives `Trdstempty` no text, so no specification states it must return to 1.
* A trace stopped by a CLA action leaves a partial bank in the packetizer accumulator: the FIFO reads empty, the accumulator does not, and the bank stays until more trace arrives or `Trdstenable` is cleared with `Trdstactive` held. Only that falling enable starts the flush.
* After the memory-mode phase, in which the sink's memory-mode flush reaches the DST as a hardware flush, clearing `Trdstenable` with `Trdstactive` held does not empty the packetizer: the flush mode does not start, the FIFO reads empty and the accumulator does not. The memory-mode phase therefore runs last.
* With `FrameModeEnable` cleared, clearing `Trdstenable` with `Trdstactive` held does not bring `Trdstempty` back to 1 within 32 polls, whether the software-stop phase in frame mode off runs before the memory-mode phase or at the end of the leaf. The frame-mode-off leg therefore runs last and claims nothing about emptying.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_sink_concurrent_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-HIGHSTART` |With `Trdstramstartlow` at 0x4000 bytes and the limit 0x400 past it, the held trace moves the write pointer above the start and not past the limit within 32 polls; a pointer that stays at or below the start, or passes the limit, fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-IDLE` |With the sink armed and no trace captured, the RAM data port reads 0 and the write-pointer register reads 0: the pointer field the arm wrote and the wrap flag clear. Either one non-zero fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-DRAIN` |Inside one live trace the read pointer was driven to eight positions across the window, the data port returned at least one non-zero word against that baseline, and the write-pointer field, wrap flag masked, read at those eight steps, changed between at least one pair of consecutive steps; any of the three missing fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-MODE` |The sink was armed and driven through a live trace in both values of its destination-mode field, each read back exactly; a value the register does not accept fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-EDGES` |`Trdstramlimitlow` reads back the one-line limit 0x40 it was written, with the trace then held on into that window; a limit that does not read back fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-FRAMEWALK` |With the DST enabled in the compressed format the frame shape was walked through all 32 combinations of the closure mode and the frame length, each written and read back exactly; a combination the registers do not accept fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-ODDBYTES` |With the CLA mux in normal mode, a DEBUG_BUS_MUX identifier whose mode change moves the debug-signal snapshot is found, its two bus states differ in an odd number of bytes, an action restarts the compressed trace after an emptying stop, the sink write pointer moves across the 160 switches, and the snapshot ends on the normal-mode state; no mux that moves the snapshot, an even byte difference, no restarting action, a pointer that stays put or a wrong final state fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-MEMORY` |With the sink in memory mode and the uncompressed trace held on for 100 action writes, `Trdstempty` reads 0; the sink and trace stop writes that follow read back exactly; re-armed in RAM mode, the write pointer moves within 32 polls. `Trdstempty` at 1 after the hold writes, or a stream that does not resume, fails it; the flag does not distinguish a refusing sink from a draining one, so backpressure itself is not claimed
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-STOP` |With the uncompressed stream running, `Trdstempty` reads 0 and, with the restarting action written before each read, four write-pointer reads advance one after another immediately before the stop; once `Trdstenable` is cleared with `Trdstactive` held, three back-to-back pointer reads agree within 32 reads, and `Trdstcontrol` reads `Trdstenable` 0 and `Trdstactive` 1. `Trdstempty` already 1 while running, a pointer that does not move while running, or one that keeps moving after the stop fails it. `Trdstempty` after the stop is recorded, not compared
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-STOPWRAP` |With `Trdstramstoponwrap` set the write pointer is sampled between 0 and where it ends, the last three of eight samples agree while the trace is still driven, the parked value is inside the window, and it does not move once the sink enable is cleared with the setting held; a pointer that never moves, keeps moving, parks past the window or moves after the disable fails it
|`CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-SYNCWALK` |`Trdstsyncmode` was written and read back exactly in every value of its field under both timestamp sources, and the sink write pointer read after the stream under each value differs from the read before it; a value either register does not accept, or a pointer that does not move under a value, fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-DRAIN`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-EDGES`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-FRAMEWALK`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-HIGHSTART`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-IDLE`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-MEMORY`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-MODE`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-ODDBYTES`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-STOP`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-STOPWRAP`, `CHK-DST-CONCURRENT-SYNCWALK` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The accumulator's bank states and its write offset have no register view, so the leaf produces the boundary stimulus but cannot witness which bank state a frame shape reaches, and whether packets arrive during the frame-shape walk is not measured. No register reports the sink's backpressure, and `Trdstempty` reads 0 for a stream draining into a RAM-mode sink too, so the memory-mode leg claims the flag, not the backpressure; the sink control read across the memory-mode stop makes no claim on the empty flag. The read-side wrap and the staged-RAM lap rows cannot be reached, because the read address only advances through the tied memory write-out. `Trdstempty` after a stop by clearing `Trdstenable` with `Trdstactive` held (uncompressed with packets in flight, after the memory-mode phase, and with frame mode off) is recorded over bounded polls, not compared: the register description gives it no text, so no specification states it must return to 1.
'''''

[[sec-224-smc_dfd_cla_snapshot_capture_test]]
===== 224 `smc_dfd_cla_snapshot_capture_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_snapshot_capture_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Every CLA pair driven over its whole action range on its own node, with the snapshot registers read.

*Test Coverage*:

* All 16 event-action pairs across all four nodes, each driven over the whole declared range of its action field with a relation this sequence measures to activate that pair, on the node the DUT reports current. The other CLA leaves drive the action field on one pair of one node only.
* All 32 debug-signal snapshot registers read at their RDL reset first and again after their own pair has acted.
* The debug-bus mux array is put into the identifier output mode its description names, and the CLA's own mux (`CDbgMuxSelLo`), which resets to off and would hold the bus at zero, into normal debug mode, so the bus the pairs capture carries known non-zero content and holds still.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_snapshot_capture_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-RESET` |All 32 snapshot registers read their RDL reset before the CLA was armed; one already moved fails it
|`CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-DRIVE` |All 16 pairs across all four nodes had their action field driven over its whole declared range with a relation measured to activate that pair; a pair that never activates, or a node the walk cannot reach, fails it
|`CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-CAPTURE` |After each pair acted, its `Lo` snapshot left its RDL reset and all sixteen read the same value, the content of a bus that holds still; the `Hi` halves stayed at their reset. A `Lo` snapshot at its reset, two pairs that disagree, or a `Hi` half that moves fails it
|===

*Known limitation*: the `Hi` halves of the snapshot registers cannot be written at all in this configuration. `smc_dfd_wrap.sv` passes `DEBUG_SIGNAL_WIDTH` of 64, `core_logic_analyzer.sv` makes `DBG_SIGNAL_CONFIG` the comparison of that against 128, and the generate in `core_logic_analyzer.sv` that drives the `Hi` write enables is therefore not elaborated.


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-CAPTURE`, `CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-DRIVE`, `CHK-CLA-SNAPSHOT-RESET` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The `Hi` halves of the snapshot registers cannot be written at all in this configuration (a debug signal width of 64, so the generate that drives their write enables is not elaborated); only their staying at reset is observed.
'''''

[[sec-300-smc_dfd_cla_live_bus_test]]
===== 300 `smc_dfd_cla_live_bus_test`

*Phase*: 2

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_cla_live_bus_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The CLA's signal event generators, counters and actions driven on a debug bus that moves between two measured states.

*Test Coverage*:

* The other CLA leaves leave the CLA's own mux at its off reset, so every signal event generator sees a bus that never moves. Here the CLA mux is put in normal mode and the DEBUG_BUS_MUX identifier feeding it is found by measurement; its identifier and normal modes put two different values on the bus, both read through the node 0 pair 0 snapshot.
* From those two states: both edge detectors select the lowest differing bit with opposite polarities, then swapped; the change mask covers the differing bits; the transition registers describe the move between the states; the four comparators take a value between the states and a value equal to the first, under a low-byte mask and its complement; the LFSR is enabled from a non-zero seed. The bus is switched 16 times under each edge configuration.
* The two match events whose indices the descriptions of `CDbgSignalMask0Lo` and `CDbgSignalMask1Lo` give (0x2 and 0x4) are set to follow the two states, and node 0 pair 1 selecting them is walked over every value of its relation field while the bus switches, once with the two events and once with the first event twice.
* The action that leaves counter 0 moving after the pair's enable is cleared is found by measurement and written before every action value in turn, with the counter set back to its target after each pair. Then, with a non-zero cross-trigger stretch, both clock-halt disables cleared (the halt output does not gate the SMC's own clocks in this bench) and every counter given a target of 2 with `ResetOnTarget` set, the action field is swept twice with an activating pair and once more with `EnableEap` clear.
* The action field is swept once more with the lowest bit of `DEBUG_CTRL.xtrig_clk_halt_mask` set, which its description makes the halt enable for that position, and the mask is cleared again.
* Each custom-action enable of pair 0 is set on its own and `Resync` is set with no cross trigger.
* The CLA mux is put in normal mode with `Finegraintime` set and then in identifier mode, the snapshot read after each.
* Node 0's other pairs are held on the first match event while all four pairs name destination 1, so the chain moves away from pairs whose relation holds.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_cla_live_bus_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-CLA-LIVE-BUS` |A DEBUG_BUS_MUX identifier moves the snapshot, every generator register write reads back exactly, and the snapshot shows both measured states across the switches; no feeding mux, a rejected write, or a bus that does not reach both states fails it
|`CHK-CLA-LIVE-MATCH` |The four match-event registers read back exactly and node 0 pair 1 activates under at least one relation value with its events on the match events while the bus switches; no activation fails it
|`CHK-CLA-LIVE-ACTIONS` |A running action is found, every stretch, counter and halt-mask write reads back exactly, and after the sweeps every counter reads at or below its target, as the description of `ResetOnTarget` makes it; no running action, a rejected write or a counter past its target fails it
|`CHK-CLA-LIVE-MUXMODES` |The snapshot with the CLA mux in normal mode and `Finegraintime` set differs from the normal-mode state measured with it clear, and the identifier-mode snapshot differs from it in turn; a mode change that leaves the bus where it was fails it
|`CHK-CLA-LIVE-NODE` |Both custom-action enables and `Resync` read back exactly, and `CurrentNode` reads 1 within 8 polls after the move; a rejected write or a chain that stays on node 0 fails it
|===

*Known limitation*: the CLA timestamp input is tied to 0 in the SMC, so the time-match event can never fire, however the match value is programmed.


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-CLA-LIVE-ACTIONS`, `CHK-CLA-LIVE-BUS`, `CHK-CLA-LIVE-MATCH`, `CHK-CLA-LIVE-MUXMODES`, `CHK-CLA-LIVE-NODE` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The CLA timestamp input is tied to 0 in the SMC, so the time-match event can never fire, however the match value is programmed. The halt output does not gate the SMC's own clocks in this bench.
'''''

[[sec-301-smc_dfd_trace_flush_corner_test]]
===== 301 `smc_dfd_trace_flush_corner_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_flush_corner_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI)

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: The DST's trace control driven through stream lengths, start/stop action loops, timestamp phases and memory-mode sink flushes, with the trace actions measured first.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every value of the `Action0` field of node 0 pair 0 is sorted into those that start the uncompressed trace, those that stop it and those that leave it as it is, with the sink write pointer as the witness: it moves while packets arrive.
* `Trdstvendorstreamlength` is written in every encoding. The sink is armed twice in memory mode at one start, the second time with the limit one 64-byte line above it, then in RAM mode with that window. With the sink stopped on wrap and disabled, `Trfunneldisinput` takes bits 15:8, which its description gives the DST sources.
* Compressed with the bus still, start/stop pairs run under every `Trdstsyncmode` value until the write pointer has advanced 64 frames of 64 bytes, the stream that stream-length encoding 0 describes. Uncompressed at the reset stream length, the trace runs 128 frames inside a 16 KB window, and the stream length drops to encoding 0 under the running trace.
* Node 0 pair 0 starts the trace and names node 1, whose pair 0 stops it and names node 0, so the trace starts and stops on consecutive cycles.
* With `Trdstsyncmode` 2 and `Trdstsyncmax` 0, a timestamp is due every 16 cycles; a stop action and a `Trdstenable` clear each land 32 different delays after the start.
* With `FrameClosureMode` 1 the frame length toggles between 128 and 64 bytes 64 times under the running trace.
* The sink is armed in memory mode with the trace running on the neutral action, then four times under each of six loops of the start, stop and neutral actions over two to four nodes, so the flush it causes reaches the DST while it traces, stops and is stopped; it is re-armed in RAM mode after each.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_flush_corner_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-REGS` |Every stream-length encoding, the one-line limit in both sink modes and the DST-source disable bits read back exactly; a rejected write fails it
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-ACTIONS` |At least one `Action0` value starts the trace, at least one stops it, none does both, and one leaves a running trace running without being a start value; any of these missing fails it
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-STREAMS` |The start/stop pairs move the write pointer 64 frames within 1024 pairs under every sync value; the uncompressed trace advances at least 128 frames without wrapping and the write pointer keeps moving after the stream length drops; a stall, a wrap or a stop after the drop fails it
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-LOOP` |`CurrentNode` reads 1 once node 1 names itself and 0 once both pairs name node 0; any other node fails it
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-PHASES` |The closure-mode write reads back and the write pointer keeps moving after the 64 frame-length toggles; a rejected write or a stalled trace fails it
|`CHK-DST-FLUSH-MEMARMS` |After the 25 memory-mode arms the chain reads node 0 and the start action moves the write pointer again; a chain left elsewhere or a trace that does not restart fails it
|===

*Known limitation*: the sink's memory write-out is accepted once and never again in this bench, so memory mode is only armed, never drained, and the leaf makes no claim about `Trdstempty` after a memory-mode flush.


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-FLUSH-ACTIONS`, `CHK-DST-FLUSH-LOOP`, `CHK-DST-FLUSH-MEMARMS`, `CHK-DST-FLUSH-PHASES`, `CHK-DST-FLUSH-REGS`, `CHK-DST-FLUSH-STREAMS` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: The sink's memory write-out is accepted once and never again in this bench, so memory mode is only armed, never drained, and no claim is made about `Trdstempty` after a memory-mode flush.
'''''

[[sec-302-smc_dfd_trace_reset_test]]
===== 302 `smc_dfd_trace_reset_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_reset_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI), SMC reset agent

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: A cool reset taken while the DST is tracing returns the DFD to its RDL reset state, and the trace starts again once the path is programmed afresh.

*Test Coverage*:

* The funnel, sink, DST, CLA and both debug-bus muxes are programmed away from reset, an `Action0` value that starts the uncompressed trace is found by measurement, and the write pointer has to be moving.
* `rst_cool_ni` is driven low until `rst_primary_smc_clk_no` is observed at 0, then released until it and the warm reset return to 1 and the fuse sense completes; `hw/sys/smc/doc/clk_rst.adoc` lists the cool reset as a Primary Reset source.
* Every field the sequence moved is read back after the reset against its RDL reset value, the sink write pointer against its reset value, and the trace path is programmed again and started from the measured action.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_reset_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DFD-RESET-LIVE` |Every programmed field reads away from its RDL reset value and the write pointer moves before the reset; a field already at reset or a stalled trace fails it
|`CHK-DFD-RESET-TAKEN` |The primary reset asserts within 400 `clk_ref_i` edges of the cool pin going low and it and the warm reset release within 4000 of it going high; either bound expiring fails it
|`CHK-DFD-RESET-CLEARED` |Every programmed field of the nine registers reads its RDL reset value after the reset, and the write pointer reads its reset value and stays there; any field left programmed or a moving pointer fails it
|`CHK-DFD-RESET-RESTART` |Programmed again, the measured start action moves the write pointer; a trace that does not restart fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DFD-RESET-CLEARED`, `CHK-DFD-RESET-LIVE`, `CHK-DFD-RESET-RESTART`, `CHK-DFD-RESET-TAKEN` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-303-smc_dfd_trace_writeout_phase_test]]
===== 303 `smc_dfd_trace_writeout_phase_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_trace_writeout_phase_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI), SMC reset agent

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/cpu.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes` `smoke`;
`timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, every stimulus value is pinned by the entry and the sequence
draws nothing from the seed.

*Objective*: Sink-mode and stop writes walked a cycle at a time across the flush a memory-mode arm causes and across the sink's single memory write-out.

*Test Coverage*:

* The start, stop and neutral values of the `Action0` field of node 0 pair 0 are measured with the sink write pointer as the witness, as in card 301.
* With the trace running on the neutral action, the sink is armed in memory mode and the stop action written 1 to 16 cycles later, under frame lengths of 128, 192 and 256 bytes, which move the end of the flush the arm causes.
* The bench accepts one memory write-out per reset. 64 times, a cool reset is taken, the trace path is programmed afresh with 256-byte frames and started, and 1 to 64 cycles later the sink is switched to memory mode and at once back to RAM mode, so the switch back lands at every cycle of the first frame's fill and read-out.

*Test Procedure*:

Drive `smc_dfd_trace_writeout_phase_test_seq`. Each checker below is a named compare the DUT can fail; a token is emitted only after that compare holds.


*Checkers*:

[cols="1,2",options="header",]
|===
|Checker |Description
|`CHK-DST-PHASE-ACTIONS` |At least one `Action0` value starts the trace, at least one stops it, none does both, and one leaves a running trace running; any of these missing fails it
|`CHK-DST-PHASE-FLUSH` |After the 48 stop attempts the RAM-mode re-arm reads `Trdstrammode` 0; any other mode fails it
|`CHK-DST-PHASE-WRITEOUT` |After each of the 64 switches `Trdstrammode` reads 0, and at the end `CurrentNode` reads 0 and the start action moves the write pointer; a sink left in memory mode, a chain away from node 0 or a trace that does not restart fails it
|===


*Pass Criteria*: `CHK-DST-PHASE-ACTIONS`, `CHK-DST-PHASE-FLUSH`, `CHK-DST-PHASE-WRITEOUT` hold after their compares and every sequence assert holds. Enrolled in: `all`, `hosted`.

*Scope limit*: None stated.
'''''

[[sec-446-smc_dfd_csr_field_access_test]]
===== 446 `smc_dfd_csr_field_access_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: JTAG

*Source Module*: `smc_dfd_csr_field_access_test`

*BFM / Model*: ocah_axi_vip (AXI) on SEP_IN, full-width accesses to the `smc_cla` aperture blocks
`dst_sink`, `funnel` and `dst` (the six `dst` registers and the `ScratchLo` / `ScratchHi` pair of
each block, addresses taken from the generated register map); bench signal `tb_fuse_sense_done`

*Run mode*: one testlist entry in `testlists/jtag.toml`; groups `all`, `hosted`; `run_modes`
`smoke`; `timeout_sec` 1800; tags `ci`; seed 1; tool Verilator (cocotb).

*Randomization*: RAND-NONE: directed, the leaf walks the whole cell set in one run.

*Objective*: DST field and scratch storage and same-offset block independence.

*Test Coverage*:

* Every software-writable field of the six DST registers (`dfd_dst.rdl`) is written alone with
  all ones and then all zeros, the other fields at their RDL reset value, and read back. Fields
  the hardware also writes (`Trdstinsttracing`) and `Trdstformat`, whose supported value set the
  specification does not state, are printed, not compared.
* Writing one field to the complement of its baseline value leaves every other software-writable,
  non-hardware-driven field of its register and every other register of the DST block as it was.
* The bit positions no DST field covers (for example `Trdstcontrol` bits 8:7, 10, 14, 19:18 and
  31:27) are written with ones and with zeros and read; the stored values are printed. No DST
  field is declared there in `dfd_dst.rdl`, so no value is compared.
* `Trdstinsttracing` and `Trdstinsttriggerenable` are written and read with the trace inactive
  and with `Trdstactive` and `Trdstenable` set, no capture started; the stored values and whether
  hardware changed `Trdstinsttracing` are printed.
* The six scratch registers (`ScratchLo` and `ScratchHi` of `dst_sink`, `funnel` and `dst`, the
  registers `dfd_dst.rdl` describes as scratch for DV use) store four fixed patterns and 32
  walking ones, and six distinct values written before any read each read back from their own
  register.
* `ScratchLo` sits at the same block-relative offset in the three blocks; with distinct values
  written in turn, each block returns its own value and the other two keep theirs, per the
  aperture layout in `smc_cla.rdl` (`dst_sink` at 0x0, `funnel` at 0x1000, `dst` after the CLA).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Wait for `tb_fuse_sense_done`, bounded to 200000 clock cycles.
. Build the register list from the generated map, require six registers in the `dst` block, and
  read each one: the bits no hardware drives must equal the RDL reset value.
. For each software-writable field, write all ones then all zeros alone, read the register back
  and compare the field; restore the baseline after each field.
. For each software-writable field, write the baseline, read the six DST registers, write the
  field alone to the complement of its baseline value, read the six registers again and compare
  every bit that is not hardware-driven, outside the written field; restore the baseline.
. Write ones and then zeros to the positions no field covers, register by register, and print what
  reads back.
. Write the instruction-trace fields of `Trdstcontrol` (1 and 0) with the trace inactive and active,
  read after each write and print the values; restore the baseline.
. Write each of the six scratch registers with all ones, all zeros, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555 and
  the 32 walking ones, reading each back and comparing it; write 0 after each register.
. Write six distinct values to the six scratch registers before any read, then read all six and
  compare each with its own value; write 0 to all.
. Write three distinct values to `ScratchLo` of the three blocks one after another; after each
  write read all three and compare each with the value it should hold.
. Write every `dst` register and every scratch register its reset word and compare the bits no
  hardware
